constructionwand.advancement.constructionwand.root.title: Construction Wands Revived
constructionwand.advancement.constructionwand.void_sack.t: Store items from the Destruction Core inside the Void Sack or linked containers
constructionwand.constructionwand.description.core:
§5§nINSTALLATION§0§r
Put your new core together with your wand in a crafting grid to install it. To switch between cores, hold down %s and left click empty space with your wand or use the option screen.
constructionwand.constructionwand.description.core_angel: The angel core places a block on the opposite side of the block (or row of blocks) you are facing. Maximum distance depends on wand tier. Right click empty space to place a block in midair. To do that, you'll need to have the block you want to place in your offhand.
constructionwand.constructionwand.description.core_destru: The destruction core destroys blocks (no tile entities) on the side facing you. Maximum number of blocks depends on wand tier. Destroyed blocks disappear into the void, you can use the undo feature if you've made a mistake.
constructionwand.constructionwand.description.void_sack:
The Void Sack intercepts items you pick up and stores them in its 4×4 internal inventory.

§5§nACTIVATION§0§r
Press %1$s to activate or deactivate the sack. While inactive, items go to your normal inventory as usual.

§5§nLINKING A CONTAINER§0§r
Right-click any container (chest, barrel, shulker...) while holding the sack to link it. Once linked, items go to that container first when the sack is active. If the container is full, the overflow goes to the sack's internal storage.

§5§nTOGGLE MODE§0§r
Press %1$s to switch between §aSending§0 (items → container) and §eStoring§0 (items → internal slots). You can also click the toggle button inside the sack GUI.
constructionwand.constructionwand.description.wand:
The %1$s can place up to %2$d blocks at the side of a building facing you and lasts %3$s.

Hold down %5$s and scroll to change placement restriction (Horizontal, Vertical, North/South, East/West, No lock).

Open the option screen with %6$s§9+Right click§0.

§5§nUNDO§0§r
Holding down §9Sneak+§0%4$s while looking at a blocks will show you the last blocks you placed with a green border around them. §9Sneak+§0%4$s§9+Right clicking§0 any of them will undo the operation, giving you all the items back. If you used the Destruction core, it will restore the blocks.

§5§nCONTAINERS§0§r
Shulker boxes, bundles and many containers from other mods can provide building blocks for the wand.

§5§nOFFHAND PRIORITY§0§r
Having blocks in your offhand will place them instead of the block you're looking at.

And do all possible trades for these types

 - Local select the trade for the active villager only.

Bookmarks also work for Wandering Traders but they only have Global type.

stextras.stextras.skill_imitator.description.tens: As the second highest authority in the western holy church, Hinata's only goal is to protect humanity with no room for compromise.
Folgen was a loyal yet ruthless knight of Falmuth, devoted to his nation above all else. Cold and pragmatic, he saw others as tools and met his end facing Rimuru’s wrath.
Only caring for her former world, Kirara views the cardinal world as nothing more than an illusion for her to play with. She is willing to cross almost any line to get her way.
Enjoying the fantasy of being summoned, Kyoya holds no hate for the cardinal world. His calm and curious demeanor hides his more violent tendencies.
Serious and driven to repay her debts, Mai aims to master her ability so that she can return home and can care for her family.
Short tempered and with a strong dislike of being kept out of the loop, Mark strives to be successful in life and live luxuriously.
Shinji Tanimura is a Japanese Otherworlder who previously served as a military officer in the Eastern Empire. He was granted asylum in Tempest and now works as Ramiris's assistant.
Shin Ryusei is an Otherworlder and disciple of Gadra. After defecting to the Jura Tempest Federation, he now works as Ramiris' assistant, helping her with research and dungeon development.

Shizue, known as the Conqueror of Flames, was a human summoned from Japan and a former Hero. She possessed the spirit Ifrit and served as a teacher and inspiration to many, including Rimuru Tempest, who inherited her will and physical appearance.
Shogo was a human summoned from another world, one of three Otherworlders working for the Falmuth Kingdom. Consumed by power and arrogance, he died after colliding with Rimuru's forces.
The Orc Disaster, also known as Geld, was an Orc Lord who transformed into a Demon Lord Seed after devouring numerous foes.
stextras.stextras.skill_imitator.description.trmy: Ai Hoshino is a an idol from another world renowned for her radiant charm and captivating performances. Despite her cheerful demeanor, she conceals deep emotions beneath her smile.
stextras.stextras.skill_imitator.description.tens: Rimuru is a Demon Lord who founded and rules the Jura Tempest Federation. He is also one of the Octagram's Eight Demon Lords. Rimuru, once a human, was reincarnated as a Slime in another world and quickly rose to power.

Carrion, also known as Beast Master, is the ruler of the Beast Kingdom of Eurazania and the lycanthropes. He is a former Demon Lord of the Ten Great Demon Lords and now works as Milim Nava's assistant alongside Frey.
Luminous is a Demon Lord, the fifth seat of the Octagram, and the legitimate ruler of the Holy Empire of Lubelius. She is the leader of all vampires and one of the oldest Demon Lords.

tensura_blade.tensura_blade.wiki.blessing_bearer:
Blessing Bearer

Passives
[Passive - Toggle] Thought Acceleration —
Increases movement, attack and chanting speed. Mastering Blessing Bearer improves movement/attack bonuses and adds dodge invulnerability, following native Thought Acceleration configuration.

[Passive - Toggle] Self Regeneration —
Heals each second while injured. Mastery improves healing and also restores spiritual health. Uses the native Self Regeneration magicule cost with its own regeneration cycle. Pauses when energy is insufficient or healing is blocked.

Both passives use Blessing Bearer's toggle, without needing an active slot. They are calculated independently and do not grant extra skill entries or change existing standalone skills, their toggles, mastery or effects.

Active Modes
[Active - Press] World Blessing —
Spend 30 experience levels to draw an unowned blessing from the 15-entry pool. Associated resistances reach 100% mastery. Chat announces the blessing and native skill acquisition messages.

[Active - Press] World Response —
Switch Blessing Bearer's mode to list collected blessings in chat. Cooldown: 3 minutes. No experience cost.

[Active] Blessing of Martial Arts
Each successful draw costs 6 Magic Ore Shards and 60 XP levels. 35 equally likely, non-repeating blessings; no cost on completion or failure. Native skills gain full mastery. World Response lists both collections. Custom passives follow the Bearer toggle; native rewards retain their own toggles.

rain: Strength V when raining.

sky: Grant Gravity Domination at full mastery.

night: Strength V at night.

day: Strength V during daytime.

drive: Permanent Speed II.

lake: Underwater speed x1.5 and Water Breathing.

fog: Immune to Darkness and Blindness.

telepathy: Grant Chant Annulment at full mastery.

judgment: Damage against pillagers x1.5.

taste: Each food eaten adds 15 base EP.

cooking: Food grants Saturation for 5 minutes; cooldown 10 minutes.

medicine: Drunk potion effects last twice as long.

poison: Immune to Magicule Poison.

bleeding: 100 accumulated actual damage grants Haste II for 3 minutes; cooldown 10 minutes.

projectile: Immune to projectile attacks.

arrow: Grant Spatial Domination at full mastery.

first_sight: First attack from each enemy is blocked and heals its damage amount, capped at missing health.

return: Block incoming attacks in a 90-degree forward cone with line of sight.

first_strike: First melee hit per enemy is critical and bypasses dodge, resistance and barriers; resets after 30 seconds out of combat.

phoenix: Prevents one death every 10 minutes, including /kill, void/bypass damage, direct death and zero physical/spiritual health. Restores 1 HP and full magicules, without the totem overlay. Repeated death operations within the same server tick count as one event; cooldown grants no extra life.

unarmed: Empty-hand melee bypasses dodge, resistance and barriers; invulnerability remains.

nightmare: Spiritual health cannot decrease.

flight: Flying and gliding speed x1.5.

forging: Eligible held armor gains Protection IV without downgrading or replacing incompatible enchantments.

eating: Eat twice as fast.

dragon: Damage to dragons x1.5; entity tag tensura_blade:dragons.

smelting: Automatically smelt ore drops using furnace recipes.

shovel: Dirt mining speed x2.

axe: Logs and planks mining speed x2.

fortune: Virtual Fortune V and Looting V; permanent Luck V.

World Blessing: Thorns grants fully mastered Pierce Resistance.
Martial additions: Debris grants one extra Netherite Scrap per Ancient Debris mined. Nullification continuously evolves current and future permanent resistances via native evolution links, with full mastery and no EP cost. Scholar adds 12 to both ability learning and mastery gain. Slashing leaves unhealable wounds on non-player mobs from actual sword damage; players and absorption hearts are excluded. Phoenix revives without the central totem item overlay, retaining sound, particles and magicule refill.
Hero blessing: after drawing it, collect 20 different blessings and reach 500,000 player EP to receive Hero Egg once per player in this save. Counts both pools and unlocked hidden blessings, including Hero itself; no duplicates. Never downgrades a True Hero.

Successful Dragon Sword draws add 15 mastery points, capped at full mastery, with a player-wide 2-minute reward cooldown. Failed draws and sheathing grant no mastery. Existing mastery sources remain.

Purple (Majin) and red (Chaos) alignments: Hero Blessing cannot be obtained or used and grants no Hero Egg. Current alignment is checked after reincarnation. After collecting the other 34 martial blessings, Martial Blessing cannot be activated and consumes nothing. While Majin- or Chaos-aligned, eating 10 Dragon Essences does not unlock Sword Saint Blessing or grant a Dragon Sword; saved unlocks do not restore the blessing or issue pending gifts.

Reincarnation reset: character or race reincarnation clears collected world, martial and hidden Sword Saint blessings, and removes Dragon Swords and scabbards. Consume ten fresh Dragon Essences and meet the unlock requirements to receive the sword again. A paid, locked ultimate skill remains, but its blessings must be collected again. Ordinary deaths do not trigger this reset.

Hero Egg limit: the Hero blessing grants at most one egg per player in this save. Losing it, evolution, death, reincarnation, reconnecting and relearning never reset the reward. Existing Hero-blessing owners with an egg or True Hero status are marked as already rewarded. Purple and red alignments cannot obtain the Hero blessing or receive a Dragon Sword through essences, saved unlocks or the World-Blessed Child reward.

tensura_blade.tensura_blade.wiki.reinhard:
Sword Saint - Reinhard

Embedded Thought Acceleration bonuses are doubled. Self Regeneration is replaced with embedded Ultraspeed Regeneration: every half second, restore missing physical health using the native magicule cost and mastery discount. Insufficient magicules restore only the affordable portion. It creates no standalone skill or shared effect and does not restore spiritual health. Blessing potion levels are doubled (Strength V to X, Speed II to IV, Luck V to X, Haste II to IV), including cooking, water breathing and phoenix effects. Durations, cooldowns, costs, native standalone skills, enchantments and other blessing bonuses are unchanged.

While toggled on, grants immunity to native Anti-Skill and clears existing Anti-Skill. Other status/area rules are preserved. The hidden sword passive is inherited without granting another sword. World Response retains its 3-minute cooldown.

With Sword Saint, Dragon Sword removes 0.5 maximum health per point of actual health damage from non-player enemies, until death (minimum maximum health: 1). After defeating a recognized enemy or leaving its 16-block detection radius, returns to the matching sheath after 10 seconds without a recognized enemy nearby. Reentry cancels the countdown; leaving again starts a new 10-second countdown.
Phoenix prevents one death per 10 minutes, including /kill and direct physical/spiritual death. It restores full magicules without a totem overlay. A death sequence within one server tick consumes one charge. Dragon Sword also recognizes non-player mobs with learned Unique/Ultimate skills or over 2000 maximum HP within 16 blocks, regardless of their toggle.
While enabled, also blocks and removes Silence, Anti-Magic and Magic Interference. Recovers 300,000 magicules per second, capped at maximum, with no additional doubling. This recovery is exclusive to the ultimate skill.

Reincarnation lock
Eat 30 Dragon Essences in total and own this Ultimate Skill to lock it automatically with one bonus native lock slot when SlimeThroneExtras is absent. The ten essences recorded by older versions count toward thirty; unrecorded consumption cannot be reconstructed. Retain this skill, blessing collection, their learned native rewards, mastery and cooldowns through reincarnation while locked. Manually unlocking disables retention; the bonus slot is awarded only once.

Dragon Essence loot
Melee kills with your own drawn Dragon Sword add three essences for Ice and Fire cave dragons. Other non-player creatures have a 10% base chance to drop 1-3 essences, plus two percentage points per Looting level, capped at 100%. Fortune blessing supplies Looting V; take the higher level instead of adding levels. Cave dragons do not receive the random reward as well.

Skill lock screen
With SlimeThroneExtras installed, consuming 30 essences adds Reinhard to its actual lock screen with the standard chain/lock indicators. Previously paid saves migrate automatically. Unlocking follows the pack rules; this paid skill can be locked again without more essences. No lock chat announcement. Without this addon, the native Tensura lock is used.

Purple (Majin) and red (Chaos) alignments: Hero Blessing cannot be obtained or used and grants no Hero Egg. Current alignment is checked after reincarnation. After collecting the other 34 martial blessings, Martial Blessing cannot be activated and consumes nothing. While Majin- or Chaos-aligned, eating 10 Dragon Essences does not unlock Sword Saint Blessing or grant a Dragon Sword; saved unlocks do not restore the blessing or issue pending gifts.

Reincarnation reset: character or race reincarnation clears collected world, martial and hidden Sword Saint blessings, and removes Dragon Swords and scabbards. Consume ten fresh Dragon Essences and meet the unlock requirements to receive the sword again. A paid, locked ultimate skill remains, but its blessings must be collected again. Ordinary deaths do not trigger this reset.

Hero Egg limit: the Hero blessing grants at most one egg per player in this save. Losing it, evolution, death, reincarnation, reconnecting and relearning never reset the reward. Existing Hero-blessing owners with an egg or True Hero status are marked as already rewarded. Purple and red alignments cannot obtain the Hero blessing or receive a Dragon Sword through essences, saved unlocks or the World-Blessed Child reward.

chat_heads.modmenu.descriptionTranslation.chat_head:
See who are you chatting with!
This mod adds player heads next to their chat messages.
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.title: Chat Heads
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.offset:
All text will be aligned if enabled
Only applies to "Before Line" rendering
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.explan:
Normally, servers tell us who sent a message,
i.e. the sender's UUID. However, many servers do not.
They can even send fake UUIDs. In these cases we need to use
a heuristic, i.e. we guess by the message content.
This heuristic is not perfect, so it might mismatch heads.
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.render:
Where to render the chat heads

Note: "Before Name" may be incompatible with certain mods.
For Caxton and Modern UI, "Before Line" will automatically be used.
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.sender:
For most servers "UUID and heuristic" works fine.
If the server sends fake UUIDs, "Heuristic only"
has to be used.
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.smartH:
Turn off heuristics if the server is known to send UUIDs.
(Applies to the "UUID and heuristic" sender detection)
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.handle:
Whether heads can be added to "pure" server messages.
Note that many servers (e.g. running the FreedomChat plugin)
turn player messages into server messages!
Only disable this option if you know what you are doing!
chat_heads.text.autoconfig.chat_heads.option.nameAl:
Some servers allow setting nicknames which can't automatically be matched.
Here you can manually match those nicknames to their profile name, like:
nickname -> profilename

Open Cloth Config page on Modrinth

entityculling.text.entityculling.title: EntityCulling
entityculling.text.entityculling.tab.tick_culling.tool: Entities selected in this tab will not have their tick method optimized when culled. This can be useful for entities that need to tick for certain functionality, such as Boats.
entityculling.text.entityculling.tab.entity_culling.to: Entities selected in this tab will not be culled at all. This is mainly needed for client-side entities or entities that need to be rendered regardless of their visibility.
entityculling.text.entityculling.tab.block_entity_cull: Block entities selected in this tab will not be culled at all. This is mainly needed for block entities that need to be rendered regardless of their visibility.
entityculling.text.entityculling.renderNametagsThrough: When turned off, culled entities will not have their nametags rendered through walls.
entityculling.text.entityculling.tickCulling.tooltip: When turned on, entities that are culled will not tick. This can improve performance in some cases, but may cause issues with certain mods. Consider the finer control options in the other tab.
entityculling.text.entityculling.disableF3.tooltip: When turned on, the F3 debug info will not show culling information.
entityculling.text.entityculling.skipEntityCulling.too: When turned on, culling of entities will be skipped entirely. This can be useful for debugging or when you want to disable culling temporarily.
entityculling.text.entityculling.skipBlockEntityCullin: When turned on, culling of block entities will be skipped entirely. This can be useful for debugging or when you want to disable culling temporarily.
entityculling.text.entityculling.blockEntityFrustumCul: When turned on, block entity state extraction will be culled based on the camera's view frustum. This can improve performance in case your modloader/another mod doesn't do this already.
entityculling.text.entityculling.forceDisplayCulling.t: When turned on, display entities without a bounding box will get assigned a default bounding box for culling purposes. This can improve performance for maps/servers that do not configure their display entities correctly, but can cause visual issues.
entityculling.text.entityculling.solidLeaves.tooltip: When turned on, leaves will be treated as solid for culling purposes. This can improve performance in forests, but also cause visual issues. Useful when setting 'See-Through Leaves' to Off, or using a bushy leaves resource pack.

eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.seeking_eye: A magical eye that can be used to locate the ruins where the powerful creatures live. You need to hold a locator item too if you wish to find a specific structure.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.orb_of_prophecy:
A mysterious orb that knows all.
It can be used on the portal frame to open the portal.
Beside from this, you can access all of your crests and cast spells with them.
To cast a spell, first check the requirements of the spell you want to cast and make sure you have one of the mana crystals that can be accepted.
Then, hold the orb and switch to that spell you want to cast.
Lastly, you're ready to use the orb to cast the spell.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.accessories.title: Accessories
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.accessories:
Accessories are items that can be combined with equipments to grant unique properties. Each accessory can only be combined with a specific type of equipment.
The number of accessories an equipment can hold depends on the number of accessory slots it possesses. You can combine or separate accessories from equipment just as you would place or remove items from a bundle. Additionally, combining can be done directly through crafting. When an item's durability is depleted, all combined accessories will be lost.
Accessories may be obtained from mobs or chests. Additionally, some accessories have unique acquisition methods.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.accessories.butte: Throw any accessory into the Ether
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.starlight_golem:
Mechanical creations built by the ancient Starlighters to do the bidding of the mechanical giants used to defend against the doom, once possessing heavy armor and unparalleled strength.
To this day, no intact golems exist.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.starlight_golem.d:
Under normal circumstances, its armor is difficult to penetrate.
However, when it stops attacking and begins to absorb energy, its weakness becomes apparent.
Simply extinguishing all the energy blocks it relies on will temporarily deactivate its armor.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.starlight_golem.s: As an imperfect being, it does not move, which significantly lowers the difficulty of fighting it.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.freeze:
In ancient times, they had been the embodiment of the frozen magic of this dimension. The discovery of the Freeze provided a major opportunity for the ancient Starlighters when they were building that mechanical giant and realized that the exothermic heat of the machine was too intense but could not be solved due to technical problems.
The Freeze were modified and eventually used successfully for cooling and defense against intruding enemies, and the magical ice ball they once shot were compressed and sealed in tubes.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.freeze.attack: You can defend yourself against their intensive attacks using cold-proof armor.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.permafrost:
Following the Starlighters' successful conversion of Freezes into cooling units, they soon realized the latent magical energy within these constructs far exceeded their initial projections. By fusing and augmenting multiple Freezes, they forged the ultimate thermal regulator: the Permafrost.
If the Freeze is a mere network of cooling vents, then the Permafrost is a surging pump of liquid nitrogen. As the definitive evolution of its predecessor, it retains the primal instincts of the Freeze while wielding absolute dominion over frost.
Long after the civilization crumbled into dust, this machine remains among the ruins, mechanically executing its final directive: to bring the world to absolute zero.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.energy_transmitte:
The Energy Transmitter is a redstone device capable of transmitting redstone signal over long distances.
To use it, first interact with the emitter end, then with the receiver end to establish a connection between the two. Once linked, the Energy Transmitter will emit a beam of light between the emitter and receiver while active.
The emitter collects redstone signal from the block it is attached to and transmits them wirelessly, while the receiver passes the received signal to the block it is attached to.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.accumulator:
The Accumulator is a redstone device that can receive redstone signal from one direction and output it in all other directions.
Among its six faces, the one marked with a red dot is the input face, while all other faces are output faces. As the input signal strengthens, the color of the Accumulator gradually shifts from gray to blue.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.lunar_monstrosity: A plant infused with the power of the moon's radiance by an ancient civilization, used to devour the souls of prisoners held in the labyrinth.

Normally, its resilient epidermis significantly reduces all incoming damage.
However, when ignited or stunned, it loses this damage reduction ability.
As a plant, it remains immobile most of the time, but will occasionally burrow underground to pursue its prey.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.tangled:
They are the remains of criminals imprisoned in the garden, whose life-force was not entirely consumed by the monstrosity, but overflowed outward to form a vegetative shell when their bodies were destroyed, a process considerably more painful than the devouring of their souls, a windfall which the ancient inhabitants were well pleased with, and which, as a matter of course, left the remains of these prisoners in the Labyrinth.
As their carapaces are broken, the souls within, overloaded by suffering, are released.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.meteor_shower: Meteor showers sometimes occur here. During the meteor shower, countless meteors streak across the night sky, creating a beautiful sight. But there is also danger in the beauty, be careful not to get hit by the large meteorites. After dodging them, you can find some ores at the landing spot. Creteors may spawn after the large meteorites land, you can kill them to get their hide. You can also build an Aethersent Golem to prevent meteors from destroying your home, or use Aetherstrike Rockets to cause meteor showers manually.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.thirst_walker:
They are the last descendants of ancient civilizations that were attacked by Gleeches. Their bodies were drained and then infected by starlight crystals. They are now as hungry as Gleeches for sustenance in this desert.
The unique structure of their teeth seems to allow them to store nutrients to increase their sharpness, and this holds true even after the teeth have left the Thirst Walker's body.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.dagger_of_hunger:
A weapon crafted using the teeth of Thirst Walkers, the materials used to make it allow it to absorb nutrients to increase its sharpness.
It seems to retain activity and a primal need for food, so much so that he may act out and betray its master in cases of extreme hunger.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.crystalborn_catal:
A machine that uses the teeth of Thirst Walkers as its core material, inheriting the Thirst Walker's greed.
Upon receiving a redstone signal, it can use the crystals in it to infest nearby environments and collect the resources contained therein.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.stranghoul:
These bizarre humanoid creatures seem to have started popping up after that disaster. No one knows where they came from, and for some reason they are especially afraid of silver weapons.
While their habits are rather feral, they apparently have some intelligence and possess a tendency to create civilizations.
Their thin bodies make them more inclined to scavenging, but they will not turn away from dying people in their choice of food. They are fascinated by high-level rotten foods such as Pungency Stews, and because of this they will help anyone who gives it high-level rotten food for a certain amount of time.
They use Malarite to barter for items, so perhaps this could be used to obtain some valuable items from them?
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.pungency_fruit:
A fruit found everywhere in the Dark Swamp that tastes somewhat like garlic, it gives off an odor that makes people weep, which allows it to be made into a weapon as well.
A stew made of it and rotten flesh can rid you of hunger effect, but such food doesn't seem to be very tasty.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.silver_pungency_f: A precious food made from Pungency Fruit and Deepsilver Ingots that still retains the flavor of Pungency Fruits. It paralyzes your nerves, causing your body to temporarily ignore most damage, but all damage is still returned after a period of time.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.seeds_launcher:
This unique weapon can shoot seeds of any type at high speed, it is made primarily from Pungency Fruits, but the exact method of production is unknown, so the only way to obtain it is to barter with their makers.
The weapon can be enchanted, and when enchanted it can shoot seeds with unique properties.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.drying_rack:
Stranghouls use it to dry rotten flesh into leather for their armor.
It can be placed over a campfire, at which point the rotten flesh can be placed to obtain Rotten Flesh Jerky, which is tastier but harder to chew than rotten flesh.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.shimmer_lacewing: An insect that flits around shimmer river and dark swamp with four pairs of glowing blue or purple wings. Their presence is neither threatening nor useful to other creatures. When the Starlight civilization still existed, this was a small creature loved by children.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.twilight_gaze: Twilight Gaze are known for their glowing purple eyes - in the Abyss, where they originate from, these eyes help them see their surroundings in total darkness. They love the environment of the Abyss, and will attempt to return to it if they stray too far from it. This fish will not actively attack humans, but if you harm them, the Twilight Gaze will not hesitate to fight back.
eternal_starlight.book.eternal_starlight.nocturnal_millet:
Nocturnal Millet is a crop native to the Starlight Dimension, whose seeds are hidden within Thioquartz at the banks of the Ether River.
Nocturnal Millet seeds can be sown on dirt, farmland, or Dusted Gravel. Once the stalks have grown, the tops will naturally produce panicles.
When the panicles are plump and ripe, interacting with them will grant Nocturnal Millet. The stalks will remain after harvesting, but there is also a small probability that they will wither. Withered Nocturnal Millet will continuously destroy other types of crops nearby. If a stalk loses its vitality, applying bone meal can revive it.
If Nocturnal Millet is planted on Dusted Gravel and bone meal is applied to the stalk, the entire plant will enter a state of forgotten. Panicles in this state no longer produce ordinary Nocturnal Millet, but instead condense into Forgotten Nocturnal Millet. Plants in the forgotten state will seize the life force of other types of crops nearby to accelerate their own maturation. These types of panicles are exceptionally tough and can only be obtained by interacting with them. Destroying them with brute force will yield nothing.

fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.copy_file.desc:
This action copies a file or folder in the game directory, which starts at the root of the Minecraft instance directory. This action is limited to work only inside the game directory for safety reasons.

It is also possible to access the default '.minecraft' directory with this action. For that, just start paths with the '.minecraft/' prefix.

Append '*' to the end of the source path to copy every file directly inside that folder. This wildcard ignores sub-directories and requires the destination to be a directory.

It is also possible to access the default '.minecraft' directory with this action. For that, just start paths with the '.minecraft/' prefix.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.delete_file.desc:

It is also possible to access the default '.minecraft' directory with this action. For that, just start paths with the '.minecraft/' prefix.

Append '*' to the end of the target path to delete every file directly inside that folder. This wildcard ignores sub-directories and leaves the folder itself intact.

This action renames a file or folder in the game directory, which starts at the root of the Minecraft instance directory. This action is limited to work only inside the game directory for safety reasons.

It is also possible to access the default '.minecraft' directory with this action. For that, just start paths with the '.minecraft/' prefix.

Renaming a folder keeps its contents intact while updating its name.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.reset_element_animator: Resets the selected Element Animator and restarts its animation playback for all linked targets.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.screens.build_screen.e:

fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.screens.move_action_do:
Moves the selected entry down in the
list, so it gets executed later.
This is more precise than using
drag-&-drop to move entries.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.screens.move_action_up:
Moves the selected entry up in the
list, so it gets executed earlier.
This is more precise than using
drag-&-drop to move entries.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.script_editor.cancel_w:
Are you sure?

Do you really want to cancel the script editing?

§xThis will undo everything you've done in here!
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.select_file.desc:
This action opens a native file selection dialog so you can pick a file from anywhere on your computer.
When a file is selected it gets copied to the configured target path inside the Minecraft instance directory (or the default '.minecraft' directory when the prefix is used).

FancyMenu also fires a listener with the selection result so you can trigger follow-up actions when the file was copied, the dialog was cancelled, or an error occurred.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.select_file.edit.exten:
Extensions that should be selectable in the file dialog.

Separate multiple entries with ',' or ';'.

Use values like 'png', 'jpg' or custom patterns such as '*.zip'.

Leave empty to allow every file.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.select_file.edit.filte:
The label shown in the native file dialog for the custom file filter.

Leave empty to use the default label.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.select_file.edit.overw: Choose whether FancyMenu should replace an existing file at the target path or cancel the action instead.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.select_file.edit.targe:
The destination that the selected file should be copied to.

Starts at the root of the Minecraft instance directory.

Use '.minecraft/' as prefix to target the default .minecraft directory.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.send_http_request.desc:
Sends an HTTP request to a web target with configurable parameters.

This action allows you to send data to REST APIs, webhooks, or any HTTP endpoint.
Supports various authentication methods, custom headers, and different request types.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.send_http_request.edit:
The name of a FancyMenu variable the response should get written to.

§xIt's important to note that this action gets executed asynchronously,
§xso the variable value is not updated yet right after the action got executed.
Store Response as Single-Line in Variable: %s
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.sendmessage.desc: Send a chat message or command.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.show_toast.desc: Displays a configurable toast notification. Supports custom width, icon, background texture, message and duration.

Toast icons look best at 20x20 pixels.

Removes the custom icon and uses an empty icon slot.

fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.toggle_element_animato: Toggles whether the Element Animator plays its animation for linked targets. The state persists across sessions.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.toggle_layout.desc: Toggle a layout (Enable/Disable) by its name.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.update_screen.desc:
Updates the current screen.
This is useful if you need to rebuild its
elements (like images, custom buttons, etc.),
or after changing the GUI scale or other
options that need the screen to get updated.
It's basically the same as resizing the window.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.variables.clearall.des: Clears ALL of FancyMenu's stored variables.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.variables.set.desc:
Store text content in a variable to use it
in placeholders, requirements and more.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.video.background.toggl:
Toggles the paused state of a Video menu background by its identifier.

To get the identifier of a background, right-click the
editor background and click on 'Copy Background Identifier'.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.video.set_video_backgr:
Sets the volume of a Video menu background by its identifier.
The volume has to be a valid decimal between 0.0 (0%%) and 1.0 (100%%).

To get the identifier of a background, right-click the
editor background and click on 'Copy Background Identifier'.
Video Background Identifier + Volume [ Separated by : ]
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.video.set_video_elemen:
Sets the volume of a Video element.
The volume has to be a valid decimal between 0.0 (0%%) and 1.0 (100%%).
Video Element Identifier + Volume [ Separated by : ]
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.video.toggle_paused_st: Toggles the paused state of a Video element.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.write_file.desc:
This action writes content to a file in the game directory, which starts at the root of the Minecraft instance directory. If the file doesn't exist, it will be created. This action is limited to work only inside the game directory for safety reasons.

It is also possible to access the default '.minecraft' directory with this action. For that, just start paths with the '.minecraft/' prefix.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.write_file.edit.conten:
The content to write to the file.
Use '\n' to represent line breaks. Click the edit button for multi-line editing.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.write_file.edit.mode.d: Choose whether to override the entire file content or append to the existing content.
fancymenu.fancymenu.actions.write_file.edit.target:
The path to the file to write to.
Starts at the root of the Minecraft instance directory.
Use '.minecraft/' prefix to access the default .minecraft directory.
fancymenu.fancymenu.backgrounds.color.desc:
A simple color background.

This type is PART OF THE BASE MOD, unlike the other similar type you might see in the types list.
fancymenu.fancymenu.backgrounds.image.configure.in:
When ENABLED, the parallax effect will move in the SAME direction
as the mouse, otherwise it moves in the opposite direction.
fancymenu.fancymenu.backgrounds.image.configure.no: §xYou need to choose an image or set an image URL first!
fancymenu.fancymenu.backgrounds.image.configure.pa:
The intensity of the parallax effect.

fancymenu.fancymenu.backgrounds.image.desc:
Well, it's an image.
Works with JPEG, PNG, APNG, GIF and FMA (FancyMenu Animation).
Supports local and web images.

fancymenu.fancymenu.backgrounds.image.type.web.fal:
Set an (optional) fallback image that gets
displayed in case the main image fails to load.
fancymenu.fancymenu.backgrounds.panorama.desc:
A moving panorama cube.
Similar to the Title Screen background.
See docs.fancymenu.net for details.
fancymenu.fancymenu.backgrounds.slideshow.desc:
An image slideshow.
See docs.fancymenu.net for details.
fancymenu.fancymenu.backgrounds.video_mcef.configu: §xYou need to choose a video first!
fancymenu.fancymenu.backgrounds.video_mcef.desc:
Plays a video file as menu background.
§xThis background needs the MCEF mod to work!

fancymenu.fancymenu.customization.scroll_lists.des:
Some screens have headers and footers.
For the most part these screens are
scrollable screens like the Singleplayer Screen,
but also some newer screens like the new
Create World Screen has a header for its tabs.
fancymenu.fancymenu.editor.anchor_overlay.change_a:
If the anchor of elements should get changed when
hovering over anchor areas (the rectangles in all edges).

You need to drag elements to change their anchors on hover.

If the anchor of elements should get changed to the
"Other Element" anchor when hovering over other elements.

You need to drag elements to change their anchors on hover.

How long you need to hover an anchor area/element
to change the anchor point of an element.
fancymenu.fancymenu.editor.anchor_overlay.invert_c:
Inverts the colors of what's behind the overlay,
so the overlay is always visible.

Enabling this disables custom colors and opacity.
fancymenu.fancymenu.editor.auto_scaling.disable_fo:
§xYou need to disable §lauto-scaling §r§xfirst
§xbefore editing the forced GUI scale.

If Vanilla's background blur should get
applied to the custom background.

If the dark overlay rendered by Vanilla Minecraft
should be visible on custom backgrounds.
fancymenu.fancymenu.editor.background_options.copy:
This will copy the identifier of the
current menu background to the clipboard.

The background identifier is used by actions, placeholders
and similar stuff to communicate with the background instance.
fancymenu.fancymenu.editor.buddy.enable.desc:
If a cute little pet creature should
walk around at the bottom of the editor screen.
fancymenu.fancymenu.editor.close_audio.desc: Play an audio when closing the screen.
fancymenu.fancymenu.editor.layout.index.desc:
The layout index is useful when you have
multiple layouts active for the same screen.
If these layouts need to get loaded
in a specific order, use the layout index.
The bigger the index, the later the layout
gets loaded, which means it is ON TOP OF
layouts with a smaller index.

For example: A layout with index 1 will
be under a layout with index 2.
fancymenu.fancymenu.editor.object.movedown.desc:
Moves the element one layer down.

§x§lIMPORTANT:
Selected elements are always on top,
so you will not see the change
until you deselect the element.
fancymenu.fancymenu.editor.object.moveup.desc:
Moves the element one layer up.

§x§lIMPORTANT:
Selected elements are always on top,
so you will not see the change
until you deselect the element.
fancymenu.fancymenu.editor.open_audio.desc: Play an audio when opening the screen.
fancymenu.fancymenu.editor.render_custom_behind_va:
If all non-vanilla elements should
get rendered behind vanilla elements.

Since you can't change the order
of vanilla elements, this is the only
way to have some kind of control over it.

An error happened while trying to save the layout!

If elements should show controls for tilting them.
You can also set their vertical/horizontal tilt in their right-click menu.
fancymenu.fancymenu.editor.settings.enable_rotatio:
If elements should show controls for rotating them.
You can also set their rotation in their right-click menu.
fancymenu.fancymenu.editor.text_editor.single_line:
The target needs a single-line text, which means all lines will
get merged into one line and all leading spaces of all lines
except the very first line will get removed in the actual
output text for the target.
fancymenu.fancymenu.editor.warning.unsaved:
Are you sure?

All unsaved changes for the current layout will get lost!
fancymenu.fancymenu.element.auto_sizing.desc:
Auto-sizing will try to adjust the element's size
based on the screen size, so it's never too big or
too small for the current screen size.

It is not recommended to use this when
§lauto-scaling §ris enabled in the layout.

fancymenu.fancymenu.element.elements.splash_text.d:
A splash text like the bouncing
text in the Title screen.
fancymenu.fancymenu.element.fading.error.negative_:
Fading speed needs to be a positive and
valid floating point value (bigger than 0.0).
fancymenu.fancymenu.element.fading.fade_out.desc:
Fade-Out will NOT fade-out elements before opening a new menu!
It is meant to be used when elements change
their visibility via loading requirements.
fancymenu.fancymenu.element.general.pick_element.d:
List will all elements at the position
of the mouse cursor when
you opened this context menu.

Useful for when you need to
select an element that's behind
another one.

Enabling this allows you to use placeholders in the element's
rotation degrees value, but it will also disable rotation grabbers.
fancymenu.fancymenu.element.rotation.degrees.desc:
Set the rotation angle in degrees for this element.
Positive values rotate clockwise.

This is the same as using the grabbers,
but more precise for full control.
fancymenu.fancymenu.element.sticky_anchor.desc:
In this mode, the element's position will get calculated
in a different way than normal.

This mode makes the element always keep the exact same distance
to its anchor, no matter the current size of the element.
This means the size of the element can dynamically change
without it moving away or getting closer to its anchor.
While this can be useful in some situations, there
are also cases where this behaviour is not optimal.

§xThis has NO EFFECT when using another element as anchor!
fancymenu.fancymenu.element.sticky_anchor.desc.dis: §xYou need to disable 'Stay on Screen' first to use this!
fancymenu.fancymenu.element.tilt.horizontal.advanc:
Enabling this allows you to use placeholders in the element's
horizontal tilt degrees value, but it will also disable tilt grabbers.
fancymenu.fancymenu.element.tilt.horizontal.degree:
Set the horizontal tilt angle in degrees for this element.
Positive values tilt the right side away from the viewer.
Range: -60 to 60 degrees.

This is the same as using the grabbers,
but more precise for full control.
fancymenu.fancymenu.element.tilt.vertical.advanced:
Enabling this allows you to use placeholders in the element's
vertical tilt degrees value, but it will also disable tilt grabbers.
Set the vertical tilt angle in degrees for this element.
Positive values tilt the top away from the viewer.
Range: -60 to 60 degrees.

This is the same as using the grabbers,
but more precise for full control.

Disabling Vanilla Music in Screens

You can disable the music that plays in screens
in FancyMenu's menu bar at the top of every screen,

or disabled (not clickable and greyed out).
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.button.manage_actions:
Manage the actions this button
should execute when clicked.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.button.template_setti:
When you enable the template mode for a custom button, it will apply
some of its settings to all other buttons or sliders in the current screen.

Template buttons will be §linvisible§r outside the editor.

When you set the template to share settings with sliders, the
settings for the button textures will change to slider texture settings.

fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.button.tooltip.desc:
Tooltip to display when the widget is getting hovered.
If you need more control over the tooltip's design, use a dedicated Tooltip element.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.buttons.buttonbackgro:
The highlighted background is used
when focusing the slider by using the
arrow/tab key navigation in screens.

A clickable checkbox that can execute actions when toggled.

Use the '$$value' placeholder in its actions and loading requirements

Actions will be executed when the checkbox is toggled.

You can use the '$$value' placeholder in actions

Copy the ID of this element, to use

A custom cursor that gets show

which means users can "grab" parts of layouts with
the mouse cursor and move them around.

If the drag offset should be persistent

The 'game session' ends when restarting the game.

out of the visible screen area
when resizing the window or changing
the GUI scale.

fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.in_editor_color.desc: Set a custom in-editor color to help with organization.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.in_editor_display_nam:
The in-editor display name helps with organization.
It is shown in the layers widget and when
you pick an element using the right-click menu.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.input_field.desc:
A text input field.

Can be used to set variable
values by user input.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.input_field.editor.se:
Set the type of this text field.

The type defines what characters
the user can use in the field.

For example:
If the field is
set to "Only Numbers", the
user will only be able to
type numbers into the field.

An item like a sword, apple or grass block.
For the extra bit of battle pass menu flair!
