fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.item.name: Set Item Name
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.item.nbt.desc:
This allows you to set custom NBT data to the item.
It is basically the part the /give command that follows
after the item name in curly brackets {}.

§lFull example command:
/give @a netherite_sword{display:{Name:'["",{"text":"Kinabra","italic":false}]'}}

§lSet this as value for NBT:
{display:{Name:'["",{"text":"Kinabra","italic":false}]'}}

There are lots of Give Command Generators available online,
so just ask Google about it and you will find something.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.multiselect.loading_r:
§x§lOverride Loading Requirements?

The selected elements have different loading requirements!
All of their loading requirements will get §xoverridden§r!

Continue?
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.music_controller.desc:
Element to control Vanilla music that plays in menus.

This element can't control music that plays
in worlds while no screen is open.
It is only to control music while a screen is open.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.music_controller.play:
This type of music plays in menus when NO world is loaded,
like in the Title screen for example.

This type of music plays in menus when a world is loaded.
It's basically the normal world music that
keeps playing in menus that don't pause the game,
like the inventory in SP and every menu in MP.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.parallax.desc:
If a parallax effect should get added to the element's position.

The parallax effect only works while not in the editor!
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.parallax.intensity.de:
The intensity of the parallax effect.
This should be a value between 0.0 (no movement) and 1.0 (maximum movement).
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.parallax.intensity.in: This needs to be a value between 0.0 (no movement) and 1.0 (maximum movement)!
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.parallax.invert.desc:
When ENABLED, the element will move WITH the mouse.
When disabled, it will move in the opposite direction of the mouse.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.player_entity.baby.de: If the player should be a baby.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.player_entity.body_mo: If the player's pose should be animated.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.player_entity.cape.au:
§xYou can't do this while
§x"Auto Cape" is enabled.

Tries to automatically pick
the cape based on the
element's player name.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.player_entity.copy_cl:
§xYou can't do this while
§x"Copy Client Player" is enabled.

Automatically make the entity look
like the client player.

Copies the name, skin and cape.
If the player should have a parrot
on their shoulder.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.player_entity.parrot_:
If the player's shoulder parrot
should be on the left shoulder.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.player_entity.scale.d:
Set the entity's scale.

Default scale is 30.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.player_entity.set_pla:
Set the player's name.

You can use any name here,
it doesn't have to be an
existing user.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.player_entity.show_na: If the player name should be visible.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.player_entity.skin.au:
§xYou can't do this while
§x"Auto Skin" is enabled.

Tries to automatically pick
the skin based on the
element's player name.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.player_entity.slim.de: If the skin should be slim.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.progress_bar.backgrou:
The background color is used in case there
is no background texture defined for the element.

If a background texture is defined,
the background color will be ignored.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.progress_bar.bar_colo:
The bar color is used in case there
is no bar texture defined for the element.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.progress_bar.bar_text:
If a bar texture is defined,
the bar color will be ignored.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.progress_bar.desc:
A customizable progress bar which
supports setting a custom text source
for the current progress.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.progress_bar.progress:
Use the current progress of this progress bar
as anchor origin position when using
this element as Element anchor.
That way other elements move with
the progress of the progress bar.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.progress_bar.source.d:
The progress source is the current progress
as percentage number between 0 and 100 or
floating point number between 0.0 and 1.0,
depending on the progress value mode.
The source supports placeholders, so there's
nothing that holds you from getting creative!
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.shape.color.desc:
Set the HEX color of the shape.
Supports alpha channel (RGBA)!
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.shape.rectangle.desc:
A rectangular shape.
Supports custom HEX RGBA colors.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.slider.desc:
A slider button.

Can be used to set variable
values by user input.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.slider.editor.list.se:
Set text values for the list slider.
§xOne value per text line.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.slider.editor.set_lab:
The prefix of the slider label.

The base of the slider label
is always the current value.

The suffix of the slider label.

The base of the slider label
is always the current value.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.slider.editor.set_var:
Link this slider to a variable.
Use the variable name.

The variable can be a new
or an existing variable.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.slider.editor.type.de:
Set the type of this slider.

When using the list type,
you can set a list of
text values and switch through
them when moving the slider.

The range type allows you
to switch through a range
of numbers.
You can set a min and a max value
when using this type.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.slider.v2.desc:
A slider button that can be used to
set variable values and more.
Executes actions on value change.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.slider.v2.label: Slider Label
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.slider.v2.label.desc:
The label of the slider.

To show the current slider value as part
of the label, use the §x$$value§r placeholder.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.slider.v2.manage_acti:
The actions this slider will execute
when its value gets changed.

You can get the slider's current value
by using the §x$$value§r placeholder in
action values or requirement values.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.slider.v2.pre_selecte:
This is the value that will be pre-selected
when the slider gets created, so make
sure this points to a variable or something
the slider sets.
If the slider sets a Minecraft option,
point this to the option value.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.slider.v2.type.list.s:
Set text values for the list slider.
One value per text line.
At least two values (lines) needed.
The decimal place to round the value to.
One (1) decimal place is one place
after the decimal point.

To not round the value, set it to §x-1§r.
The maximum value the range slider can reach.
The minimum value the range slider can reach.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.slideshow.desc:
A slideshow.
To learn more about slideshows,
visit docs.fancymenu.net!
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.splash.refresh.desc:
Pick a new splash everytime the screen
is getting reloaded or opened.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.text.base_color.desc:
Set the base color for the text.
Use HEX color codes.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.text.desc:
Add a text to render in
your layout.

Choose between local and online
sources for the text content.
The color used for every second row when 'Alternate Row Colors' is enabled.

The padding inside table cells.
Higher values create more space between content and cell borders.
Customize the appearance of Markdown tables.

The margin around tables.
Adds space above and below each table.
If the element should parse Markdown formatting codes.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.text.scroll_grabber_c:
The color of the grabber.
Use HEX color codes.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.text.set_source.direc: Set direct text content to render.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.text.set_source.local: Use a TXT file as content.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.text.set_source.web.d:
Get the plain web text content
of a website as text.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.text.source_mode.desc:
§zDirect Text:
Directly input a text to render.

§zLocal Source:
Use a TXT file as source.

§zWeb Source:
Use the plain text content
of a website as source.

§xChanging the source mode will
§xreset the text content!

§xYou can undo source changing
§xby pressing §lCTRL + Z§r§x!
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.text.text_border.desc:
The text border is the space
between the text and the left
and right side of the element.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.text.v2.desc:
Renders a text body.
It support multi-line text, markdown
and has many options to customize
the look and feel of the element
and its content.
If this element should be interactable.
Disable this if you experience problems with
clicking elements above or under this text element.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.text.v2.source_mode.d:
§lDirect: §rInput text content via text editor.
§lResource: §rSet a source file to get the text content from.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.ticker.async.desc:
If the ticker should run in
a separate thread (asynchronous).
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.ticker.desc:
Allows you to execute actions
every tick.

Supports asynchronous ticking
and tick delays.

Can be set to tick only once
every time you open the screen.

§xThis element is only visible
§xin the editor.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.ticker.manage_actions:
Manage the actions this ticker
should execute.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.ticker.tick_delay.des: Set the delay between ticks in milliseconds.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.ticker.tick_mode.desc:
§lNormal: §rTicker ticks every tick.

§lSession: §rTicker ticks once per game session.

§lOn Load Screen: §rTicker ticks once every time you load the screen.
Keep in mind that screens also get
reloaded when resizing the game window.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.tooltip.background_te:
Set a custom background texture.
Uses nine-slicing to resize the texture for the current tooltip size.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.tooltip.desc:
Renders a tooltip at a specific position or the mouse position.
Has full Markdown support, similar to Text elements.
Control its visibility with loading requirements.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.tooltip.mouse_followi: If the tooltip should follow the mouse when outside the editor.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.tooltip.nine_slice.de:
Here you can set settings related to the
nine-slicing logic of the custom tooltip background.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.vanilla_button.copy_l:
The widget locator points to a
specific widget in a specific screen.

§zThe widget locator is used for actions like 'Mimic Button'.
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.vanilla_button.copyri: §cYou can't move the Copyright button out-of-screen!
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.vanilla_button.draggi: §cTo move this element, change its anchor point first!
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.video_mcef.desc:
A video player powered by MCEF.
§xThis element needs the MCEF mod to work!
fancymenu.fancymenu.elements.widgets.generic.navig:
If the user should be able to focus this
widget by using the Tab/Arrow key navigation.
fancymenu.fancymenu.fancymenu.editor.layoutoptions:
Add this layout to a group to randomly
pick one of the group's layouts
when opening the screen.

Can be used to randomize
backgrounds and other elements.

If layouts of this random group
should be random everytime the
screen gets opened or if only one layout
should be picked the first time
the screen gets opened.

Set the group of this layout.
One layout per group gets picked
when opening the screen.
fancymenu.fancymenu.game_intro.desc:
Plays an animated image or video before the
Title Screen is shown for the first time.
§xYou can't edit the title of Custom GUIs.
§xTo edit Custom GUI titles, edit the GUI in
§xthe 'Manage Custom GUIs' screen.

Allows you to override the text at the
top of some screens with a custom one.

§xThis option might not work for some screens.

§xThe title needs to be at least 1 character long.
§xSpaces count as characters.
fancymenu.fancymenu.helper.editor.layoutoptions.ba:
Set an image, animation, panorama
or slideshow as background.
fancymenu.fancymenu.helper.editor.layoutoptions.un:
Add a screen to the blacklist
by its §lscreen identifier§r.

§xScreens on the blacklist will
§xbe ignored by the layout, so
§xthe customizations don't get
§xapplied to this screen.

§xYou can get the identifier
§xof a screen by clicking on
§x§lCustomization -> Copy Identifier of Current Screen
§r§xwhile in the screen.

Add a screen to the whitelist
by its §lscreen identifier§r.

§xIf there are screens on the
§xwhitelist, only these screens
§xwill be customized by the layout.
§xAll other screens will be ignored!

§xYou can get the identifier
§xof a screen by clicking on
§x§lCustomization -> Copy Identifier of Current Screen
§r§xwhile in the screen.

§x§lAre you sure?

Do you really want to §xclear §rthe blacklist?

§x§lAre you sure?

Do you really want to §xclear §rthe whitelist?

§x§lAre you sure?

Do you really want to §xremove §rthis identifier?

§x§lAre you sure?

Do you really want to §xremove §rthis identifier?
fancymenu.fancymenu.helper.editor.properties.autos: Here you can set the base window size of your layout.
This should be the size your layout was designed for.
If you made it in the current window size, just leave the values like they are.

Let FancyMenu handle the scale
 of the screen, so your layout works
for every scale and resolution.

To do this, resize the window
until everything looks good and
elements are not too far apart
from each other and click on
this button.

§xThis will make text look blurry
§xat some scales.
§xThis can't be fixed and the best
§xworkaround is to use images
§xwith background as text elements.

You need to set a §lforced GUI scale
before you can use auto-scaling!

It's recommended to use 2 as
forced GUI scale.

§xTo set a forced GUI scale,
§xright-click the editor background
§xand click on §lForce GUI Scale§r§x.
fancymenu.fancymenu.helper.editor.properties.scale:
Force a GUI scale for this screen.

§xOnly overrides the scale for the
§xtarget screen, not for all screens!
fancymenu.fancymenu.layout.editor.edit_close_scree: This action script gets executed when closing the screen.
fancymenu.fancymenu.layout.editor.edit_open_screen: This action script gets executed when opening the screen.
fancymenu.fancymenu.layout.manage.delete.confirm:
§x§lDelete Layout?

Do you really want to §xdelete §rthis layout?

You can't undo this!
fancymenu.fancymenu.layout.manage.rename.error.emp:
Unable to rename layout!

The file name has to be at least one character long!
fancymenu.fancymenu.layout.manage.rename.error.fil:
Unable to rename layout!

A layout with the same name already exists!
fancymenu.fancymenu.layout_editor.grid.snapping.de: If elements should snap to the grid lines when being moved.
fancymenu.fancymenu.layout_editor.grid.snapping.st:
Controls how strongly elements snap to grid lines.
Lower values require more precision.
Higher values snap from further away.
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.manage.cancel_warnin:
Are you sure?

Do you really want to cancel?

§xThis will undo everything you've done in here!
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.manage.desc:
Listeners are a very powerful feature that allows you
to execute an action script when specific things happen,
like when a user types on their keyboard, performs a mouse click
or even when things happen in worlds, like when the player dies.

Listeners aren't bound to screens, to they constantly
listen for events, even if there isn't a screen open at all,
like when playing in a singleplayer world or on a server.
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.manage.rename_tip: Rename listeners by double-clicking their display name.
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.manage.quick_edit_ti: Right-click listeners to quick-edit their actions.
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.manage.delete_warnin:
Are you sure?

Do you really want to §xdelete§r this listener?

§xYou can't undo this!
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_block_broke.desc:
This listener triggers once when the player breaks a block.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$block_key §r= The resource location of the broken block
- §z$$broke_with_item_key §r= The resource location of the item/tool that was used (or EMPTY when nothing was held)
- §z$$block_pos_x §r= The X coordinate of the broken block
- §z$$block_pos_y §r= The Y coordinate of the broken block
- §z$$block_pos_z §r= The Z coordinate of the broken block
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_block_placed.desc:
This listener triggers once when the player places a block.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$block_key §r= The resource location of the placed block
- §z$$block_pos_x §r= The X coordinate of the placed block
- §z$$block_pos_y §r= The Y coordinate of the placed block
- §z$$block_pos_z §r= The Z coordinate of the placed block
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_char_typed: On Keyboard Character Typed in Screen
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_char_typed.desc:
This listener triggers whenever a character is typed in a screen.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$char §r= The typed character
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_chat_message_rece:
Triggers whenever the client displays a normal player chat message.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$chat_message_string §r= Plain text version of the received chat line
- §z$$chat_message_component §r= Full component JSON of the received chat line
- §z$$sender_uuid §r= UUID of the sender (or ERROR if unavailable)
- §z$$sender_name §r= Plain name of the sender (or ERROR if unavailable)
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_chat_message_sent:
Triggers when the local player sends a chat message to the server.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$chat_message_string §r= Plain text version of the sent chat line
- §z$$chat_message_component §r= Full component JSON of the sent chat line
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_close_screen.desc:
Triggers right after a screen got closed.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$screen_identifier §r= Identifier of the screen that was closed
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_damage_taken.desc:
This listener triggers once when the player takes damage.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$damage_amount §r= The amount of health removed by the hit
- §z$$damage_type §r= The resource location of the damage type
- §z$$is_fatal_damage §r= TRUE when the hit reduced the player to zero health
- §z$$damage_source §r= The resource location of the entity that caused the damage or NONE when unavailable
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_death.desc:
Triggers right after the vanilla death screen opens for the local player.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$days_survived §r= In-game days survived (rounded down) since the last death
- §z$$death_reason_string §r= Plain text description of the death reason
- §z$$death_reason_component §r= Full component JSON of the death reason
- §z$$death_pos_x §r= X coordinate where the player died
- §z$$death_pos_y §r= Y coordinate where the player died
- §z$$death_pos_z §r= Z coordinate where the player died
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_dimension_entered:
This listener triggers once when the player enters a new dimension.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$dimension_key §r= The resource location of the entered dimension
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_effect_gained.des:
This listener triggers once when the player gains a status effect.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$effect_key §r= The resource location of the effect that was applied
- §z$$effect_type §r= The effect category (positive, negative, neutral)
- §z$$effect_duration §r= The effect duration in ticks remaining
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_effect_lost.desc:
This listener triggers once when the player loses a status effect.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$effect_key §r= The resource location of the effect that expired
- §z$$effect_type §r= The effect category (positive, negative, neutral)
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_enter_biome.desc:
This listener triggers once when the player enters a new biome.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$biome_key §r= The resource location of the biome the player entered
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_enter_structure.d:
§xRequires FancyMenu on the server.§r

This listener triggers once when the player enters a structure using coarse structure-area detection.

Because it considers the entire structure footprint, it can also fire when a structure is near or below the player (for example, a mineshaft beneath the surface).

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$structure_key §r= The resource location of the structure the player entered
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_enter_structure.h:
§xRequires FancyMenu on the server.§r

This listener triggers once when the player actually steps into a structure's interior.

It uses high precision detection, so it only fires when the player enters the structure's bounding boxes.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$structure_key §r= The resource location of the structure the player entered
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_entity_died.desc:
§xRequires FancyMenu on the server.§r

This listener triggers whenever an entity dies anywhere on the connected server/world (even if the player is far away or in another dimension).

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$entity_key §r= The resource location of the entity type that died
- §z$$distance_to_player §r= The distance from the player to the death position (returns -1 when the entity died in another dimension)
- §z$$death_pos_x §r= The X coordinate where the entity died
- §z$$death_pos_y §r= The Y coordinate where the entity died
- §z$$death_pos_z §r= The Z coordinate where the entity died
- §z$$entity_uuid §r= The UUID of the entity that died
- §z$$dimension_key §r= The dimension the entity died in
- §z$$damage_type §r= The resource location of the damage type that caused the death
- §z$$is_same_dimension_as_player §r= If TRUE, the entity died in the same dimension as the player
- §z$$entity_killed_by_name §r= The plain text name of the killer or NONE when unavailable
- §z$$entity_killed_by_key §r= The resource location of the killer's type (uses minecraft:player for players, NONE when unavailable)
- §z$$entity_killed_by_uuid §r= The UUID of the killer or NONE when unavailable
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_entity_in_sight.d:
This listener triggers once when an entity first becomes visible in the player's field of view (and is not farther away than 200 blocks).

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$entity_key §r= The resource location of the visible entity type
- §z$$distance_to_player §r= The distance from the player's eyes to the entity
- §z$$entity_pos_x §r= The entity's X coordinate
- §z$$entity_pos_y §r= The entity's Y coordinate
- §z$$entity_pos_z §r= The entity's Z coordinate
- §z$$entity_uuid §r= The UUID of the visible entity
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_entity_mounted.de:
This listener triggers once when the player begins riding an entity.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$entity_key §r= The resource location of the mounted entity type
- §z$$entity_pos_x §r= The entity's X coordinate when mounting started
- §z$$entity_pos_y §r= The entity's Y coordinate when mounting started
- §z$$entity_pos_z §r= The entity's Z coordinate when mounting started
- §z$$entity_uuid §r= The UUID of the mounted entity
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_entity_spawned.de:
§xRequires FancyMenu on the server.§r

This listener triggers whenever an entity spawns anywhere on the connected server/world (even if the player is far away or in another dimension).

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$entity_key §r= The resource location of the spawned entity type
- §z$$distance_to_player §r= The distance from the player to the spawn location (returns -1 when the entity spawned in another dimension)
- §z$$entity_pos_x §r= The entity's X coordinate at spawn time
- §z$$entity_pos_y §r= The entity's Y coordinate at spawn time
- §z$$entity_pos_z §r= The entity's Z coordinate at spawn time
- §z$$entity_uuid §r= The UUID of the spawned entity
- §z$$dimension_key §r= The dimension the entity spawned in
- §z$$is_same_dimension_as_player §r= If TRUE, the entity spawned in the same dimension as the player
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_entity_starts_bei: On Entity Starts Being In Sight

This listener triggers once when an entity first becomes visible in the player's field of view (and is not farther away than 200 blocks).

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$entity_key §r= The resource location of the visible entity type
- §z$$distance_to_player §r= The distance from the player's eyes to the entity
- §z$$entity_pos_x §r= The entity's X coordinate
- §z$$entity_pos_y §r= The entity's Y coordinate
- §z$$entity_pos_z §r= The entity's Z coordinate
- §z$$entity_uuid §r= The UUID of the visible entity
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_entity_stops_bein: On Entity Stops Being In Sight

This listener triggers once when an entity that was previously visible in the player's field of view stops being visible (or moves farther away than 200 blocks).

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$entity_key §r= The resource location of the entity type that just left the view
- §z$$distance_to_player §r= The last measured distance from the player's eyes to the entity
- §z$$entity_pos_x §r= The entity's X coordinate
- §z$$entity_pos_y §r= The entity's Y coordinate
- §z$$entity_pos_z §r= The entity's Z coordinate
- §z$$entity_uuid §r= The UUID of the entity that just left the view
This listener triggers once when the player stops riding their current entity.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$entity_key §r= The resource location of the entity that was dismounted
- §z$$entity_pos_x §r= The entity's X coordinate when dismounting
- §z$$entity_pos_y §r= The entity's Y coordinate when dismounting
- §z$$entity_pos_z §r= The entity's Z coordinate when dismounting
- §z$$entity_uuid §r= The UUID of the entity that was dismounted
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_experience_change:
This listener triggers whenever the player's total experience amount changes (gaining or losing XP).

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$new_experience_amount §r= The player's total experience value after the change
- §z$$old_experience_amount §r= The player's total experience value before the change
- §z$$is_level_up §r= TRUE when the change increased the player's level
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_file_downloaded.d:
This listener triggers when a file finishes downloading via the 'Download File to Game Directory' action.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$download_url §r= The URL of the file that got downloaded
- §z$$target_file_path §r= The path the file got saved to
- §z$$download_succeeded §r= If the file download was successful (true/false)
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_file_selected.des:
This listener triggers after the 'Select File' action finishes.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$selected_file_path §r= The absolute path of the chosen file (empty when the dialog was cancelled)
- §z$$target_file_path §r= The resolved path inside the Minecraft instance that received the file
- §z$$selection_succeeded §r= 'true' when the file was copied successfully
- §z$$selection_cancelled §r= 'true' when the dialog was closed without selecting a file
- §z$$failure_reason §r= Error information when the action failed
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_fully_frozen.desc: This listener triggers once when the player becomes fully frozen.
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_interacted_with_b:
This listener triggers once when the player successfully interacts with a block.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$block_key §r= The resource location of the interacted block
- §z$$block_pos_x §r= The X coordinate of the block
- §z$$block_pos_y §r= The Y coordinate of the block
- §z$$block_pos_z §r= The Z coordinate of the block
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_interacted_with_e:
This listener triggers once when the player successfully interacts with an entity.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$entity_key §r= The resource location of the interacted entity type
- §z$$entity_pos_x §r= The entity's X coordinate at the time of interaction
- §z$$entity_pos_y §r= The entity's Y coordinate at the time of interaction
- §z$$entity_pos_z §r= The entity's Z coordinate at the time of interaction
- §z$$entity_uuid §r= The UUID of the interacted entity
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_item_broke.desc:
This listener triggers once when an item in the player's inventory breaks.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$item_key §r= The resource location of the broken item
- §z$$item_type §r= Category of the broken item (tool, armor, other)
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_item_consumed.des:
This listener triggers once when the player finishes consuming an item.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$item_key §r= The resource location of the item that was consumed
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_item_dropped.desc:
This listener triggers once when the player drops an item from their inventory.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$item_key §r= The resource location of the item that was dropped
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_item_picked_up.de:
This listener triggers once when the player picks up an item entity.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$item_key §r= The resource location of the item that was picked up
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_item_used.desc:
This listener triggers once when the player uses an item.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$item_key §r= The resource location of the item that was used
- §z$$used_on_type §r= The interaction context (block, entity, self, none)
- §z$$used_on_entity_key §r= The resource location of the entity type that was targeted, empty when none
- §z$$used_on_block_key §r= The resource location of the block that was targeted, empty when none
- §z$$target_pos_x §r= Target X position when available, otherwise -1
- §z$$target_pos_y §r= Target Y position when available, otherwise -1
- §z$$target_pos_z §r= Target Z position when available, otherwise -1
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_jump.desc: This listener triggers once whenever the local player performs a jump action.
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_key_pressed.desc:
This listener triggers whenever a keyboard key is pressed, which works both while a screen is open and when in-game (in a world/server). The listener keeps firing while the key is held down and the screen continues to receive repeat events.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$key_name §r= The resolved display name of the key
- §z$$key_keycode §r= The GLFW key code
- §z$$key_scancode §r= The GLFW scan code
- §z$$key_modifiers §r= The active modifier bit mask
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_key_released.desc:
This listener triggers whenever a keyboard key is released, which works both while a screen is open and when in-game (in a world/server).

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$key_name §r= The resolved display name of the key
- §z$$key_keycode §r= The GLFW key code
- §z$$key_scancode §r= The GLFW scan code
- §z$$key_modifiers §r= The active modifier bit mask
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_leave_biome.desc:
This listener triggers once when the player leaves their current biome.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$biome_key §r= The resource location of the biome the player just left
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_leave_structure.d:
§xRequires FancyMenu on the server.§r

This listener triggers once when the player leaves their current structure using coarse structure-area detection.

Because it considers the entire structure footprint, it can also fire when a structure is near or below the player (for example, a mineshaft beneath the surface).

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$structure_key §r= The resource location of the structure the player just left
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_leave_structure.h:
§xRequires FancyMenu on the server.§r

This listener triggers once when the player leaves the interior of their current structure.

It uses high precision detection, so it only fires after the player fully exits the structure's bounding boxes.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$structure_key §r= The resource location of the structure the player just left
This listener triggers once when the crosshair starts pointing at a block in the world.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$block_key §r= The resource location of the targeted block
- §z$$distance §r= The distance from the player's eyes to the block hit position
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_mouse_button_clic:
This listener triggers once when a mouse button is pressed, which works both while a screen is open and when in-game (in a world/server).

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$button §r= Which button was pressed (left, right, middle)
- §z$$mouse_pos_x §r= The current mouse X position
- §z$$mouse_pos_y §r= The current mouse Y position
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_mouse_button_rele:
This listener triggers once when a mouse button is released, which works both while a screen is open and when in-game (in a world/server).

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$button §r= Which button was released (left, right, middle)
- §z$$mouse_pos_x §r= The current mouse X position
- §z$$mouse_pos_y §r= The current mouse Y position
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_mouse_moved.desc:
This listener triggers whenever the mouse cursor moves while a screen is open.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$mouse_pos_x §r= The current mouse X position
- §z$$mouse_pos_y §r= The current mouse Y position
- §z$$mouse_move_delta_x §r= The horizontal distance moved since the last event
- §z$$mouse_move_delta_y §r= The vertical distance moved since the last event
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_mouse_scrolled.de:
This listener triggers whenever the mouse wheel is scrolled while a screen is open.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$scroll_delta_y §r= The vertical scroll amount for the event
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_music_track_start:
This listener triggers once when a new music track starts playing.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$track_resource_location §r= The resolved resource location of the audio file that started
- §z$$track_display_name §r= Human-readable track name when available, otherwise UNKNOWN
- §z$$track_artist §r= Reported track artist when available, otherwise UNKNOWN
- §z$$track_duration_ms §r= Track duration expressed in milliseconds (0 when unknown)
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_music_track_stopp:
This listener triggers once when the current music track stops playing (naturally or because it was replaced).

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$track_resource_location §r= The resolved resource location of the audio file that stopped
- §z$$track_display_name §r= Human-readable track name when available, otherwise UNKNOWN
- §z$$track_artist §r= Reported track artist when available, otherwise UNKNOWN
- §z$$track_duration_ms §r= Track duration expressed in milliseconds (0 when unknown)
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_open_screen.desc:
Triggers immediately after a screen becomes active, allowing actions such as "Open Screen or Custom GUI" to override it.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$screen_identifier §r= Identifier of the screen that just opened
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_other_player_died:
Triggers when another player in the current world dies.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$player_name §r= The plain name of the player who died
- §z$$player_uuid §r= The UUID of the player who died
- §z$$death_pos_x §r= X coordinate where the player died
- §z$$death_pos_y §r= Y coordinate where the player died
- §z$$death_pos_z §r= Z coordinate where the player died
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_other_player_join:
Triggers when another player joins the current world or connected server.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$player_name §r= The plain name of the player who joined
- §z$$player_uuid §r= The UUID of the player who joined
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_other_player_left:
Triggers when another player leaves the current world or connected server.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$player_name §r= The plain name of the player who left
- §z$$player_uuid §r= The UUID of the player who left
This listener triggers once whenever the local player's block position changes.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$old_pos_x §r= Previous block X coordinate
- §z$old_pos_y §r= Previous block Y coordinate
- §z$old_pos_z §r= Previous block Z coordinate
- §z$new_pos_x §r= New block X coordinate
- §z$new_pos_y §r= New block Y coordinate
- §z$new_pos_z §r= New block Z coordinate
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_quit_minecraft.de:
This listener triggers once when the Minecraft client begins shutting down.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$timestamp_millis §r= Epoch milliseconds when the quit event fired
- §z$$timestamp_iso §r= ISO-8601 timestamp representing the quit moment
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_server_joined.des:
Triggers after the client finishes joining a multiplayer server.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$server_ip §r= IP address of the server the player joined
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_server_left.desc:
Triggers after the client disconnects from a multiplayer server.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$server_ip §r= IP address of the server the player left
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_start_looking_at_:
This listener triggers once when the crosshair starts pointing at a block in the world.

It only detects blocks within a maximum distance of 20 blocks from the player's eyes.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$block_key §r= The resource location of the targeted block
- §z$$block_pos_x §r= The X coordinate of the targeted block
- §z$$block_pos_y §r= The Y coordinate of the targeted block
- §z$$block_pos_z §r= The Z coordinate of the targeted block
- §z$$distance_to_player §r= The distance from the player's eyes to the block hit position

This listener triggers once when the crosshair starts pointing at an entity.

It only detects entities within a maximum distance of 20 blocks from the player's eyes.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$entity_key §r= The resource location of the targeted entity type
- §z$$distance_to_player §r= The distance from the player's eyes to the entity hit position
- §z$$entity_pos_x §r= The entity's X coordinate
- §z$$entity_pos_y §r= The entity's Y coordinate
- §z$$entity_pos_z §r= The entity's Z coordinate
- §z$$entity_uuid §r= The UUID of the targeted entity
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_start_swimming.de:
This listener triggers once when the player starts swimming.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$fluid_type §r= The resource location of the fluid the player started swimming in
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_start_touching_fl:
This listener triggers once when the player starts touching a fluid.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$fluid_type §r= The resource location of the fluid the player touched
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_started_burning.d: This listener triggers once when the player starts burning.
This listener triggers once when the player begins taking drowning damage.
This listener triggers once when the player starts freezing.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$freezing_intensity §r= The current freezing intensity (0.0 = no freeze, 1.0 = fully frozen)
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_started_running.d: This listener triggers once when the player starts sprinting.
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_stepping_on_block:
This listener triggers once when the player steps onto a block.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$block_key §r= The resource location of the block that was stepped on
- §z$$block_pos_x §r= The X coordinate of the block
- §z$$block_pos_y §r= The Y coordinate of the block
- §z$$block_pos_z §r= The Z coordinate of the block
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_stop_looking_at_b:
This listener triggers once when the crosshair stops pointing at a block and reports information about the block that was previously targeted.

It only reports data for blocks that were within a maximum distance of 20 blocks from the player's eyes.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$block_key §r= The resource location of the block that was targeted
- §z$$block_pos_x §r= The X coordinate of the previously targeted block
- §z$$block_pos_y §r= The Y coordinate of the previously targeted block
- §z$$block_pos_z §r= The Z coordinate of the previously targeted block
- §z$$distance_to_player §r= The last measured distance from the player's eyes to the block hit position
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_stop_looking_at_e:
This listener triggers once when the crosshair stops pointing at an entity and fires with information about the entity that was previously targeted.

It reports data for entities that were within a maximum distance of 20 blocks from the player's eyes.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$entity_key §r= The resource location of the entity type that was targeted
- §z$$distance_to_player §r= The last measured distance from the player's eyes to the entity hit position
- §z$$entity_pos_x §r= The entity's X coordinate
- §z$$entity_pos_y §r= The entity's Y coordinate
- §z$$entity_pos_z §r= The entity's Z coordinate
- §z$$entity_uuid §r= The UUID of the entity that was targeted
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_stop_swimming.des:
This listener triggers once when the player stops swimming.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$fluid_type §r= The resource location of the fluid the player stopped swimming in
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_stop_touching_flu:
This listener triggers once when the player stops touching a fluid.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$fluid_type §r= The resource location of the fluid the player stopped touching
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_stopped_burning.d: This listener triggers once when the player stops burning.
This listener triggers once when the player stops freezing.
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_stopped_running.d: This listener triggers once when the player stops sprinting.
This listener triggers whenever a FancyMenu variable gets updated/set.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$var_name §r= The variable name
- §z$$old_value §r= The old variable value
- §z$$new_value §r= The new variable value
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_weather_changed.d:
This listener triggers once whenever the weather state changes (clear, rain, or thunder).
It will also re-trigger when the local weather changes, which means if it is raining, for example, and you enter a biome that has no rain (desert) or a biome where it is snowing, the listener will re-trigger even though the global weather didn't change.
Entering a building also counts as local weather change while it is raining outside, because well, it doesn't rain inside.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$weather_type §r= The new global weather type (clear, rain, thunder)
- §z$$weather_can_snow §r= TRUE when precipitation at the player renders as snow
- §z$$weather_can_rain §r= TRUE when precipitation at the player renders as rain
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_world_entered.des:
Triggers after a singleplayer world finishes loading and the player regains control.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$world_name §r= Display name of the world
- §z$$world_save_path §r= Absolute path to the world save folder
- §z$$world_difficulty §r= Current game difficulty key
- §z$$world_cheats_allowed §r= TRUE when cheats are enabled
- §z$$world_icon_path §r= Absolute path to the world icon
- §z$$world_is_first_join §r= TRUE when this is the very first visit after creation
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_world_left.desc:
Triggers after a singleplayer world closes and finishes saving.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$world_name §r= Display name of the world
- §z$$world_save_path §r= Absolute path to the world save folder
- §z$$world_difficulty §r= Last known game difficulty key
- §z$$world_cheats_allowed §r= TRUE when cheats were enabled
- §z$$world_icon_path §r= Absolute path to the world icon
fancymenu.fancymenu.listeners.on_world_sound_trigg:
This listener triggers whenever a positional world sound starts playing near the player.

It provides the following variables for its actions and requirements:

- §z$$sound_resource_location §r= The resolved resource location of the sound file that started
- §z$$sound_display_name §r= The localized display name shown in the subtitles overlay when available
- §z$$sound_origin_pos_x §r= The X position of the sound's origin
- §z$$sound_origin_pos_y §r= The Y position of the sound's origin
- §z$$sound_origin_pos_z §r= The Z position of the sound's origin
- §z$$sound_origin_distance_to_player §r= The distance between the player and the sound origin
- §z$$sound_origin_direction_from_player §r= Direction in degrees (0-360) relative to where the player is facing when the sound started

fancymenu.fancymenu.overlay.menu_bar.leave_current:
Force-closes the current screen and brings
you back to the Title Screen.

How fast sub menus should open when

text format via actions, which you can

fancymenu.fancymenu.panorama.choose.no_panorama_se: §xYou need to select a panorama first!
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.absolute_number.d:
Returns the absolute (positive) value of the given number.

fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.absolute_path.des:
Returns the absolute path
of a file/folder.

fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.audio_duration.de:
Returns the total duration of the current track
playing in an Audio element in MM:SS format (e.g. '03:45').
Returns '00:00' if no audio is playing.

Required values:
- element_identifier: The ID of the audio element to get the duration from
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.audio_element_cur:
Gets the filename or display name of the currently playing track in an Audio element.
Returns "---" when no track is playing.
Takes the element identifier of the target Audio element.
Optionally takes display name mappings to show custom names for tracks.
Mapping format: track1.ogg=>Cool Name%%:%%track2.wav=>Another Name
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.audio_element_vol:
Returns the volume of an Audio element
as a value between 0.0 (0%%) and 1.0 (100%%).
Takes the element identifier of the target Audio element.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.audio_playing_sta:
Returns the current playing state of an Audio element.
Use 'element_identifier' to specify the Audio element.
Returns 'true' if the audio is playing, 'false' if paused or stopped.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.audio_playtime.de:
Returns either the current play time of an Audio element
(MM:SS format) or the play progress percentage (0-100).
Returns '00:00' or '0' if no audio is playing.

Required values:
- element_identifier: The ID of the audio element
- show_percentage: Set to 'true' to show percentage instead of time
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.calc.desc:
Solves arithmetic expressions.

Just replace the example expression
with the real one.

Set 'decimal' to 'false' if the
placeholder should return a LONG
instead of a DOUBLE.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.clipboard_content:
Returns the current text content of the system's clipboard
or an empty text if nothing is currently stored in the clipboard.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.crop_text.desc:
Removes a specific amount of characters from the
beginning and end of the given text.

text = The text to crop.
remove_from_start = Characters to remove from the beginning.
remove_from_end = Characters to remove from the end.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.desc:
Add placeholders to the text that later
get replaced with values like the
player name or the Minecraft version.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.element_height.de:
Gets the height of an element
by its element ID.

Just replace 'some.element.id' with
the actual element ID.

§xYou can get the ID of elements
§xby right-clicking them in the editor.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.element_posx.desc:
Gets the X position of an element
by its element ID.

Just replace 'some.element.id' with
the actual element ID.

§xYou can get the ID of elements
§xby right-clicking them in the editor.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.element_posy.desc:
Gets the Y position of an element
by its element ID.

Just replace 'some.element.id' with
the actual element ID.

§xYou can get the ID of elements
§xby right-clicking them in the editor.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.element_width.des:
Gets the width of an element
by its element ID.

Just replace 'some.element.id' with
the actual element ID.

§xYou can get the ID of elements
§xby right-clicking them in the editor.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.error.text_too_lo: §c§lERROR: §rText too long to parse placeholders! 17,000 characters at max!
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.file_md5.desc:
Returns the MD5 hash of a local file.
Only supports local files, not URLs.
Returns an empty string if the file doesn't exist or cannot be read.

You can target the default '.minecraft'
directory by starting the file path with '.minecraft/'.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.file_size.desc:
Returns the size of a local file in bytes.
Only supports local files, not URLs.
Returns 0 if the file doesn't exist or cannot be read.

You can target the default '.minecraft'
directory by starting the file path with '.minecraft/'.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.file_text.desc:
Reads text from a local file or remote URL and returns it.
Supports reading entire content or only the last few lines.

Content is cached to improve performance:
- Local files: Re-read every 1 second
- URLs: Re-read every 10 seconds

Required values:
- path_or_url: The file path or URL to read from
  Local files: Use relative paths (e.g. 'config/myfile.txt')
  Remote files: Use HTTP/HTTPS URLs (e.g. 'https://example.com/data.txt')
  
The file path can start with '.minecraft/' to target the default .minecraft directory.

Optional values:
- mode: How to read the content (default: 'all')
  Options: 'all' (entire content), 'last' (last X lines)
- separator: Text between lines when joining (default: '\n')
  Common options: '\n' (newline), ' | ', ', ', ' '
- last_lines: Number of lines to return in 'last' mode (default: 1)
  Only used when mode is 'last'

Note: When mode is 'last' with last_lines set to 1,
the single line is returned without any separator.

Returns empty string if source is not cached yet, doesn't exist,
cannot be read, or if there's no internet connection for URLs.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.get_variable.desc:
Gets the text content of a stored variable.
This is only to get variables stored via FancyMenu
and will not work for mod or Vanilla variables.

Just replace 'some_variable' with the actual variable name.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.guiheight.desc: The height of the current screen.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.guiwidth.desc: The width of the current screen.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.json.desc:
Parse JSON and get a value from it.

The 'source' value accepts:
- Direct JSON content (e.g. {"key":"value"})
- Path to a local JSON file
- URL to a remote JSON file

Replace '$.some.json.path' with the JSON path to the value you want to get.

§zGo to §ljson.fancymenu.net§r §zto learn more about JSON paths.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.jvm_cpu_usage.des: Gets the current CPU usage of the Java Virtual Machine.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.jvm_name.desc: The name of the Java Virtual Machine.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.last_death_messag: Shows the latest death message you received. Set "as_json_component" to true to return the serialized text component instead of plain text.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.last_world_server:
Returns the last world or server the player joined.
You can control via the 'type' value if the placeholder
should return both servers and worlds or only one of them.

Types: both, world, server

The 'full_world_path' value controls if the full path or
only the name of the world (not server) should get returned.
Setting this to 'false' will only return the world name.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.loaded_mods.desc:
Gets the active mods count.
This doesn't include disabled mods.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.loader_name.desc: Gets the name of the mod loader (Forge, Fabric, etc.).
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.loader_version.de: Gets the version of the mod loader (Forge, Fabric, etc.).
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.local.desc:
Localizes a text by the given key.

Just replace 'localization.key' in the
placeholder with a localization key.

Supports Minecraft's localization keys and custom ones!

Check §x§ldocs.fancymenu.net §rfor how to add localizations!
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.lowercase_text.de:
Converts the input text to lowercase letters.

Example:
Input: HELLO WORLD
Output: hello world
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.math_ceil.desc:
Returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to the given number.
For example, ceil(3.14) = 4 and ceil(-3.14) = -3.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.math_cos.desc: Returns the trigonometric cosine of an angle.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.math_cosh.desc: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of a double value.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.math_floor.desc:
Returns the largest integer less than or equal to the given number.
For example, floor(3.14) = 3 and floor(-3.14) = -4.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.math_round.desc:
Rounds a number.
Set the optional 'decimals' value to control the decimal place (use 0 or -1 round to an integer).
Example 1: num=3.14159 & decimals=2 -> 3.14.
Example 2: num=3.14159 & decimals=0 -> 3.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.math_sign.desc:
Returns:
 1 if the number is positive
-1 if the number is negative
 0 if the number is zero
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.math_sin.desc: Returns the trigonometric sine of an angle.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.math_sinh.desc: Returns the hyperbolic sine of a double value.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.math_tan.desc: Returns the trigonometric tangent of an angle.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.math_tanh.desc: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of a double value.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.max_number.desc: Returns the greater of two numbers.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.min_number.desc: Returns the smaller of two numbers.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.minecraft_option_:
Gets the current value of a Minecraft option.
For a list of valid option names, take a look at
the 'options.txt' file of your Minecraft instance.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.modversion.desc:
Gets the version of a mod by its mod ID.

Just replace 'some_mod_id' in the placeholder
with an existing mod ID.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.mouseposx.desc:
Gets the mouse X position.

§xAlways returns 10 while in the editor,
§xso you can still edit the element
§xwithout it following your mouse when
§xusing it for advanced sizing/positioning.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.mouseposy.desc:
Gets the mouse Y position.

§xAlways returns 10 while in the editor,
§xso you can still edit the element
§xwithout it following your mouse when
§xusing it for advanced sizing/positioning.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.nbt_data_get.clie:
Reads NBT directly from the client's world state.
Supports entity selectors with type/name/tag/limit/sort/distance/x/y/z/dx/dy/dz options,
plus absolute or relative block positions, returning value,
string, or SNBT formats entirely client-side.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.nbt_data_get.desc:
Gets NBT data from entities and blocks (similar to '/data get' command).
Returns the value at the specified NBT path.

§lTIP: §rUse the '/data get' command in-game without setting a path
to easily get all available NBT paths for an entity or block!

Required values:
- source_type: The data source type ('entity' or 'block')
- nbt_path: The NBT path to query (e.g. 'foodLevel', 'Pos[0]', 'Inventory[0].id')

Conditional values:
- entity_selector: Entity selector when source_type is 'entity'
  Supports: @s (self), @p (nearest player), @e (nearest entity),
  UUID, or entity name
- block_pos: Block position when source_type is 'block'
  Format: 'x y z' (e.g. '100 64 -200')

Optional values:
- scale: Scale factor for numeric values (default: 1.0)
- return_type: How to return the data (default: 'value')
  Options: 'value' (numeric/size), 'string' (text value),
  'snbt' (formatted NBT), 'json' (JSON format)

Returns empty string if data cannot be accessed or path is invalid.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.nbt_data_get.serv:
§xRequires FancyMenu on the server.§r

Fetches live NBT data from the server, mirroring every target supported by '/data get'.
Returns an empty value until the server response arrives.

The placeholder works exactly like the '/data get' command, so everything that should be possible with the command should also be possible with the placeholder.

Supported source_type values:
- entity: Full selector syntax (scores, advancements, predicates, rotation, gamemode, etc.)
- block: Absolute, relative (~) or local (^) coordinates like the vanilla command
- storage: Command storage identifiers (namespace:key)

Optional arguments:
- nbt_path: Same path rules as '/data get'
- scale: Multiplies numeric results (default 1.0)
- return_type: 'value', 'string', 'snbt', or 'json'

Responses are cached for 100ms to avoid spamming the server.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.negate_number.des:
Returns the negation of the given number.
If the given number is negative, the given number is returned.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.number_base_conve:
Converts a number between bases (supports decimals).
Values: input, from_base (2-36), to_base (2-36).
Up to 16 fractional digits are generated in the target base.
Example: input=67, from_base=10, to_base=2 -> 1000011.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.os.desc: The name of the Operating System.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.os_cpu_usage.desc: Gets the current CPU usage of the Operating System.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.pi.desc: Returns the double value that is closer than any other to §opi§r, the ratio of the circumference of a circle to its diameter.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.player_has_tag.de:
Checks if a specific player has a specific tag. Returns 'true' or 'false'.

These are the tags that you add via the '/tag' command.
Returns a list of all tags for a specific player, separated by the specified separator.

These are the tags that you add via the '/tag' command.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.player_team.desc:
Returns the current team of the given player
or an empty value if the player has no team.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.random_number.des:
Returns a random number in the specified range.
Returns a different number every tick,
so it's recommended to use the
placeholder in combination with
a variable or something else to
control the refresh rate.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.randomtext.desc:
Picks a random line from a TXT file, URL or direct plain text.

Supports local files, remote URLs and plain text as "source":
- Local files: Use relative paths (e.g. '/config/fancymenu/assets/tips.txt')
- Remote files: Use HTTP/HTTPS URLs (e.g. 'https://example.com/tips.txt')
- Plain text: Input direct plain text. Separate lines with "\n".

Content is automatically reloaded every 30 seconds to pick up changes.

The 'interval' parameter controls how often a new random line is selected
from the loaded content (in seconds).

An interval of 0 will make it pick a line only once per session.

For local files, just replace '<file_name.txt>' with your file path.
Local files HAVE to be placed in FancyMenu's ASSETS folder!
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.replace_text.desc:
Replaces text in a string using either literal text or regular expressions (regex).
Supports both single replacement and replace-all operations.

Required values:
- text: The input text to perform replacements on
- search: The text or regex pattern to search for

Optional values:
- replacement: The replacement text (default: empty string)
- use_regex: Set to 'true' to use regex patterns (default: 'false')
- replace_all: Set to 'true' to replace all occurrences, otherwise only first occurrence (default: 'true')

When using regex, you can use capture groups like $1, $2, etc.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.scoreboard.displa:
Returns the name of the objective displayed in a specific slot.
Returns an empty value if no objective is assigned to that slot.

Required values:
- slot: The display slot to check
  Valid slots: sidebar, list, below_name, or team color slots
  (e.g., sidebar.team.red, sidebar.team.blue)
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.scoreboard.has_sc:
Checks if a player has a score for a specific objective.
Returns 'true' if the player has a score, 'false' otherwise.

Required values:
- player: The player name to check
- objective: The objective name to check
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.scoreboard.object:
Returns the total number of objectives in the scoreboard.
Returns '0' if no objectives exist.

Returns the criteria type of an objective.
Common criteria: dummy, trigger, deathCount, playerKillCount,
totalKillCount, health, food, air, armor, xp, level, etc.

Required values:
- objective: The objective name to check

Returns the display name of an objective.
Can return as plain text or JSON format for advanced formatting.

Required values:
- objective: The objective name

Optional values:
- as_json: Set to 'true' to get JSON format (default: 'false')

Returns how an objective's scores are displayed.
Possible values: 'integer' (normal numbers) or 'hearts' (heart icons).

Required values:
- objective: The objective name to check

Returns a list of all objectives in the scoreboard.
Each objective name is separated by the specified separator.

Optional values:
- separator: The text to separate objectives (default: ', ')
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.scoreboard.player:
Returns a formatted list of all scores for a specific player.
Use %%objective%% and %%score%% in the format to customize output.

Required values:
- player: The player name to list scores for

Optional values:
- separator: Text between each score entry (default: ', ')
- format: How to format each entry (default: '%%objective%%: %%score%%')
Returns the score value of a player for a specific objective.
Returns an empty value if the player has no score for that objective.

Required values:
- player: The player name to check
- objective: The objective name to get the score from
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.scoreboard.tracke:
Returns a list of all players tracked by the scoreboard.
Players who have any score in any objective will be listed.

Optional values:
- separator: The text to separate player names (default: ', ')
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.screen_identifier: Returns the identifier of the screen that is currently open. Returns an empty value if no screen is open.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.servermotd.desc:
Gets the MOTD of a server.
Just replace 'someserver.com:25565'
with the actual server IP
and '1' with the MOTD line.
MOTDs only have 2 lines, so
the only valid line values are
'1' and '2'.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.serverping.desc:
Gets the ping to a server.

Just replace 'someserver.com:25565' in the
placeholder with a valid server IP.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.serverplayercount:
Gets the player count of a server.

Just replace 'someserver.com:25565' in the
placeholder with a valid server IP.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.serverstatus.desc:
Gets the status (online/offline) of a server.

Just replace 'someserver.com:25565' in the
placeholder with a valid server IP.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.serverversion.des:
Gets the MC version of a server.

Just replace 'someserver.com:25565' in the
placeholder with a valid server IP.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.split_text.desc:
Splits a text at a specific character or regex.

input = The text to split.
regex = The character or regex for where to split the text.
max_parts = The max parts the text should get split into. Setting this to -1 disables the limit.
split_index = The part that should get returned after splitting. Starts at 0.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.stringify.desc:
Stringifies a text by escaping all
syntax characters ( " { } ).

This is useful when nesting other
placeholders as value. If the
replaced nested placeholder could
contain syntax characters that aren't
part of another placeholder, you need
to escape them.

§xPlaceholders in the value will be
§xreplaced first, so you don't need
§xto worry about them getting stringified.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.switch_case.desc:
Matches a value against multiple cases and returns the corresponding result.
Format: value to match, case pairs (value:result) separated by commas, optional default case.
Example: value="1", cases="1:first,2:second", default="none"
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.text_char_count.d: Returns the character count of the given text.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.text_width.desc:
Returns the width in pixels of the given text.
Useful for calculating element positions or sizes based on text width.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.totalmods.desc:
Gets the total mods count.
This includes disabled mods.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.trim_text.desc:
Removes all leading and trailing spaces of the
given text, but not spaces within the text.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.unix_time.desc:
The current time in milliseconds, measured by the time
that has elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on 1 January 1970.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.uppercase_text.de:
Converts the input text to uppercase letters.

Example:
Input: Hello World
Output: HELLO WORLD
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.uptime_seconds.de: Returns the time since the game launched in seconds or, if "output_as_millis" is true, in milliseconds.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.vanillabuttonlabe:
Get the label/text of a Vanilla widget/button.

Replace 'some.menu.identifier:505280' with
the correct widget locator
of the target widget.

The widget locator points to a specific
widget in a specific screen.

§xYou can right-click widgets
§xin the editor to copy their locator.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.video_background_:
Returns the total duration of a Video menu background in MM:SS format (e.g. '03:45') by its identifier.
Returns '00:00' if the background is not ready yet or not video is set.

To get the identifier of a background, right-click the
editor background and click on 'Copy Background Identifier'.

Returns the paused state of a Video menu background by its identifier.
Returns 'true' when the element is paused, otherwise returns 'false'.

To get the identifier of a background, right-click the
editor background and click on 'Copy Background Identifier'.

Returns either the current play time of a Video menu background
(MM:SS format) or the play progress percentage (0-100).
Returns '00:00' or '0' if the element is not ready yet or no video is set.

Required values:
- background_identifier: The ID of the Video background
- show_percentage: Set to 'true' to show percentage instead of time

To get the identifier of a background, right-click the
editor background and click on 'Copy Background Identifier'.

Returns the volume of a Video menu background by its identifier.
The volume is a decimal between 0.0 (0%%) and 1.0 (100%%).

To get the identifier of a background, right-click the
editor background and click on 'Copy Background Identifier'.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.video_element_dur:
Returns the total duration of a Video element in MM:SS format (e.g. '03:45').
Returns '00:00' if the element is not ready yet or not video is set.

Required values:
- element_identifier: The ID of the Video element to get the duration from
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.video_element_pla:
Returns either the current play time of a Video element
(MM:SS format) or the play progress percentage (0-100).
Returns '00:00' or '0' if the element is not ready yet or no video is set.

Required values:
- element_identifier: The ID of the Video element
- show_percentage: Set to 'true' to show percentage instead of time
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.video_element_vol:
Returns the volume of a Video element.
The volume is a decimal between 0.0 (0%%) and 1.0 (100%%).
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.video_paused_stat:
Returns the paused state of a Video element.
Returns 'true' when the element is paused, otherwise returns 'false'.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.webtext.desc:
Gets the first line of
plain text content from a website.

Replace 'http://somewebsite.com/textfile.txt'
with the link to the page you
want to get the text from.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.active_effe:
Returns the key of the active effect for the given index.
Takes a zero-based index for the effect to get.
The index of the first effect is 0.
Returns an empty value when not in a world or
when no active effect exists for the given index.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.active_hotb:
Returns the currently selected hotbar slot as number.
Returns '0' if no world is loaded.
Possible Values: 0-8
Returns the amount of currently active bosses.
Returns '0' when not in a world or when no boss is active.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.boss_name.d:
Returns the name of an active boss.
Takes a zero-based index for the boss you want to get the name of.
The first boss has and index of 0.
Also takes a boolean (true/false) if the name should be returned as JSON.
Returns an empty value when not in a world or no boss with the given index is active.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.current_bos:
Returns the current health of an active boss in percent.
Takes a zero-based index for the boss you want to get the health of.
The first boss has and index of 0.
Returns '0' when not in a world or no boss with the given index is active.
Possible Values: 0-100
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.current_mou:
Returns the current health of the player's mount.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world or not riding an entity with health.

Returns the current health of the player's mount in percent.
Returns '0' when not in a world or not riding an entity with health.
Possible Values: 0-100

Returns the current jump meter value of the player's mount in percent.
Returns '0' when not in a world or not riding an entity that can jump.
Possible Values: 0-100
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.current_pla:
Returns the current absorption health of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the current absorption health of the player in percent.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
Possible Values: 0-100

Returns the current armor of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the current armor of the player in percent.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
Possible Values: 0-100

Returns the experience progress of the player in percent.
This is the basically the experience bar value.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
Possible Values: 0-100

Returns the current total experience of the player.
This is not the player level.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the current health of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the current health of the player in percent.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
Possible Values: 0-100

Returns the current food level of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the current food level of the player in percent.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
Possible Values: 0-100

Returns the current level of the player.
Returns '0' when not in a world.

Returns the current oxygen level of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the current oxygen level of the player in percent.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
Possible Values: 0-100
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.current_ser:
Returns the IP of the current server.
Returns an empty value when the player is not on a server.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.current_tit:
Returns the currently active HUD title or subtitle.
Takes a boolean (true/false) if it should return the subtitle.
Also takes a boolean (true/false) if it should return the title as JSON.
Returns an empty value if not in a world or no title/subtitle is active.
Returns the current world's difficulty.
Returns empty value if no world is loaded.
Possible Values: peaceful, easy, normal, hard
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.effects_cou:
Returns the amount of currently active effects.
Returns '0' when not in a world or when no effect is active.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.level_save_:
Returns the complete level data of a specific world save as single-line JSON.

Values:
§elevel_name§r = The exact name of the world save to get data for.

Returns a list of all available local world save names.

Values:
§eseparator§r = The separator text between world names. Default is ', '.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.max_mount_h:
Returns the max health of the player's mount.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world or not riding an entity with health.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.max_player_:
Returns the max absorption health of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the max armor of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the max health of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the max food level of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.

Returns the max oxygen level of the player.
Returns '0.0' when not in a world.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.player_atta:
Returns the current attack strength of the player.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
Possible Values: 0-100
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.player_game:
Returns the current game mode of the player.
Returns an empty value when not in a world.
Possible Values: survival, creative, adventure, spectator
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.player_view:
Returns the player's view direction.
Returns an empty value when not in a world.
Possible Values: north, east, south, west
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.player_x_co:
Returns the X coordinate of the player.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.player_y_co:
Returns the Y coordinate of the player.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.player_z_co:
Returns the Z coordinate of the player.
Returns '0' when not in a world.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.players_lis:
Returns a list of all players currently in the world.
Player names are sorted alphabetically.

Optional values:
- separator: The text to separate player names (default: ', ')
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.slot_item.d:
Returns the key of the item in the given inventory slot.
Takes a slot number to point to an inventory slot.
Returns an empty value when not in a world.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.world_day_t:
The current world's day time.
This is the time within a day.
Returns '0' if no world is loaded.

The current world's day time hour.
This is the time within a day.
Returns '0' if no world is loaded.

The current world's day time minute within the current hour.
This is the time within a day.
Returns '0' if no world is loaded.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world.world_game_:
The current world's game time.
This is the total game time, not the day time.
Returns '0' if no world is loaded.
fancymenu.fancymenu.placeholders.world_load_progre:
Reflects the world loading progress
while in a Progress Screen.
Can be used to make loading bars, etc.

Returns a percentage integer between 0 and 100.
fancymenu.fancymenu.requirements.async.cant_run_as:
§x§lFailed to check FancyMenu requirement!§r

You tried to asynchronously use an requirement that only works on the game thread.
