foxablazeaqzl_wiki.foxablazeaqzl_wiki.wiki.skill.foxablazeu:
Everything I desire shall ultimately become wealth that belongs to me alone.

Acquisition Requirements
Master Greed.
Become a True Demon Lord or True Hero.
Permanently consume 1,000,000 maximum Magicules.

Active
[Active - Press] Life Steal: Steal 1% of the target's EP and add it to your own. Your EP must be higher than the target's. Each attempt costs 3,000 Magicules. Cooldown: 10 seconds on success, 3 seconds on failure.

[Active - Press] Heart Control: Control a creature whose EP is lower than your own. Costs 2,500 Magicules. Cooldown: 60 seconds.

[Active - Press] Skill Steal: Steal a skill from a creature or player, excluding Unique and Ultimate Skills. The skill is removed from the target and transferred to you rather than copied. Each target can only have a skill successfully stolen once. Each attempt costs 10,000 Magicules. Cooldown: 30 seconds on success, 3 seconds on failure.

[Active - Hold] Mental Domination: Hold while looking at a target to place them under your control. The base duration is 60 seconds. Within 5 blocks, this duration is reduced by 30 seconds. Beyond 20 blocks, it increases by 30 seconds. Maximum range: 30 blocks. Targeting a non-player creature adds another 30 seconds. When targeting a player, each Desire Point reduces the required time by 1 second. One Desire Point equals 10 villager trades. Each recorded trade belonging to a targeted merchant NPC reduces the required time by 2 seconds. You must keep looking at the target, or your progress will decrease. Activate while sneaking to release a controlled target.

[Active - Toggle] Greed Flare: Activate without looking at a target to gain a buff that increases your physical attack damage by 20% of your current Spiritual Health divided by your race's Spiritual Health multiplier. Formula: Spiritual Health / Y / 5, where Y is the racial Spiritual Health multiplier. Activate again to disable it. Each hit consumes Magicules equal to 10 times the bonus damage.
Activate while looking at an ally to grant them a buff equal to 10% of their current Spiritual Health divided by their race's Spiritual Health multiplier. Formula: Spiritual Health / Y / 10. Costs Magicules equal to 20 times the bonus damage.
Activate while looking at a creature within 20 blocks to deal damage equal to your Spiritual Health / Y / 10. Costs Magicules equal to 20 times the damage dealt. Cooldown: 120 seconds.

[Active - Hold] Death Wish: Hold while looking at a creature within 5 blocks for 200 ticks to kill them instantly. Costs 1,000 Magicules. You must keep looking at the target, or your progress will decrease.

[Active - Press] Multilayer Barrier: Sets your Barrier Points to 1.5 times your maximum health. Incoming damage below the Barrier Point threshold consumes your Magicules at a rate of 5 Magicules per point of damage. foxablazeaqzl_wiki.foxablazeaqzl_wiki.wiki.skill.trmysticis:
The crops, the wild, everything was there for you. You sow the seeds and wish only for a bountiful harvest. And in turn, the crops bless you.

Passive
[Passive, True] Hoe Mastery - All hoes deal increased damage, allowing even a wooden hoe to be useful.
Passive: [Passive, Toggled] Crop Mastery - Nearby crops have a 50% chance (per crop) every 5 seconds to grow by one stage. allowing you to vastly speed up the process of growing any crops. Consumes 20 MP every 5 seconds when toggled on.
Active
[Active, Press] Blessing - Bless the food stack you're holding. Based on the current time of day, blessing the food will grant various helpful buffs. You can give these foods to any entity as well, allowing you to give buffs to them.
For each item in the stack, consume 250 MP. On mastery, the cost increases to 500 MP per food item.
Blessed at Dawn: Gain Strengthen 3 for 3 minutes (Strengthen 5 for 5 minutes on mastery) from consuming it.
Blessed at Noon: Gain Resistance 1 for 3 minutes (Resistance 2 for 3 minutes on mastery) from consuming it.
Blessed at Night: Gain Speed 3 and 2.0 Step Height for 3 minutes (Speed 5 and 3.0 Step Height for 5 minutes on mastery) from consuming it.
This mode gains mastery differently! It DIVIDES the points you would gain by 10, based on how many items were in the item stack, rounded down to the nearest whole number.
For example, if I had a stack of 64 Steak, I would gain 6 mastery points instead of 1. However, if I were to just bless one, two, three, four, five, eight, or nine items, it would be 0 mastery points. You MUST minimally bless a stack of 10 to gain mastery.

Active
[Active, Held] Build [Sentry/Dispenser]:
Sentry:
Holding down the skill for 5 seconds will see you build a sentry at that location. Sentries are stationary and copy the user’s attributes at the time of building, like armor, HP, SHP and more.
Sentries are autonomous and shoot at the nearest non-friendly target, including players.

Level 2 requires 120 seconds of being near the player. It will double the fire rate of the sentry.
Level 3 requires 300 seconds (total 300, so 5 minutes from level 1) of being near the player. It will increase the fire rate further and equip your sentry with missiles.
Dispenser:

At level 2, after 120 seconds of being near the player, it starts to dispense health, healing 10 HP and restoring 1% of MP/AP every 5 seconds.
At level 3, after 300 seconds (total 300, so 5 minutes from level 1) of being near the player, it starts to heal 5% of HP and restore 3% of MP/AP every 3 seconds.

Information
Source: Mysticism
Type: Unique Skill
Obtain Cost: 85,000 MP
Points to Master: 1000
Passive: In Slot

Obtaining
Reincarnation / Reroll.

Passive

Active

[Active, Press] King's Storehouse: Opens a Spatial Storage with the dimensions of a large chest featuring 5 weapon slots, increased to 10 when mastered. Only weapons can be stored, with each item placed individually without stacking. This storehouse supplies the arsenal for Gates of Babylon.

[Active, Held] Gates of Babylon: Summons the arsenal deposited in the storehouse and fires at the location the user is looking at. There is a fixed cooldown of 5 seconds between uses.

0 mastery: 1 portal.
250 mastery: 2 portals.
500 mastery: 3 portals.
750 mastery: 4 portals.
1000 mastery: 5 portals.

Crouching while using the skill causes the portals to surround the targeted location. If an entity is targeted, the portals automatically aim and fire arrows of light that deal Spatial Damage.
Portal counts while crouching:
0 mastery: 3 portals.
250 mastery: 4 portals.

Converts combat, domination, and rage into Wrath, then releases Satanael's true form at its limit.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Authority of Wrath: Can be enabled immediately after acquiring the skill; Mastery is not required. While enabled, attacking an enemy or being attacked by another entity places the user in combat. The user remains in combat for 10 seconds after the last attack dealt or received.

Magicule Proliferation Reactor
[Passive] Magicule Proliferation Reactor: Runs automatically after entering combat. It no longer appears as an active mode and does not need to be held. Restores 2% of maximum Magicules every 2.5 seconds. Each dominated enemy that remains within 30 blocks increases proliferation efficiency by 10%.

Actual recovery formula:
Maximum Magicules × 2% × (1 + dominated enemy count × 10%)

While Magicules do not exceed the natural maximum, each pulse has a 6% chance to grant 1 level of Satanael Rage. Above the natural maximum, the chance increases to 10%. Below 50% health, the chance to gain Rage increases to 150%; below 25% health, it increases to 200%.

Satanael Rage
[Passive] Rage Enhancement: Each Rage level grants +20 Armor, +100 Attack Damage, +0.6 Attack Speed, +0.2 Movement Speed, ×2 Swimming Speed, and +0.5 Knockback Resistance. Rage has a maximum of 10 levels and a base duration of 45 seconds. Attacking or being attacked extends the duration by 5 seconds, up to 60 seconds. Rage begins decaying after 10 seconds out of combat, then loses 1 level every 5 seconds. Rage does not decay during Rampage Release.

Wrath
[Passive] Wrath Accumulation: Wrath ranges from 0% to 100%. Each enemy still affected by Wrath Domination and within 30 blocks of the user generates 0.1% Wrath per second; for example, 10 enemies generate 1% per second. When no dominated enemies remain and the user is out of combat, 1% Wrath is lost per second. During Rampage Release, Wrath is fixed at 100%. When Rampage ends, Wrath is reset to zero. While Rampage Release is on cooldown, Wrath is locked at 0% and cannot be gained from any dominated enemy.

Active
[Active - Hold] Wrath Domination: Continuously consumes 100 Magicules per second and affects enemies within 30 blocks of the user, granting them Satanael Rage for 40 seconds. Scans and refreshes affected targets every 0.5 seconds. Affected creatures lose their reason and are forced to attack other creatures dominated by the same user. The user's allies and Creative Mode players are unaffected. Targets that possess and have Mental Attack Nullification enabled are completely immune. Each affected enemy contributes both Wrath and a Magicule Proliferation Reactor efficiency bonus. Grants 1 Mastery point every 5 seconds while held.

Current Rage leveling behavior: The initial base level is calculated from hold duration, normally increasing the target's Rage by 1 level every 10 seconds. A target that already has Rage also gains 1 additional level every time the effect is refreshed. Because refreshing occurs every 0.5 seconds, a continuously affected target usually reaches Rage level 10 in about 4.5 seconds.

[Active - Press] Rampage Release: Consumes all accumulated Wrath and enters Satanael's true form. Activation requires 100% Wrath, and Rampage Release must not be on cooldown.

Activation effects: Lasts 30 seconds and cannot be manually disabled after activation; clearing the passive checkbox does not end it. Wrath remains fixed at 100%. The Magicule Proliferation Reactor enters full-power operation, reducing the pulse interval to 0.5 seconds. The base proliferation multiplier starts at ×5 and increases by ×0.1 each second. Efficiency bonuses from dominated enemies still apply.

Full-power recovery formula:
Maximum Magicules × 2% × (1 + dominated enemy count × 10%) × (5 + elapsed seconds × 0.1)

Without enemy bonuses, each pulse initially restores about 10% of maximum Magicules and restores about 16% near the end. Two pulses occur each second.

Continuous growth: During Rampage, the user gains +20 Attack Damage, +5 Armor, +2% Movement Speed, and +0.05 Magicule Gain each second. After 30 seconds, the maximum gains are approximately +600 Attack Damage, +150 Armor, +60% Movement Speed, and +1.5 Magicule Gain. All of these bonuses are removed when Rampage ends.

End penalty: When Rampage ends, Wrath is reset to zero, Weakness II is applied for 2 minutes, and Rampage Release enters a 360-second cooldown. The cooldown uses the Tensura skill system's seconds unit. Wrath cannot be gained during the cooldown.

Active
[Active - Press] Harvest Storehouse: Opens the independent Harvest skill storehouse GUI. It automatically records information about Intrinsic, Common, and Extra Skills that the player formally acquires. Skills still being learned, temporary skills, resistances, Unique Skills, and Ultimate Skills are not stored. Recorded information remains even if the original skill is later integrated, consumed, or forgotten.

Ability Creation: Place information for two stored skills into the synthesis area to create a new skill according to a preset recipe. The player must actually possess both non-temporary material skills. On success, the new skill is permanently granted. By default, the player's base maximum EP is permanently reduced by 5%, and both material skills are consumed, although their information remains in the storehouse. Cooldown: 10 seconds. A failed synthesis consumes neither the material skills nor permanent EP.

Example recipes:
Self-Regeneration + Body Strengthening → Ultraspeed Regeneration
Self-Regeneration + Ultraspeed Regeneration → Infinite Regeneration
Ranged Barrier + Body Armor → Multilayer Barrier
Thought Acceleration + Analytical Appraisal → Great Sage
Spatial Motion + Multilayer Barrier → Spatial Domination

Ability Duplication: Select a stored skill that the player does not currently possess and permanently copy it to the user. Each successful duplication permanently reduces base maximum EP by 2%. Cooldown: 300 seconds. Resistances, Unique Skills, and Ultimate Skills cannot be duplicated.

Ability Bestowal: Select a skill in the storehouse and click Bestow Skill to temporarily enter Bestow mode. Aim at a named subordinate or allied player and press the skill key to grant the selected skill permanently. Maximum range: 24 blocks. A successful bestowal consumes 25% of the user's current Magicules. Cooldown: 300 seconds. Crouch and press the skill key to cancel. Resistances, Unique Skills, and Ultimate Skills cannot be bestowed.

Associated Item
Harvest Crystal: While the player possesses Harvest King, harvesting mature crops has a 1% chance to drop a Harvest Crystal. Consuming 10 Harvest Crystals unlocks permission to lock Harvest King, but the skill must still be actually locked in the skill-lock interface. Once locked, Harvest King and its storehouse data are immune to Character Reset Scrolls and Skill Reset Scrolls. If fewer than 10 crystals have been consumed, the skill was not actually locked, or configuration forbids locking it, Harvest King is reset normally and its storehouse data is also lost.

Supports the user with supreme computational ability, instantly casting magic, analyzing and restructuring skills, and taking over combat when necessary.

Passive
[Passive] Computation Enhancement: Grants +10 Chant Speed, +10 Analysis Level, +30 Skill Learning gain, and +30 Skill Mastery gain.

[Passive] Automatic Evasion: Ensures both melee and projectile automatic dodge attributes are at least 90%.

[Passive] Skill Optimization: Reduces all skill cooldowns to 70% of their original duration. Reduces the Magicule cost of all skills that consume Magicules to 70% of the original cost.

[Passive] Knowledge Infusion: Immediately learns every blueprint.

[Passive] Physical Assistance: Grants +20% Movement Speed and +1 Attack Speed.

[Passive] Additional Computation Enhancement: Grants an additional +5 Chant Speed and an additional +18 each to Skill Learning and Mastery gains.

[Passive] Magic Computation: Magic is no longer restricted by its own Mastery level and can be cast instantly.

Active
[Active - Press] Analytical Appraisal: Opens the analysis interface. Crouch and press to switch the analysis target between entities, blocks, or both.

[Active - Press] Analyze: Analyzes a creature within 10 blocks in the user's line of sight or a copyable magic projectile within 30 blocks, then randomly learns one skill that is permitted to be copied.

[Active - Press] Refinement: Press normally to open the Duplication Synthesis interface. Crouch and press to open the Refinement interface.

[Active - Press] Synthesis: Press normally to open the Disassembly interface. Crouch and press to open the Synthesis and Separation interface.

[Active - Press] Integration: Use while targeting a Charybdis Core to acquire the skill stored inside it. Cooldown: 8 seconds on success or 3 seconds on failure; with Mastery, 3 seconds on success or 1 second on failure. Costs 300 Magicules, reduced to 150 with Mastery.

[Active - Press] Separation: Opens Degenerate's Separation interface and dismantles a composite into its components. Cooldown: 8 seconds on success or 3 seconds on failure; with Mastery, 3 seconds on success or 1 second on failure. Costs 200 Magicules, reduced to 100 with Mastery.

[Active - Press] Authority Management: Switches between Normal Assistance and Emergency Takeover.

Emergency Takeover: Consumes 1% of maximum Magicules per second. This cost does not benefit from Ciel's 30% cost reduction. Attacks creatures without player input and locks onto targets within 32 blocks.

Manipulates spacetime and possibility, using future prediction to evade attacks and a multidimensional barrier to adapt to different forms of damage.

Passive
[Passive] Future Prediction: Increases both melee and projectile automatic dodge attributes by 70 percentage points.

[Passive] Thought Acceleration: Grants +0.04 Movement Speed, +0.8 Attack Speed, +4 Chant Speed, and +2 Dodge Invincibility.

[Passive] Universal Perception: Grants +3 Presence Detection Level, +20 Perception Radius, +0.1 Sound Perception, and +30 Heat Detection Radius.

[Passive] Spatial Damage Amplification: Multiplies Spatial damage by 6. This bonus does not stack while Spatial Domination is also enabled.

[Passive] Jumping Magic Bullet: When a projectile is fired from a bow, kunai, or gun, it automatically teleports behind the creature the user is looking at. Holding Shift prevents this effect from triggering. Each activation costs 30 Magicules.

Active
[Active - Press] Spacetime Manipulation: Maximum teleport range: 40 blocks. When aiming at a creature, teleports the user behind the target. A successful teleport has a 5-second cooldown and searches for a safe position with no collision or liquid and solid ground beneath it.

[Active - Press/Toggle] Multidimensional Barrier: Consumes 2,000 Magicules per second while active and enters a 60-second cooldown when disabled. The barrier tracks and adapts to each damage type independently:
The first through third instances of the same damage type are reduced by 10%.
The fourth through sixth instances are reduced by 11%.
Afterward, every 3 additional instances of that damage type increase its reduction by 1 percentage point.
Reduction for any single damage type is capped at 80%.

Manually disabling the barrier, running out of Magicules, unequipping the skill, or disabling Fortuna's master toggle ends the barrier and clears every damage adaptation record.

[Active - Hold] Holy Haki: Default range: 15 blocks. Inflicts Fear on enemies whose EP is significantly lower than the user's and pushes them away, while clearing negative effects from allies and periodically healing them. The default activation and ongoing costs are both 50 Magicules. Cooldown after release: 5 seconds, reduced to 3 seconds with Fortuna Mastery. With Mastery, the mouse wheel can adjust the EP ratio used for the Haki check.

[Active - Press] Haki Coating: Consumes 100 Magicules and grants Haki Coating for 120 seconds. Press again to end it early. The effect grants +1 Physical Resistance Degradation.

Locks onto targets with magic circles and unleashes a devastating charged sniper attack. Mastery unlocks Infinite Sniping for sustained volleys.

Active
[Active - Hold] Sniping: Hold for 2 seconds (40 ticks) to release a magic circle. The circle then charges and fires one attack, dealing 500 damage or 800 with Mastery. Costs 5,000 Magicules.

[Active - Hold] Infinite Sniping: A new mode unlocked with Mastery. Hold for 10 seconds (200 ticks) to deploy magic circles around the player, continuously attacking all creatures for 1 minute. Costs 50,000 Magicules. Cooldown: 10 minutes.

The supreme authority over time and space, stopping the world, crossing time, and dominating enemies through Infinity Prison and Severance.

Passive
[Passive - Equipped] Magicule Seizure: The user's attacks have a 50% chance to seize 1% of an enemy's Magicules, restoring Magicules spent by the user.

[Passive - Equipped] Absolute Defense: Blocks all attacks using the formula C = A × 25, where C is the Magicule cost and A is the incoming damage. Attacks from opponents whose EP is at least 75% of the user's EP can bypass Absolute Defense.

[Passive - Equipped] Resistance Bypass: Bypasses resistances and treats nullifications as resistances.

Active
[Active - Press] Time Stop: Stops the entire world, leaving only the user able to act normally. Press again to restore the flow of the world. Costs 100,000 Magicules per second.

[Active - Press] Time Travel: Returns to the beginning of the world. Cooldown: 1,600 seconds.

[Active - Press] Infinity Prison: Costs 30,000 Magicules and imprisons the creature or player the user is looking at, sealing all movement and skill use. Drains 500 Magicules from the trapped target every 10 ticks. Lasts 300 seconds, increased to 600 seconds with Mastery. Cooldown: 20 seconds; missing still triggers the cooldown, reduced to 10 seconds with Mastery.

[Active - Press] Imaginary Space: Opens a spatial storage with 6 pages of standard chest capacity. Items stack to 999 instead of 64. It also stores the energy of attacks blocked by Absolute Defense, represented by the Magicules spent to block them.

[Active - Press] Severance Coating: Costs 1,000 Magicules and grants the user's attacks +50 damage and the Severance effect for 60 seconds. The damage bonus increases to +200 with Mastery.

[Active - Press] Severance Blade: Costs 20,000 Magicules and fires an invisible projectile that deals 50 damage and inflicts Severance, increased to 300 damage with Mastery. The projectile is 5 blocks in size, increased to 10 blocks with Mastery. Cooldown: 3 seconds.

[Active - Press] Usurpation: Only works against opponents whose EP is higher than the user's. Steals one Spiritual Magic or skill from the target, limited to Common and Extra Skills. Success chance: 25%, increased to 50% with Mastery. Each attempt costs 1,000 Magicules. Cooldown: 10 seconds.

[Active - Press] Replication: Copies one Spiritual Magic or skill from the target, limited to Common, Extra, and Intrinsic Skills. Success chance: 25%, increased to 50% with Mastery. Each attempt costs 1,000 Magicules. Cooldown: 10 seconds.

[Active - Press] Forced Usurpation: Unlocked with Mastery. Functions like Usurpation, but only against targets whose EP is lower than the user's, with a 100% success rate. When used on a summon owned by a creature whose EP is no more than 75% of the user's EP, ownership of that summon is stolen. Costs 5,000 Magicules. Cooldown: 10 seconds.
foxablazeaqzl_wiki.foxablazeaqzl_wiki.wiki.skill.tennogamen:
Stops creatures from reaching you and briefly prevents the target from acting.

Active
[Active - Press] Umweg: Targets a living entity in the user's line of sight, inflicting Slowness and Mining Fatigue, effectively preventing movement and actions.

If no target is found, no control effect is applied.

Charges a devastating explosion that creates a massive crater and contaminates the surrounding land.

Active
[Active - Press] Far Cry Charge: Starts charging. Releasing before the charge is complete will not fire the full attack.

[Active - Release] Far Cry: Releases after charging, creating a bomb crater 40 blocks in diameter and contaminating the surrounding land.

Extracts and compresses the user's own Magicules into a bead.

Active
[Active - Press] Magic Beads: Consumes Magicules and adds one Magic Bead to the player's inventory.

If the user does not have enough Magicules, no item is created.

Copies the target's Ultimate Skill, or uses a Machina Cannon to release Pseudo-Code: Dragon Roar.

Modes
[Mode] Lösen: Copy: Targets a player in front of the user. If the target has any Ultimate Skills, one is randomly copied to the user. Copying a new skill removes the previous copied skill.

[Mode] Pseudo-Code: Dragon Roar: Requires a Machina Cannon in the main hand. Press to record a target position, hold to charge, then release after the charge is complete. The attack causes a small explosion first, followed by a large expanding wave explosion.

A spell used by the Flügel during the Great War, their only named move and their strongest attack method.

Active
[Active - Press] Tengeki Charge: Starts charging and records the point the user is looking at as the target.

[Active - Hold] Maintain Charge: Holding the charge increases explosion radius and final damage. Charging too long continuously consumes Magicules; if the user cannot pay, the charge is interrupted.

[Active - Release] Tengeki: After charging long enough, releases a massive explosion at the target point and deals magic damage to non-allied living entities in range.

Effect
Longer charge time increases both explosion range and damage. Releasing after an extended charge weakens the user.

Manipulates space for instant shifting and cross-dimensional return to an imprinted coordinate.

Acquisition
Unlocked for the Flügel series when maximum Magicules exceed 5,000.

Active
[Active - Press] Mode 1: Instantly shifts 24 blocks.

[Active - Press] Mode 2 - Coordinate Shift: Uses the currently selected coordinate sub-mode. Press Shift + Skill Key to switch between Coordinate Imprint and Coordinate Return. Returning requires a 2-second charge and works across dimensions.

Overloads the Spirit Circuit to strengthen skills, flight, and barriers, but automatically shuts down when Overload reaches its limit.

Passive
[Passive] Damage and Chant Enhancement: Increases skill damage by 20% and chant speed by 25%, but increases Magicule consumption by 20%. Adds 3 Overload per second.

[Passive] Flight Enhancement: Increases flight speed by 35%, improves aerial turning, and grants immunity to fall damage. Adds 2 Overload per second.

[Passive] Physical and Magic Barriers: Grants physical and magic barriers. The barriers consume Magicules based on damage taken. When a barrier breaks, adds 20 Overload. Adds 1 Overload per second.

[Passive] Overload Limit: At 100 Overload, the skill automatically shuts down and applies Circuit Burnout for 15 seconds. During Circuit Burnout, high-speed cruising is disabled and flight speed is reduced.

Fires a delayed explosive Black Arrow. Rapid consecutive shots trigger a cooldown.

Active
[Active - Press] Black Arrow: Fires one Black Arrow that explodes after 4 seconds. Firing 6 Black Arrows within 5 seconds places the skill on a 5-second cooldown.

Creates a fully enclosed spherical barrier that isolates its interior from the outside world and withstands explosions, magic, and physical impacts.

Active
[Active - Press, No Entity Target] Self Barrier: Creates a fully enclosed spherical barrier around the user, including beneath the ground. Its radius is 5 blocks, increased to 8 blocks with Mastery. Its defensive strength can withstand destruction up to the level of Tengeki.

[Active - Press, Entity Target] Target Barrier: Creates a spherical barrier with a 3-block radius around the targeted entity, isolating the interior from the outside world. Its defensive strength can withstand destruction up to the level of Tengeki.
foxablazeaqzl_wiki.foxablazeaqzl_wiki.wiki.skill.traddon.to:
Stores energy inside a shell of total internal reflection, then folds incoming impacts and spells back toward their source.

Passive
[Passive] Analytical Mirror: Performs high-speed analysis of reflected energy. When an opponent's spell touches the user's shell, the user has a chance to learn the analyzed spell.

[Passive] Energy Condensation: Stores absorbed spells in a state of total internal reflection, converting stored Magicules into MP over time.

Active
[Active] Full-Vector Reversal: Reverses kinetic energy and reflects part of incoming physical damage back to the attacker. Mastery increases the reflected amount.

[Active] Prismatic Fracture: Accumulates damage from attacks. When activated, converts the stored damage into a barrage of projectiles that counterattack nearby enemies.
foxablazeaqzl_wiki.foxablazeaqzl_wiki.wiki.skill.traddon.re:
Uses core resonance to cancel impacts and refract hostile spells into a divided spectrum.

Passive
[Passive] Harmonic Armor: The user's body vibrates at a frequency that cancels out physical strikes.

Active
[Active] Spectral Refraction: Splits a single incoming spell into several weaker elemental versions, taking only part of the damage and reflecting part back to the attacker.

[Active] Data Overload: By touching an enemy, the user uploads a burst of useless information into their brain, causing Stun.

The refractive shell of the Geode Golem weakens magic and spends Magicules to block incoming spells.

Passive
[Passive] Magic Resistance: Reduces incoming magic damage.

Active
[Active - Hold] Refractive Guard: While held, blocks magic damage at the cost of Magicules.
foxablazeaqzl_wiki.foxablazeaqzl_wiki.wiki.skill.traddon.ph:
The photon blade of the Prism Knight adds light-element cutting force to physical attacks.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Photon Blade: When toggled on, physical attacks deal extra Light elemental damage. Mastery increases the bonus damage.
foxablazeaqzl_wiki.foxablazeaqzl_wiki.wiki.skill.traddon.de:
Builds devastation through tyrannical pressure, soul collapse, and destructive resonance, becoming more dangerous as battle continues.

Active
[Active] Tyrant's Haki: Exerts heavy pressure that drains stamina from nearby targets. Those with weak wills are inflicted with Fear and Despair.

[Active] End of Days: Forces lower-EP targets through a soul check. Failure causes Soul Collapse; even when resisted, the attempt deals spiritual damage.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Post-Mortem Surge: The user gains stacking Attack and Speed bonuses for every entity they kill.

[Passive - In Slot] Atomic Annihilation: Attacks deal extra damage and reduce physical resistance. Physical attacks become Spiritual Damage and are especially effective against equipment.

[Passive - Toggle] Destructive Resonance: Coats the user in a Dissolution Aura, disintegrating physical projectiles and low-level magic before they touch the user.
foxablazeaqzl_wiki.foxablazeaqzl_wiki.wiki.skill.traddon.cr:
A cloud of microscopic diamond shards released by Shardlings, damaging enemies internally when inhaled and slowing them.

Active
[Active] Crystal Dust: Releases a cloud of microscopic diamond shards. Enemies that inhale the shards take internal damage and are slowed.
foxablazeaqzl_wiki.foxablazeaqzl_wiki.wiki.skill.tensuramor:
A power that twists perception and rewrites death, allowing the user to alter their own state and disrupt enemies in battle.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Reality Aura: When toggled on, slows nearby entities.

[Passive - In Slot] Rewritten: Rewrites the user's death, reviving them instead. On revival, restores health, grants brief invulnerability, removes negative effects, and restores part of their MP. Can trigger multiple times per day.

Active
[Active - Press] Reality Change: Greatly empowers the user for a short time with extreme resistance, strength, speed, and regeneration. While active, the user can bypass barriers and resistances, make the next hit deal true damage, knock nearby entities away, and clear projectiles.

[Active - Press] Deleted Timeline: Enters a counter stance. When struck during the stance, the user returns amplified damage to the attacker.

[Active - Press] False Perception: Afflicts nearby entities with nausea, blindness, and slowness, while disrupting their position and facing.

[Active - Press] You Were Never Here: Sends nearby players back to their respawn locations.

Passive
[Passive - Always Active] Magicule Enhancement: Magicule gain is multiplied by 1.5, increased to 2 after Mastery. Magicule recovery speed is multiplied by 1.3, increased to 1.5 after Mastery.

[Passive - When Learned] Granted Abilities: Grants Shadow Motion, Physical Attack Nullification, Magic Darkness Transformation, and Darkness Attack Nullification.

[Passive - Toggle] Satella's Haki: Releases Haki around the user. Targets whose maximum Magicules are below 5% of the user's maximum Magicules receive Fear I.

[Passive - In Slot] Skill Duplication: When struck by an Intrinsic, Common, Extra, or Spiritual Magic skill, the user has a 5% chance to copy it. The user can also copy Authority of Greed or True Authority of Greed.

Active
[Active - Press] Shadow Tendrils: Fires 5 shadow tendrils at enemies, increased to 10 after Mastery. Each tendril deals 10 physical damage and 10 spiritual damage. Cooldown: 30 seconds. Duration: 20 seconds, or until it hits an enemy.

[Active - Press] Devouring Shadow: Gradually consumes the ground with shadow, expanding from 5×5 to 50×50. Targets within the area take 20 physical damage and 5 spiritual damage per second and receive Slowness I. Cooldown: 120 seconds. Duration: 60 seconds.

Passive
[Passive - Always Active] Return by Death: The user has 5 revival charges every 20 minutes, increased to 10 after Mastery. Revival restores 50% of maximum health. Each revival consumes 19% of maximum Magicules, reduced to 9% after Mastery. Magicule gain is multiplied by 2, increased to 2.5 after Mastery. Magicule recovery speed is multiplied by 1.5, increased to 2 after Mastery. Physical damage taken is reduced by 50%; resistance-piercing and nullification-piercing abilities cannot bypass this effect.

[Passive - When Learned] Granted Abilities: Grants Shadow Motion, Physical Attack Nullification, Magic Darkness Transformation, Darkness Attack Nullification, Spatial Domination, Magic Space Transformation, Holy Attack Resistance, Abnormal Condition Nullification, Cold Resistance, Corrosion Resistance, Magic Resistance, Pain Nullification, Paralysis Resistance, Poison Resistance, Spatial Attack Nullification, Mental Attack Resistance, Wind Attribute Attack Resistance, Summon Otherworlder, and Summon Demon. After Mastery, Mental Attack Resistance is upgraded to Mental Attack Nullification.

[Passive - Toggle] Envious Haki: Releases Haki around the user. Targets whose maximum Magicules are below 30% of the user's maximum Magicules receive Fear III. The system automatically creates a save point every 5 minutes without disabling manual save-point creation.

[Passive - In Slot] Skill Duplication: When struck by an Intrinsic, Common, Extra, Spiritual Magic, or Unique Skill, the user has a 25% chance to copy it, increased to 50% after Mastery. Unique Skills instead have a 5% copy chance, increased to 10% after Mastery. The user can also copy Authority of Greed or True Authority of Greed.

Active
[Active - Press] Shadow Tendrils: Fires 15 shadow tendrils at enemies, increased to 30 after Mastery. Each tendril deals 20 physical damage and 25 spiritual damage. Cooldown: 30 seconds. Duration: 20 seconds, or until it hits an enemy. Flight speed: extremely fast.

[Active - Hold] Shadow Hand: Extends a shadow hand from the user's body, invades the enemy, and crushes their heart. Deals 200 physical damage and 350 spiritual damage per second, increased to 300 and 500 after Mastery. Cooldown: 30 seconds. Lasts until the user releases the skill. Maximum range: 20 blocks. Movement speed: slow.

[Active - Press] Shadow Hands: Releases 15 shadow hands from the user's body, increased to 20 after Mastery, which attempt to crush enemies. Deals 100 physical damage and 100 spiritual damage per second, increased to 200 and 150 after Mastery. Cooldown: 30 seconds. Duration: 15 seconds. Movement speed: fast.

[Active - Press] Authority of Envy: Grants Return by Death to one allied target, allowing them to revive at their save point after death. Activation consumes the user's Magicules according to the target's Magicule amount. After Mastery, the cost is reduced to 50% of the target's Magicules.

[Active - Press] Save Point: Select Authority of Envy mode and Shift-right-click to set a save point for the selected allied target. The save point records the target's spiritual health, Magicules, physical health, Aura, and Existence Value. An allied target must be selected first; otherwise, the system issues a warning.

[Active - Press] Devouring Shadow: Gradually consumes the ground with shadow, expanding from 5×5 to 50×50. Targets within the area take 60 physical damage and 60 spiritual damage per second, both increased to 120 after Mastery, and receive Slowness I. Cooldown: 100 seconds. Duration: 60 seconds.

Places a pseudo heart into a subordinate, using another life to sustain the user's greed and invulnerability.

Passive
[Passive] Little King: While a pseudo heart is placed on a nearby entity, the user becomes invincible to physical attacks, no longer needs to breathe, and locks their mana and aura state. Physical attacks bypass immunities and resistances, deal more damage, and gain extra reach.

[Passive] Damage Greed: Grants resistance degradation and immunity to severance and cook effects. Mastery strengthens the effect.

[Passive - Toggle] Prevention: Limits how long Lionheart can be maintained, preventing its backlash from escalating too far.

Active
[Active - Press] Little King: Places a pseudo heart onto the subordinate the user is looking at, enabling the Little King passive. The subordinate must be alive and within effective range.

[Active - Hold] Lionheart: After charging, continuously grants all Little King effects. Holding it too long begins dealing severance health damage to the user, bypassing immunities.

The authority of death's shade, concealing presence, stealing souls, and expanding a death field through sacrifice and finality.

Passive
[Passive - On Learn] Grants Shadow Motion, Spiritual Attack Nullification, Abnormal Condition Nullification, Spatial Attack Nullification, and Gravity Attack Nullification.

[Passive - Toggle] Silence: While toggled, the user becomes silent and does not trigger normal sound-based detection.

[Passive - Toggle] Death Growth: While toggled, kills permanently scale Ronova's HP and attack bonuses. If Ronova is revoked, the bonuses are removed.

[Passive] True Death: If the user truly dies while Ronova is toggled, nearby entities are erased. Depending on config, this can also affect blocks and drops.

Active
[Active - Press] Spiritual Force: Toggles invisibility and Presence Concealment. Use again to disable it.

[Active - Press / Release] Salvation Lord: Toggles soul rescue mode. When an owned subordinate or tamed ally dies nearby, their soul lingers briefly; use the mode while looking near the soul to revive it.

[Active - Press] Ally Sacrifice: Sacrifices nearby tamed or named non-player allies. When enough sacrifices are gathered, drains part of the user's HP to grant major combat buffs and extra lives.

[Active - Hold] Death Field: Spreads a death field around the user. Nearby enemies take repeated damage, suffer torment effects, and are marked for skill plunder while the ground corrupts. Enemies killed by the field may have non-Ultimate skills stolen, and part of their EP can be added to the user's max EP.

[Active - Press] Finality: Erases every entity in range, including the caster. Non-player entities are killed and discarded; players are killed.

Records every life the user has lived and uses karma after death to begin the next reincarnation.

Passive
[Passive] Reincarnation: On death, the user reincarnates into a random race, losing all EP and skills except Nirvana. Reincarnation has a chance to grant an extra temporary Unique Skill that is not carried over on future deaths.

[Passive] Life Archive: Stores all of the user's past lives as records, including their EP and skills.

[Passive] Karma Accumulation: On death, the user gains karma based on what they achieved in their past life. Time alive, EP, acquired or mastered skills, powerful kills, long survival, and strong subordinates can all contribute.

Active
[Active - Press] Migration: Opens the Life Archive, allowing the user to view past lives and their EP and skills. The user can spend karma to unlock sub-modes of old skills and use them in the current life. If every sub-mode of a skill is unlocked, the skill is fully recovered.

The authority of life's shade, recording corpses, commanding the dead, and entering a battle stance that heals allies while corroding enemies with life force.

Passive
[Passive - On Learn] Grave Authority: Improves attack damage, attack speed, movement speed, knockback resistance, Presence Sense, and Chant Speed.

[Passive - Toggle] Grave Archive: Grants Naberius Will, Naberius Vision, and Presence Sense, while removing fear, insanity, hypnosis, mind control, burden, webbed, movement interference, and spatial blockade effects.

[Passive - Toggle] Corpse Recording: While toggled, killed enemies are stored in the archive with their HP, EP, Spiritual Health, count, and skills.

[Passive - Toggle] Servant Command: Active summons automatically attack enemies that hit the user or enemies the user attacks.

[Passive - Toggle] Grave Revival: Dead active summons can revive; repeated revivals of the same summon become more expensive.

[Mastery - Passive] Death Veto: While Naberius is toggled, lethal damage is denied, leaving the user alive and granting brief invulnerability, Haki Coat, and Instant Regeneration.

[Mastery - Passive] Corpse-King Authority: Grants Resistance Degradation and a chance to automatically dodge projectiles.

Active
[Active - Press] Grave Archive: Opens the archive menu, allowing the user to select stored corpses, reduce their count, delete them, manifest them, or clear active summons.

[Active - Press] Manifest: Raises selected archive entries as servants. Normal use summons one of each selected corpse; crouching summons as many selected stored copies as possible.

[Active - Press] Chimera Creation: Opens the chimera menu, consuming archived life records to create a stronger servant.

Modes
[Mode] Crimson Eden Warform: Switches from Grave Archive stance into War Stance. This stance strengthens health, attack, defense, speed, recovery, senses, and dodge-related abilities, replacing archive and summon modes with Life Deity combat abilities.

[War Stance] Genesis Pulse: Releases a life-force pulse that heals the user, restores resources, cleanses major mental and movement debuffs, empowers nearby allies, and causes the land nearby to bloom.

[War Stance] Spirit War Step: Dashes forward with spiritual force, damaging enemies ahead, applying Life Seizure, stealing resources, and healing the user based on enemies hit.

[War Stance] Samsara Bloom: Releases a close-range life-and-death burst. Damage increases based on missing HP, applying Organ Decay and Life Seizure, pulling enemies inward, and stealing resources.

[War Stance] Eden of the Life Deity: Hold to charge a divine life domain. While charging, allies are healed and restored; on release, enemies are damaged, pulled inward, afflicted, and drained, while allies, subordinates, summons, and owned mobs are empowered.

[War Stance] Deathless Life Siphon: Marks a target, deals heavy life-force damage, steals resources, and can execute weakened targets with a revive-skipping kill.

[War Stance] Bestow One Life: Grants one forbidden extra life to the user or an ally. When consumed, the target survives lethal damage and gains healing, brief invulnerability, Instant Regeneration, and Haki Coat.

[War Stance] Subordinate Evolution: Force-evolves allied summons, subordinates, tamed mobs, or Naberius servants, improving health, attack, movement, size, resources, and combat power.

[War Stance] Force Awakening: Forces a valid player target through Demon Lord or True Hero awakening.

[War Stance] Fruit of Life: Creates a Fruit of Life. Eating it grants temporary immunity to normal damage, though damage that bypasses invulnerability can still ignore it.

Changes the user's form, allowing them to become a creature far weaker than themselves.

Active
[Active - Press] Morph: Transforms the user into the selected mob. The target must be far weaker than the user.

[Shift + Active] Undo Morph: Cancels the current transformation and restores the user's original form.

A kingly authority over endless imprisonment and time-devouring hunger, weakening enemies, stealing skills, and trapping targets in inescapable space.

Passive
[Passive] Endless Growth: Increases skill learning, mastery progress, and EP gain.

[Passive - Toggle] Magicule Theft: When hitting a player, has a chance to steal part of their temporary Magicules.

[Passive - Toggle] Desperate Empowerment: The lower the user's health becomes, the stronger their strength grows; at critical health, incoming damage is also reduced.

[Passive - Toggle] Endless Pressure: Nearby targets are afflicted with slowness, weakness, and blindness.

[Passive - In Slot] Infinite Prison: Attacks briefly inflict Infinite Imprisonment on the target.

Active
[Active - Press] Taker's Will: Gradually lowers the target's health. Magic Resistance or Magic Nullification reduces the effect.

[Active - Press] Power Hunger: Copies some of the target's skills. Intrinsic, Resistance, Nullification, Common, and Extra skills can be copied, with a chance to copy multiple skills at once.

[Active - Press] Room: Creates a small room-like field. Entities inside are afflicted with a stronger Infinite Imprisonment effect.

[Active - Hold] Isolation: After staring at a target, temporarily disables all of their skills.

[Active - Press] Divine Lifesteal: Deals spatial and holy damage to nearby entities. Matching resistances reduce the damage, while matching nullifications can ignore it.

The authority of the Lord of Time, freezing projectiles, rewriting durations, rewinding self and targets, and detonating enemy Temporal Debt into judgment.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Chrono Divinity: Enhances movement, attack, flight, and chant speed, while granting senses, dodge power, and resistance degradation. Mastery adds Law Degradation and Space Resist Degradation.

[Passive - Toggle] Temporal Isolation: Regularly removes harmful effects from the user. Mastery strengthens the cleansing.

[Passive - Toggle] Projectile Infinity: Stops enemy projectiles before they reach the user. With Mastery, projectiles can be frozen, redirected, or reflected.

[Passive - Toggle] Chrono Prediction: Predicts enemy movement and attacks, creating rejected-future afterimages. With Mastery, threatening enemies are slowed and marked with Future Rejection.

[Passive - Toggle] Stolen Duration: Extends the user's beneficial effects, shortens harmful effects on the user, and weakens enemy buffs nearby.

[Passive - Toggle] Sovereign Time Authority: Enemies that look at, rush, or approach the user are slowed and gain Temporal Stutter and Temporal Debt.

[Passive - Toggle] Chronology Denial: With Mastery, lethal damage can be denied by rewinding the user to an older recorded state.

[Passive - Combat] Temporal Debt: Hitting enemies stores delayed time damage on them. Many Istaroth abilities consume or multiply this stored debt.

Active
[Active - Press] Chronicle: Scans nearby timelines and reports marked enemies, total Temporal Debt, and looped targets. Crouching stores a Manual Anchor for later self-rewind.

[Active - Press] Time Skip: Teleports forward, freezes projectiles along the path, damages enemies in the skipped line, and applies Temporal Stutter and Temporal Debt.

[Crouch + Active] Momentum Theft: Stops projectiles, falling blocks, and enemies in front of the user, stealing their momentum and launching the user forward.

[Active - Press] Borrowed Seconds: Steals duration from enemy buffs, extends enemy debuffs, strengthens the user's buffs, and reduces Istaroth waiting time.

[Crouch + Active] Eternal Moment: Freezes the user's beneficial effects in place, repeatedly extending them for a short time.

[Active - Press] Stillness of the King: The user enters stillness, greatly reducing incoming damage and storing blocked damage as pressure. When stillness ends, nearby enemies are damaged by the stored pressure.

[Crouch + Active] Object Permanence: Freezes a targeted entity, projectile, or falling block in place. Living targets are action-locked and gain Temporal Debt.

[Active - Press] Rewind Self: Restores the user to a Manual Anchor or recent snapshot, restoring position, health, resources, Spiritual Health, and removing harmful effects.

[Crouch + Active] Rewind Target: Rewinds a target to an older position or state. Allies can be restored, while enemies are punished with Temporal Stutter, action lock, and Temporal Debt.

[Active - Press] Delayed Verdict: Marks a target and stores damage they take. When the timer ends, stored damage plus Temporal Debt detonates as Timeline Verdict.

[Crouch + Active] Effect Before Cause: Damages a target before the cause occurs, applying Future Rejection and heavy Temporal Debt.

[Active - Press] Twenty-Second Causality Loop: Records nearby enemies, then plays their timeline backward, repeatedly snapping them to previous positions and adding Temporal Debt.

[Crouch + Active] Condemned Repeat: Anchors a target to one moment. If they move too far, move too fast, or try to escape, they are snapped back and punished.

[Active - Press] Future Exile: Removes a target from the current moment, making them invisible, frozen, and no-physics for a short time. When they return, they take damage and Temporal Stutter.

[Crouch + Active] Past Burial: Buries a target in their past, locking actions, applying Event Silence, and adding Temporal Debt.

[Active - Hold] World of Still Seconds: Creates a stopped-world field around the user. Enemies, projectiles, and falling blocks are frozen, slowed, silenced, rejected from the future, and loaded with Temporal Debt.

[Active after Holding] Clockbreak Release: Releases the stopped world, detonating frozen force, projectiles, held time, and Temporal Debt into a large causality explosion.

[Mastery - Active] Last Second of Creation: Declares the final second, forming a massive doom storm. Time accelerates violently, gravity dies, entities are lifted, projectiles freeze, enemies are silenced and rejected from the future, and the future collapses into a huge final detonation.

A parasitic skill that studies status effects, stores them as fungal samples, upgrades them, and spreads them to nearby enemies through poisonous spores.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Spore Aura: While toggled, the user periodically releases a fungal aura that affects nearby enemies. Enemies are inflicted with Paralysis, poisonous spores appear around them, and small mushroom patches may grow nearby.

If the user has stored analyzed effects, the aura releases additional poison spores. The more effects stored, the stronger the aura appears.

Active
[Active - Press] Analyze: Samples a random active effect from the target the user is looking at. Crouching analyzes the user instead. The sampled effect is stored in fungal memory; analyzing the same effect again increases its stored count.

[Active - Press] Workshop: Opens the Fungus Infection GUI, showing stored effects, upgrade state, available upgrade points, and the currently configured workshop effects.

[Active - Press] Configure: Creates a workshop loadout from stored effects. Normal users can configure fewer effects, while Mastery allows more. Crouching clears the workshop. The workshop determines which effects Spread can use.

[Active - Press] Spread: Spreads workshop effects to nearby enemies. Crouching applies effects to the user instead. Each use randomly selects effects from the workshop and applies them to nearby targets.

Upgrade
Each analyzed effect has its own stored count. Stored counts can be spent to improve that effect's duration or amplifier.

Workshop
The workshop is the selected list of effects that Spread can use. The GUI lets the player assign analyzed effects into workshop slots.

A cheat-like support skill that enhances exploration and combat, exploiting the world as if bypassing normal limits.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Utility Suite: Grants full bright vision, Magicule flight, fall protection, entity highlighting, auto-eating, and automatic totem handling. Some effects consume Magicules continuously or when triggered.

Active
[Active - Press] Xray Hack: Highlights ores, making underground resources easier to find.

[Active - Press] Kill-Aura: With Mastery, automatically aims at nearby entities for attacks.

Opens a domain of negation, empowering the user while suppressing non-allied entities within it.

Active
[Active - Press] Domain: Negation Field: Opens a field of black blocks near the user. Inside the domain, the user gains Strength, Resistance, Speed, and Regeneration.

Non-allied entities are afflicted with Anti-Skill, Weakness, and Slowness, and take continuous damage while inside.

A divine general's authority centered on adaptation, gradually mastering, nullifying, and countering threats after enduring them.

Passive
[Passive] Adaption: After being hit by a damage type, the user gradually gains resistance, nullification, bypass, and degradation against that type. Being afflicted by an effect grants immunity to it. Severance and cook effects can also be adapted to and countered over repeated exposure.

[Passive - Toggle] Adaption Usage: Toggles all gained effect immunities.

[Passive - Toggle] Infinite Regen: Provides continuous regeneration.

[Passive] Learning: Increases skill learning and mastery progress.

Active
[Active - Press] Sword of Extermination: Summons or resummons the Sword of Extermination.

[Active - Press] List Filter: Opens a filter list, allowing the user to enable or disable gained effect immunities.

The authority of the God of Conquest, using guilt as a resource to summon weapons, unleash calamities, and dominate the world through four Aspects.

Passive
[Passive] Guilt: Slowly builds guilt, which is used as a resource for the skill's other abilities.

[Passive] Rend and Split: Damage from this skill is difficult to block or resist.

[True Passive] Aspect: Grants the Aspect system. Different Aspects change how Caedros conquers, including Control, Famine, War, and Death.

Active
[Active] Fang and Serpent: Checks and uses guilt to perform an attack.

[Active] Conquest: Summons an ashen halberd. While holding it, the user can dash and sweep; using the skill again charges the weapon, then blasts enemies away in a forward cone with heavy damage.

[Active] Plague and Pestilence: Sweeps the surrounding area twice. Recasting teleports to the target and strikes them with heavy status-effect damage.

[Active] BANG!: After winding up, releases a devastating line attack forward, blowing away or erasing targets and terrain while dealing void damage.

[Active] Construct: Sweeps the nearby area. Targets killed by this move become weapons orbiting the user; these weapons automatically attack nearby enemies and generate guilt when they break.

[Active] Cloud the Skies: Consumes all guilt and charges, turning the world red. During this state, enemies are debuffed and the user is empowered. Enemies killed by Caedros during this period lose all skills.

Aspect

[Aspect: Famine] Attacks apply stacking debuffs and steal enemy buffs. When debuffs exceed a threshold, Famine triggers, draining resources over time and spreading infection, hunger, and resistance shutdown across the world.

[Aspect: War] Increases damage based on the user's Magicules. Weaker targets become Conquered, losing skills and regeneration while giving part of their EP to the user. If all enemies are conquered, Total War begins, massively empowering the user and changing BANG!.

[Aspect: Death] Movement and damage scale with souls. Souls can revive the user. Those who die in the realm have souls stolen and leave behind perfect replicas that follow the user.

Disrupts the battlefield by swapping positions, allowing the user, enemies, projectiles, or marked targets to instantly exchange places.

Passive

[Passive - Toggle] Passive Mastery: Provides passive mastery progression.

[Passive - In Slot] Tough Guy: Grants Resistance and Strength while slotted.

Active

[Active - Press] Target Select: Enters target selection. Punching entities saves up to three targets; using it while holding a projectile can save the projectile as a target. Exchange prioritizes these saved targets. Crouching clears all saved targets.

The authority of reflected judgment, reflecting damage, storing it, and releasing it all at the moment of truth.

Passive

[Active - Hold] Mirrorfield: Creates a mirror domain around the user, continuously damaging targets within it and storing Reflection from the damage dealt.

[Active - Press] Moment of Truth: Consumes all collected Reflection, dealing reflected judgment damage to the related targets at once and clearing the stored collection.

Locks the user's state into a greedy moment and sustains Little King through a pseudo heart.

Passive
[Passive] Little King: While a pseudo heart is placed on a nearby entity, the user's HP, Spiritual Health, Magicules, Aura, EP, and effects are locked to the state they were in.

[Passive - Toggle] Prevention: Limits how long Lionheart can be maintained, preventing its backlash from escalating too far.

[Passive] Damage Greed: Grants resistance degradation and immunity to severance and cook effects. Mastery strengthens the effect.

Active
[Active - Hold] Lionheart: After charging, saves the user's current state and locks the user in that state while held. Maintaining it too long causes severe backlash to the user.

[Active - Press] Little King: Places a pseudo heart onto the subordinate the user is looking at, enabling Little King. The subordinate must be alive and within effective range.

The authority of the Lord of Space, intercepting projectiles, crossing dimensions, compressing space into attacks, and creating prisons that isolate targets.

Passive

[Active - Press] End of All Creation: Spawns a massive black hole that drags in entities, projectiles, items, and falling blocks, repeatedly damages living targets, and ends in a crushing collapse.

Active

[Active - Press] Fleshy Miscreations: Sacrifices part of the user's health and Magicules to tear away biomass and spawn fleshy doubles. These minions rush enemies and inject effects stored in the Mutation Vault. If they survive to the end, they dissolve and heal the user.

Card colors reveal only the skill tier:
Bronze: Common Skill.
Silver: Extra Skill or Intrinsic Skill.
Gold: Unique Skill.

Velgrynd's Help Grow friendship request: friendship ≥500, loyalty ≥500 and bond ≥1000; the player owns Alteration, either player or NPC owns an Uriel variant, the NPC owns Raguel, and the player's current EP is at least 2.4 million. Execution spends 2.4 million EP and directly attempts to grant Shub to the player, subject to normal acquisition cost. Cthugha goes to the NPC, consuming that NPC's Raguel and any Uriel variant it owns. On first acquiring Skill Storage, eligible permanent skills are recorded and removed from the active skill list; resistances stay, while magic, battlewill, external transfers, no-plundering skills and configured exclusions are exempt.

Azathoth's special automatic acquisition: master Raphael Wisdom and Beelzebuth, with default requirements of 100 named subordinates and 100 mastered skills; automatic evolution, Nightmare ultimates and God Skills must be enabled, configuration must allow it and god-class ownership must be available. Default EP requirement is 40 million with any owned True Dragon ultimate, otherwise 60 million; the MP threshold is max(0, 20 million − 5 million × owned True Dragon ultimates). Both prerequisite ultimates and all owned True Dragon ultimates are consumed, with the dragons recorded in Azathoth. A True Dragon ultimate is optional.

Nodens standard automatic route: own Lucifer; defaults require maximum EP ≥40 million, 150 mastered skills, at least eight copied ultimate submode entries in Lucifer, and mastered Spatial Motion and Multilayer Barrier. When configured, Raphael's Alteration mode must be analyzed; owning either full Raphael also satisfies that analysis check. Automatic evolution, Nightmare ultimates, God Skills and Nodens evolution must be enabled, with god-class ownership available. The default MP threshold is 3.4 million plus the default acquisition cost of the skill for each copied ultimate submode entry. On first acquiring Skill Storage, eligible permanent skills are recorded and removed from the active skill list; resistances stay, while magic, battlewill, external transfers, no-plundering skills and configured exclusions are exempt.

Nodens alternative automatic route: own Lucifer and have Azathoth's Soul Gluttony mode plus Shub's skill-gifting mode; each can be satisfied by the full skill or its copied submode in Lucifer. Default thresholds are maximum EP ≥30 million and MP ≥12.3 million. Automatic evolution, Nightmare ultimates, God Skills and Nodens evolution must be enabled, with god-class ownership available. Full ownership of Azathoth and Shub is not required. On first acquiring Skill Storage, eligible permanent skills are recorded and removed from the active skill list; resistances stay, while magic, battlewill, external transfers, no-plundering skills and configured exclusions are exempt.

Nodens self-Alteration menu route: Lucifer is in the preset, either Raphael's Alteration mode has been copied, and at least eight ultimate submode entries are copied; Nightmare ultimates and God Skills are enabled, ownership is available, and the Alteration menu can be opened. The menu checks base maximum MP ≥5.25 million; direct granting still charges normal Nodens acquisition cost, default 3.4 million with acquisition modifiers, then deducts another 4.25 million MP from the base maximum, reducing it no lower than zero. foxablazeaqzl_wiki.foxablazeaqzl_wiki.wiki.skill.tensura_tn:
Store weakened creatures in a spirit realm and summon a fighting party within your command capacity.

Active
[Active - Hold] Absorb: The target must have at most 20% of its maximum health. Its normal maximum EP must not exceed 50% / 62.5% / 75% / 87.5% / 100% of the player's normal maximum EP across Baby Spirit Fox, Fox Spirit Envoy, Spirit Fox Contract Master, Mystic Fox Master and Heavenly Fox Sovereign. The target remains free to act during the channel. An incoming attack against the caster or target, loss of line of sight, a target distance greater than 5 blocks, or releasing the skill key interrupts the channel. Health, EP and all capture eligibility conditions are checked again on completion. Costs 500 magicules. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

[Active - Press / Hold] Summon: Select a stored creature, then hold to summon it. The five stages allow 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 / 8 active creatures and provide 6 / 9 / 12 / 15 / 18 command slots. Both limits apply. Normal maximum health when deployed, including cultivation growth and fox-race health bonuses but ignoring temporary weakening, determines slot cost: up to 50 costs 1 slot; above 50 and up to 200 costs 3; above 200 and up to 1,000 costs 6. Creatures above 1,000 cannot be deployed. A powerful creature costing at least 6 slots is limited to one active summon of the same entity type. If growth, a race change or reloading puts the party over its current limits, excess summons are automatically recalled to the spirit realm; stored creatures and cultivation progress are preserved. Summoning costs 50% of the creature's base magicules plus 25% of its accumulated cultivation EP. Cooldown: 5 seconds.

Passive
[Passive] Cultivation: Kill-based growth remains, but kills no longer restore full health. Leveling restores only the newly gained maximum health, leaving existing wounds intact. Further growth has diminishing returns as accumulated cultivation EP rises; at 100,000 cultivation EP, marginal growth is 50% of its initial value. Growth has no hard cap, and the resulting strength counts toward summon costs and command capacity.

[Passive] Damage Sharing: Spirit Fox Contract Master, Mystic Fox Master and Heavenly Fox Sovereign can redirect 30% / 40% / 50% of incoming damage to summons within 16 blocks. The player's damage is reduced only by the amount actually taken by the summons; any unhandled damage remains on the player.

Restrictions and Changes
Blacklisted creatures can never be captured. Recognized bosses without explicit compatibility are denied by default and require the dedicated boss allowlist to be enabled. The server's vanilla-only and maximum-health rules still apply. Special creatures from other mods that expose neither boss tags nor boss bars may require additional pack-specific restrictions.

This revision lowers the capture threshold from half health to 20%, restricts stronger targets and repeated powerful creatures, adds maximum-health-based command capacity, and reduces cultivation healing and damage sharing.

Interaction and Changes

foxablazeaqzl_wiki.foxablazeaqzl_wiki.wiki.item.foxboss_leo:
Combat mechanics for Leon Cromwell.

Passive: Sword Guard
While able to fight and holding a sword in his main hand, Leon independently rolls a 70% guard chance for each physical hit from a player or another non-allied living attacker, fully negating that hit. Physical attacks follow Tensura's damage classification, including physical arrows fired by those attackers. Magic damage, environmental damage and allied attacks do not trigger sword guarding.

Guard Stance and Counters
Leon keeps his sword raised while pursuing an opponent and between attacks, looking for an opening. A successful guard during a sword attack preserves that attack and its contact timing, then he returns to his guard stance. Entering a contact guard interrupts charged casting. His existing magic and aura slash attacks do not interrupt an active defense sequence.
Contact motions include a frontal cross guard, a diagonal outward parry, a raised upper guard and a hanging guard, chosen randomly without consecutive repeats. The hanging guard raises his arm with the blade tip pointing down in front. Each complete contact motion lasts 0.60 seconds, followed by a 0.20-second walking interval with an upper-body sword guard before the next motion. Physical hits during these intervals retain their independent guard checks, metallic clashes, sparks and impact feedback without resetting the overall defense timer; direct melee attackers receive slight recoil. Leon pursues at a walking speed of 0.9 while defending and does not sprint.
A close opponent can be counterattacked only after at least two successful guards, at least three completed contact motions and at least 1.20 seconds of defense. Including the walking intervals, the earliest counter is 2.20 seconds after the first guard. The current contact motion must finish before the counter begins. With only one successful guard or an opponent too far away, Leon starts recovery after 2.40 seconds, retaining another 0.20 seconds of guarded pursuit and recovery. Each successful guard during this window still produces contact feedback.

Dodge
While guarding or between attacks, an incoming hit that was not guarded receives a 30% reactive dodge check. Leon steps left, right or back, avoids obstructed directions, and uses the same dash configuration, attributes and brief invulnerability rules as the player's V dodge. Defaults are a 1-second cooldown and 0.25 seconds of dodge invulnerability; the motion lasts 0.40 seconds. Dodge-bypassing damage and dodge-negation attributes remain effective. Sword swings are completed without repeatedly canceling attacks to dodge.

Attack Pace
Ordinary sword motions use a clock 1.6 times as fast, with synchronized impact timing. The cross combo shortens its wind-up and recovery while keeping 0.50 seconds between its two damage contacts so both cuts can land.

Changes
Retains an independent 70% guard chance per physical hit, all four contact motions and impact feedback. Complete contact motions now alternate with guarded walking intervals, and melee counters require at least three completed motions and two successful guards. Single-contact and distant cases use timed recovery. Leon walks while defending, repeated hits no longer refresh the overall defense duration, and his existing magic and aura slash attacks cannot take over the defense sequence.
foxablazeaqzl_wiki.foxablazeaqzl_wiki.wiki.skill.mortal_cul:
Transforms your body, allowing your spiritual body to survive after your physical body dies.

[Passive, Toggle] Body Transformation
Physical death turns you into a spiritual body, which does not vanish when MP runs out. In spiritual form, you cannot use Aura or deal physical damage.

[Active, Press] Possession
While in spiritual form, aim at an eligible target and press the skill key to possess it. Regain physical form and inherit the target's physical attributes and body-related intrinsic skills.
foxablazeaqzl_wiki.foxablazeaqzl_wiki.wiki.skill.foxablazeu:
Passive
Immune to poison.

[Passive, In Slot - Attack] Death Poison Creation
Attacks apply death poison without consuming MP. Base poison damage is twice that of Poison. The first application is guaranteed. Subsequent hits have a 5% chance to add a stack, up to 5 stacks; higher stacks increase poison damage. The initial duration is 30 seconds, and each successful additional stack adds 30 seconds.

[Weakness Identification - Hold]
Keep the same entity targeted for 3 seconds to complete the analysis, with Tensura casting progress displayed. Moving beyond analysis range or losing line of sight interrupts it. Costs 2,000 MP with no cooldown. The result is bound to that individual target for 30 seconds and shows a purple outline visible only to the caster. While it lasts, death poison applied to that target deals double damage and bypasses poison-immunity skills. Other entities of the same type must be analyzed separately.

[Death World - Hold]
Charge for 5 seconds with Tensura casting progress displayed as a connected pool of soft black-purple liquid gathers at your feet, then release automatically. Flowing patterns move across the continuous surface as its smooth edge spreads outward over the ground and follows steps in the terrain, reaching a radius of 100 blocks. The field lasts about 10 seconds; living entities that touch its liquid die immediately. The liquid fades out afterward. Costs 10,000 MP on successful release with a 60-second cooldown. Only the caster is exempt; other living entities, including allies, die on contact.

ftbchunks.ftbchunks.config.server.claiming.claim_d:
Blacklist for dimension ID's where chunks may not be claimed.
E.g. add "minecraft:the_end" to this list if you want to disable chunk claiming in The End
Wildcards are allowed, e.g. "othermod:*" matches all dimensions added by "othermod"

Whitelist for dimension ID's where chunks may be claimed. If non-empty, dimension *must* be in this list (and also not in "Dimension Blacklist".
Same syntax as for "Dimension Blacklist"
ftbchunks.ftbchunks.config.server.no_wilderness.to: If true, chunks must be claimed before they can be built on
ftbchunks.ftbchunks.config.server.no_wilderness_di:
List of dimension ID's where chunks must be claimed before modifying.
E.g. add "minecraft:the_nether" to require chunks to be claimed in the Nether.
Wildcards are allowed, e.g. "othermod:*" matches all dimensions added by "othermod"
ftbchunks.ftbchunks.config.server.claiming.max_idl:
If no team member logs in for this many days, the team's claims will be released.
Setting this to 0 disables auto-unclaiming.
ftbchunks.ftbchunks.config.server.force_loading.ma:
If no team member logs in for this many days, any force-loaded chunks will no longer be force-loaded.
Setting this to 0 disables auto-unforceloading.
ftbchunks.ftbchunks.config.server.long_range_track:
Interval in ticks to send updates to clients with long-range player tracking data.
Lower values mean more frequent updates but more server load and network traffic; be careful with this, especially on busy servers.
Setting this to 0 disables long-range tracking.
ftbchunks.ftbchunks.config.server.protect_unknown_:
Some explosion sources (e.g. Ghasts) can't be determined in code.
If this setting is true, damage from these explosion is prevented in protected chunks.
ftbchunks.ftbchunks.config.server.claiming.hard_te:
Hard claim limit for party teams, regardless of member count or Party Limit Calculation mode.
Default of 0 means no hard limit.
ftbchunks.ftbchunks.config.server.force_loading.ha:
Hard force-load limit for party teams, regardless of member count or Party Limit Calculation mode.
Default of 0 means no hard limit.
ftbchunks.ftbchunks.config.server.claiming.party_l:
Method by which party claim & force-load limits are calculated.
LARGEST: use the limits of the member with the largest limits
SUM: add up all the members' limits
OWNER: use the party owner's limits only
AVERAGE: use the average of all members' limits.
ftbchunks.ftbchunks.config.server.require_game_sta: If true, players must have the 'ftbchunks_mapping' game stage (KubeJS and/or Gamestages required) to be able to open the map or see the minimap
ftbchunks.ftbchunks.config.server.location_mode_ov: If true, team "Location Visibility" settings are ignored, and all players can see each other anywhere on the map
ftbchunks.ftbchunks.config.server.piston_protectio:
If true, pistons may not push/pull blocks across claims owned by different teams (unless the block is entering/leaving a claim with block edit mode set to Public)
If 'disable_protection' is set to true, this setting is ignored.
ftbchunks.ftbchunks.config.server.flowing_fluid_pr:
If true, fluids are prevented from flowing horizontally across claims owned by different teams (unless the target claim has public 'edit block' permissions defined).
False by default; enabling this can potentially lead to server performance issues, since fluid flow ticks are checked very frequently, especially for large bodies of flowing fluids
If 'disable_protection' is set to true, this setting is ignored.
ftbchunks.ftbchunks.config.server.fire_spread_prot:
If true, fire is prevented from spreading across claims owned by different teams (unless the target claim has public 'edit block' permissions defined).
False by default; enabling this can potentially lead to server performance issues, especially when many blocks are on fire
If 'disable_protection' is set to true, this setting is ignored.
ftbchunks.ftbchunks.config.server.fake_players.max: Fake Player Prevented Access Log Age

Age in days to keep logs of prevented fake player access
Note: not fully implemented feature; will be used in future to display & control access by fake players to your claims

Advanced filter intended for modders and modpack makers.
Fires a CustomFilterEvent when a match is attempted; set the event result to indicate a successful or failed match.
Use the textfield to provide freeform text data which is passed to the event as the 'data' parameter.
ftbfiltersystem.filter.ftbfiltersystem.expression.name: Expression

gnetum.gnetum.config.enabled.tooltip: Determines whether to enable Gnetum, which distributes HUD updates over multiple frames to improve performance.
gnetum.gnetum.config.showFps.tooltip: Adds a line to the upper-left corner of the F3 screen to show the HUD FPS.
gnetum.gnetum.config.downscale.tooltip: Uses a lower resolution for the HUD framebuffer based on current GUI scale. May cause HUDs to feel "blurry" and may not be compatible with all mods.
gnetum.gnetum.config.numberOfPasses.tooltip:
Specifies the total number of passes. Higher number provides better performance, but will make the HUD update slower.

The maximum framerate of the HUD will be the quotient of the game FPS divided by the number of passes.
gnetum.gnetum.config.maxFps.tooltip: Specifies the maximum framerate of the HUD. Priority is lower than the number of passes setting.
gnetum.gnetum.config.screenMaxFps.tooltip: When set to a lower value than the HUD Framerate Limit, allows temporarily reducing the HUD FPS when in GUI screens. This can help improve performance in GUIs.
gnetum.gnetum.config.confirmReset:
Are you sure you want to reset all the configurations?

Resetting the configurations might help solve some issues. However, this action cannot be undone.
gnetum.gnetum.config.tooltip.auto:
Gnetum will automatically decide whether to cache this element.

Current Status: %s
gnetum.gnetum.config.tooltip.on: Caching for this element is forcibly enabled.
gnetum.gnetum.config.tooltip.off: Caching for this element is forcibly disabled.
gnetum.gnetum.config.external.tooltip: Open the Gnetum config screen for more options, including control for element caching settings
gnetum.gnetum.config.analysis.good:
Gnetum is working properly.

When any performance issues are detected, they will show up here.

greatsage.gamerule.requireGreatSage: Require Great Sage for the Sage
greatsage.gamerule.announcementsRequireGreatSage.d: Skill announcements, ceremonies and evolutions only play for players who have the Unique Skill Great Sage. Off (default): everyone gets them. This does not give access to the menu: see requireGreatSage.
greatsage.gamerule.requireGreatSage.description: The G menu, assess mode, voice commands, analyses, the Sage's tips and growth experience need the Unique Skill Great Sage (or Raphael). Off: every player can use them without the skill.
greatsage.gamerule.sageInterface.description: The menu, the assess gaze, the voice and analysis. Turn this off and only skill announces and ceremonies remain.
greatsage.gamerule.sageShaderRendering: Shader rendering for the Great Sage
greatsage.gamerule.sageShaderRendering.description: On: the menu and every announcement (skills, evolutions, Demon Lord, Harvest Festival...) are drawn by shaders. Off: the classic menu and announcements. Both say and do the same things.
greatsage.gamerule.sageProgression.description: Great Sage starts limited and grows: only intrinsic and common skills can be analysed until you open the rest. Turn this off to have everything unlocked from the start, the way it worked before.
greatsage.gamerule.sageReincarnation.description: Replaces Tensura's reincarnation screen with the Voice of the World scene. Off gives you the original screen, untouched.
