greatsage.greatsage.sigil.angle.reading: One true angle, and nothing crooked.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.bolt.reading: A strike that changes its mind twice.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.circle.reading: A shape that closes on itself.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.cloud.reading: Soft edges, all the way around.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.coil.reading: Loops that go somewhere, and lose the way.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.crenel.reading: Up, across, down. Again, in order.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.crescent.reading: Half the light, and all the sleep.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.crown.reading: Three points, raised for no one else.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.cup.reading: Open above, waiting to be filled.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.diamond.reading: Four sides, standing on a point.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.dome.reading: A curve resting on a straight line.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.drop.reading: Round, with a single point. Something is simmering.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.folly.reading: This is not a wish. It is not even a question. Very well — you have chosen for yourself.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.gate.reading: Something laid over everything, pressing down.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.heart.reading: A shape everyone knows. Why this one?
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.hook.reading: A stroke that comes back to look.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.huge.reading: A gesture that takes everything there is.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.lasso.reading: A line that ends by catching something.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.line.reading: A stroke that does not stop.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.loop.reading: A stroke that turns once around itself, and goes on.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.maze.reading: Corners turning inward, with no way out.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.peak.reading: A point that leads the way.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.polygon.reading: More sides than needed, all counted.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.rebound.reading: It went, and came back the same way.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.ring.reading: The same circle, twice. It was meant.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.serpent.reading: It bends one way, then the other.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.shield.reading: Flat on top, and it will not bend.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.slash.reading: The line, drawn the other way.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.small.reading: Almost nothing. It is still something.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.stab.reading: A stroke that goes down and stays down.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.star.reading: Points, so that it is seen.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.sweep.reading: A gesture that takes the whole room.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.triangle.reading: Three sides, and nothing gets through.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.twin.reading: Two summits, and a fall between them.
greatsage.greatsage.sigil.wander.reading: A path that will not decide.

greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.title: What's new
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.1.title: Shader rendering: a new face for the Sage
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.1.desc: On by default. The Sage's console replaces the menu and every announce is redrawn. /gamerule sageShaderRendering false brings back the classic look.
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.2.title: Ceremonies as real scenes
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.2.desc: Harvest Festival, Demon Lord Seed, Hero Egg, True Hero and the True Demon Lord awakening are now full-screen scenes with their own ambience. Nothing can hurt or push you while they play.
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.3.title: Raphael's evolution, remade
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.3.desc: Rebuilt shot by shot from episode 35.
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.4.title: The Sea of Souls
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.4.desc: A new reincarnation scene: draw your wishes above a lake of souls under the stars.
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.5.title: Skill fusion
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.5.desc: When skills merge into a Unique or an Ultimate, they slam into your screen as anime skill cards, the screen shatters, and the shards come back together as the new skill.
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.6.title: Naming, as a cutscene
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.6.desc: Name a monster and the camera pulls to the side: your magicules flow into it and it lights up as it absorbs them. Then the Sage reports the name, and the Voice of the World confirms its evolution. Players who get named see it from their side. Turn it off with namingScene in the client config.
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.7.title: Thought Acceleration (H)
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.7.desc: With the Great Sage or Thought Acceleration, press H or say it: the world freezes into cold colors, sounds drag down, your heartbeat takes over and incoming projectiles show their path, red if it hits you. Solo: the whole world slows x5. Multiplayer: a 20-block bubble slows creatures and projectiles. 6 s, 40 s cooldown, both configurable.
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.8.title: Magic Sense (N)
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.8.desc: With a sense skill such as Magic Sense, see the aura of every being, shaped like its body. Its color follows its alignment (violet Majin, white-gold Hero, red Chaos, green neutral), its size follows its EP and keeps growing: a massive aura in the distance means run. Tune it in Settings.
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.9.title: Growth comes faster
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.9.desc: Experience gains x1.5, the first kill of a species counts as observing it, and items you hold for the first time are appraised.
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.10.title: Analysis opens locked modes
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.10.desc: Skills that keep modes sealed (Sloth, Black Lightning...) open them when the Sage analyses them. FoxAblaze Ultimate's Raphael counts as the Sage.
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.11.title: Gamerules, clearer
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.11.desc: needGreatSage is now announcementsRequireGreatSage: it only decides who gets the announcements. New: requireGreatSage (on by default). Turn it off and everyone can use the G menu, assess, voice commands and analyses without the Great Sage skill.
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.12.title: Clearer menus
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.12.desc: Bigger buttons, the Sage's bubble no longer covers the pages, and a sealed class tells you to open it in the Growth tree.
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.13.title: Fixes
greatsage.greatsage.whatsnew.0_0_7.13.desc: Reincarnation no longer hands out special addon Uniques, and addon resistances are no longer always Nuclear or Void. Assess bubbles no longer drift when flying, auras no longer get stuck in a capsule shape with some mods, and the freeze before animations is gone. Server admins get /greatsage xp. Voice commands now work with microphones that refuse 16 kHz, and the menu's background hum is much quieter. The Portuguese and Turkish voice models install properly, menu text no longer shows through confirmation windows, a full reset now gives every Unique Tensura owes you from the reset counter, and you no longer stay invulnerable after a rare reincarnation outcome.

kaleidoscope_cookery.kaleidoscope_cookery.ponder.shawarma_spi: Ingredients can be placed into both the upper and lower layers of the shawarma spit.
Each layer can hold up to 8 smeltable food items of the same type.
Provide a redstone signal to activate the spit and start cooking.
Then, wait for a period of time...
However, it burns if the food is removed with bare hands from an activated shawarma spit.
A safer method is to use a kitchen knife to remove the food...
...or to deactivate the shawarma spit before attempting to remove the food.
When there are ingredients inside a wok or stockpot, right click with a blank recipe to record its contents.
At a later time, right click the wok or stockpot with the recipe again. This will add all of the recorded ingredients on the recipe using items from your inventory.

lambdynlights.lambdynlights.option.chunk_rebuild_sched:
Defines how the mod rebuilds chunks.
• %s (recommended): Chunks are rebuilt only when deemed necessary. May cause extremely rare visual glitches.

Changes to this setting will only take effect after saving and quitting.

modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.async_jei: 1.16 only. **A key optimization.** Patches JEI to perform its reloading on a background thread, completely eliminating the long delay it adds to world loading.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.async_locato: 1.16 only. Backports the Async Locator mod's patches to eliminate server freezes associated with `/locate`, loot table generation, etc.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.biome_zoomer: 1.16 only. Minor optimization to improve the performance of the biome zoomer using logic from 1.18.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.blast_search: All versions. If REI or JEI are installed, construction of the vanilla search trees for creative searching is disabled, and searching is instead done using these mods' search implementations. This saves several seconds during world loading, and probably also saves some RAM as well (although I have not measured).
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.boost_worker: 1.16 only. Removes the hardcoded cap on worker thread count, similarly to what Mojang did in 1.18.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.cache_blocks: All versions. Avoids creating fresh copies of enum arrays each time a blockstate cache is initialized. Minor optimization, but easy to do.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.cache_model_: All versions. Memoizes the `RenderMaterial` (texture) collection and dependency list that models return instead of requiring them to be recalculated on each request. Helps accelerate the model load/bake process.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.cache_strong: All versions. Saves the generated list of stronghold positions with the world, instead of regenerating it on every world load. Saves a little bit of time on 1.16, and quite a bit more on 1.18 and 1.19.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.cache_upgrad: All versions. Many mods ship outdated structure files, which requires the game to upgrade them using DFU every single time they are loaded. This can be quite slow. This patch adds logic to instead save the upgraded version of the structure, and reuse it on the next load. To handle the case that the mod changes a structure file but not the name, the original file's hash is compared against the cached version, and if they do not match the structure will be upgraded again.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.compress_bio: 1.16 only. Minor optimization borrowed from Hydrogen, which attempts to save space in the biome container when possible. This gets disabled automatically if conflicting mods like BetterEnd or Chocolate are installed.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.datapack_rel: All versions. Reduces log spam and possibly slightly improves loading speed by not printing the stacktraces for some commonly thrown exceptions during datapack reload (e.g. missing items in loot tables/recipes). The message is still printed.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.dedicated_re: All versions. Moves resource pack and data pack reloading to a dedicated worker pool instead of using the default `Worker-Main` threads. This allows mods to Smooth Boot to still potentially improve singleplayer performance at runtime while not slowing down launch due to a limited thread count.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.deduplicate_: All versions, but disabled by default due to load time impact. Deduplicates resource location namespaces and paths. This saves RAM but also increases the cost of constructing a new `ResourceLocation` by quite a bit.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.dynamic_dfu:
All versions. Modifies DFU initialization to happen the first time something needs to be upgraded. This sounds similar to LazyDFU but is distinctly implemented, as it avoids loading *any* DFU classes/data structures, while LazyDFU only disables rule optimization. Essentially, this option is a safer version of DataFixerSlayer as it will still load DFU when needed.

You should typically continue to use LazyDFU even with this option enabled, as otherwise DFU rule optimization will cause lag.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.dynamic_soun: All versions. Allows the game to unload sounds, instead of sounds indefinitely persisting after being loaded.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.dynamic_stru: All versions. Allows the game to unload structure files after generation concludes instead of keeping them loaded forever.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.fast_registr: All versions. Forge needlessly looks up a method via reflection every single time a registry is validated. This patch simply caches the returned value since it will be the same every time.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.faster_font_: All versions. Optimizes the font renderer to load fonts faster, speeding up resource reload.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.faster_item_:
All versions. Avoids rendering the sides of items in GUIs. (Yes, vanilla appears to do that.)

This can triple FPS with a mod like REI/JEI installed on weaker GPUs, if enough items are visible. Disabled by default since it's new and not tested much, but should be safe. The most likely issue is items being completely invisible in GUIs, or appearing flat in the world.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.faster_textu: All versions pre 1.19.4. Avoids reading textures twice (the first time using a very slow code path) and instead does one faster load (similar to 1.19.3+).

All versions. Enables the game to use a faster texture stitching system originally written by SuperCoder79 for lwjgl3ify on 1.7.10, which can save some time during loading. Rarely, it's been reported to cause weird artifacts on blocks or in GUIs, this may be a Sodium bug.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.jeresources_: 1.16 only. Optimizes Just Enough Resources to not needlessly recreate villager entities many times for the same profession, which saves time during JEI startup.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.kubejs: 1.16 only. Optimizations to KubeJS to avoid needless `ItemStack` copying, etc., which reduces the time taken to load datapacks.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.model_optimi: All versions. Implements optimizations to speed up the model loading process.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.nbt_memory_u: All versions. Uses a more efficient backing map for compound NBT tags that deduplicates key names and also uses an array map for very small compounds. This reduces the overhead of storing many compound tags in memory.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.nuke_empty_c: 1.16 only, inspired by Hydrogen. Avoids storing chunk sections that are full of air in memory, instead marking them as empty.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.reduce_block:
All versions. **A key optimization.** Newer Minecraft versions (after 1.12) implemented a blockstate cache system that caches frequently used information about a blockstate, such as whether it is solid, its collision shape, etc. Rebuilding this cache is quite fast in vanilla (it takes only a second or two) but is quite slow with many mods installed, as there are many more blockstates present in the game which all must have their caches rebuilt.

This problem is exacerbated by Forge as the cache is rebuilt at many points when the data would almost certainly be unused before the next rebuild. Examples include right before reaching the main menu (during the "Freezing data" stage), as well as multiple (!) times when a world is being loaded.

ModernFix solves this performance bottleneck by instead making cache rebuilds lazy. Each blockstate rebuilds its cache the first time the data would be accessed. At any point when vanilla or Forge would attempt to rebuild caches for all blockstates, this is redirected to simply invalidate the cache on each blockstate instead.

This should not have any impact on TPS after startup concludes.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.remove_biome: All versions. Removes the biome temperature cache as Lithium does on modern versions.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.resourcepack:
All versions. **A key optimization.** Launches on modern versions are heavily bottlenecked by filesystem access. Many requests are frequently made to resource packs to list resources or check if a given resource exists, and each of these result in a very slow file API call.

ModernFix completely eliminates most of the bottleneck here by simply caching a listing of all resources that exist within mod-provided and vanilla resourcepacks. The cache is rebuilt on resource reload (except for the vanilla resources, since they should never change while the game is running).

There are no known compatibility issues with this patch except for OptiFine (its CTM resources do not load correctly). However I do not recommend using OptiFine in any scenario, as it adds several minutes to launch time by itself and is not tested with ModernFix at all.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.reuse_datapa: 1.16 only. Attempts to speed up switching between singleplayer worlds by skipping the datapack reload when possible. May cause compatibility issues with some mods, but is currently enabled by default.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.rewrite_regi: All versions. **Currently semi-broken.** Aggressively replaces some internals of the Forge registry system with faster versions, however it currently causes freezes when loading some modpacks. Off by default for obvious reasons.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.skip_first_d:
1.16 & 1.19 only. **A key optimization.**

In the middle of the 1.16 development cycle, Forge patched the game to reload datapacks twice when loading an existing world, in order to fix an issue with biome ID shifting. Unfortunately, datapack reloads often take upwards of 30 seconds and so this very severely affects world loading times.

ModernFix makes the necessary changes to avoid this reload, based on the unfinished Forge PR #8163.

This change was removed by Forge in 1.18, but then a similar patch was added *again* in 1.19 to fix mod datapacks not being loaded when creating new singleplayer worlds. Fortunately, the issue is localized to the world creation screen in 1.19, and existing worlds only require a single reload. However, this still doubles the length of the lag spike when clicking "Create New World" in 1.19, and so ModernFix again makes changes to not perform a redundant reload.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.state_defini: All versions. Enabled only if FerriteCore is installed. Takes advantage of FerriteCore's handling of blockstates to speed up their creation. This can help speed up launch with mods that add lots of blockstates, such as furniture mods.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.sync_executo: All versions. Avoids having the main thread spin idly consuming one CPU core while waiting for the modloading workers to finish.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.thread_prior: All versions. Adjusts the worker and server thread priorities to be lower than the client thread. This helps improve FPS stability on machines with few CPU cores, provided that the Java implementation in use respects priorities.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.use_integrat: Mostly for 1.16. Patches JEResources to use the integrated server's loot table data if playing singleplayer, rather than pointlessly reloading loot tables. Saves a couple more seconds during JEI startup.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.concurrenc: The patches in this group fix concurrency-related issues within Minecraft and/or Forge. Most of them result in rare, hard-to-diagnose crashes during loading.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.edge_chunk: This option is a port of SuperCoder's Chunk Saving Fix mod (because I didn't realize it was already available for Forge at the time).
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.mc218112: This option fixes a deadlock that can occur if an exception is thrown while processing entity data. Vanilla does not correctly unlock the data manager when it should. This is tracked as MC-218112 on the bug tracker, and was fixed by Mojang in 1.17.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.packet_lea: **Experimental**, not enabled by default. An attempted fix for the memory leak issue that occurs after playing long enough on 1.16.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.paper_chun: 1.18 and newer. **A key optimization.** Ports a patch from Paper that fixes issues on 1.17 with chunkloading requiring huge amounts of memory and generating many `CompletableFuture` instances. 1.18+ are now able to load worlds on only 400MB of memory like 1.16 could.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.tf_cme_on_: Patches Twilight Forest to perform non-thread-safe client setup using the main thread as it should, rather than the FML worker thread.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.feature.branding: Adds ModernFix to the branding list on the title screen, and also to the F3 screen.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.feature.direct_st: Normally off, can be enabled to force the raw stack trace to be dumped to the log when a crash occurs. Occasionally vanilla's crash report system fails to work properly and gives an entirely irrelevant stack trace/report.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.feature.measure_t: Uses a couple injections to measure world load time, datapack reload time, resource reload time, bootstrap time, and adds the necessary hooks to enable vanilla's unused profiler logic for resource reloading if so configured.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.feature.spam_thre: **To be used for debugging purposes only.** Causes a thread dump to be output to the log every 60 seconds. This can help to diagnose unexplained freezes during loading/gameplay.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.chunk_dead: Attempts to prevent chunk system deadlocks or provide additional debug information in the log when they occur. These deadlocks usually manifest as the server freezing indefinitely (e.g. entities not moving), while the client continues to work just fine.
Patches Valhesia Structures to fix an issue in its code that causes frequent worldgen/chunkloading deadlocks.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.cofh_core_: Fixes a multithreading issue in CoFH Core that can cause rare crashes during launch.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.ctm_resour: Fixes a multithreading issue in ConnectedTexturesMod that can cause rare crashes during launch.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.ender_drag: Fixes a memory leak in vanilla caused by the ender dragon retaining a reference to the previous client world.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.entity_loa: Fixes many issues where EntityJoinWorldEvent/EntityJoinLevelEvent cause a worldgen deadlock, by slightly deferring entity loading. Should not, however, cause any noticeable behavior changes in-game.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.fix_config: Fixes Forge configs occasionally becoming corrupted when launching the game.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.preserve_e: Makes the game window retain its existing size when control is handed over from Forge's early loading to Minecraft code. Fixes the window teleporting back to the center of the screen after being dragged, etc.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.refinedsto: Fixes Refined Storage external storage blocks occasionally failing to show contents of drawers, etc. when loaded. Backport of Refined Storage PR #3435, which was only applied to 1.18 and later.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.remove_blo: Fixes zombie pigmen keeping the 0, 0 chunk loaded perpetually on Forge. Backport of Forge PR #8583.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.starlight_: Fixes an occasional Starlight crash due to emptiness maps not being initialized. Backport of the same fix in Starlight for 1.18.x.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.core: Core patches required for ModernFix to work
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.devenv: Patches used when running in a development environment, for speed improvement and/or testing
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.safety: Concurrency patches to prevent crashes during launch
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.feature.integrate: Adds the vanilla watchdog to singleplayer worlds as well, but just prints out the stacktraces rather than forcefully terminating the world. This version includes the functionality of Fullstack Watchdog, but the latter is still needed for multiplayer.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.feature.snapshot_: Adds easter egg features (does not affect any vanilla visuals or behavior) when running on a snapshot version.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.feature.spark_pro: If enabled, and a compatible version of Spark is installed, the entire launch sequence will be profiled until the main menu.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.feature.warn_miss: Shows a warning on startup if other performance mods considered essential and highly compatible are not present
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.launch.class_sear: Replaces Forge's resource finder (used to find game and a mod code) with a significantly faster version, speeding up launch
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.clear_fabric: Reduces memory usage by clearing mapping data structures in Fabric Loader that are either redundant or rarely used by mods. Off by default for compatibility reasons.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.clear_mixin_: Force-loads all mixins when launch finishes and then clears out mixin data structures to remove most of Mixin's memory footprint. Disabled by default for compatibility reasons.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.deduplicate_: Makes most wall blocks share the same shape object instead of each one having its own copy. Can reduce memory usage substantially when lots of wall blocks are added by mods.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.dynamic_reso: AE2 compatibility patch for dynamic resources
CTM compatibility patch for dynamic resources
LDLib compatibility patch for dynamic resources
Refined Storage compatibility patch for dynamic resources
SuperMartijn642CoreLib compatibility patch for dynamic resources
Diagonal Fences compatibility patch for dynamic resources
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.faster_advan: Rewrites the advancement checking logic to be faster and not cause StackOverflowError in large packs. Port of Advancements Debug from Fabric.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.patchouli_de: Fix Patchouli books storing many empty items with NBT tags, reducing memory usage.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.remove_spawn: Completely removes spawn chunks from the game. They are no longer loaded at all, unlike Ksyxis.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.blueprint_: Fixes Blueprint's ObjectModificationManager leaking vanilla resources, reducing memory usage. Despite the fix being contributed in PR #195 a release was not yet made.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.removed_di: Fixes the game failing to load worlds if dimension mods are removed. Backport of Forge PR #8959.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.compact_bit_: Fixes memory waste caused by some legacy servers (e.g. Hypixel) sending empty chunks as if they contain blocks. Reduces memory usage significantly on these servers.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.deduplicate_: Deduplicates climate parameter objects used by the new biome system, can save ~2MB but also slows down datapack reload somewhat.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.dynamic_enti: Constructs entity models the first time they are seen instead of during launch. Some mods are not compatible with this option and will cause EntityRenderer crashes.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.twilightfore: Fixes lag caused by Twilight Forest worldgen checking structures very inefficiently
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.fast_forge_d: Speeds up Forge registry freezing during launch by using a faster code path
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.tag_id_cachi: Speeds up uses of tag entries by caching the location object instead of recreating it every time
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.compress_uni: Stores the glyphs for the Unicode font more efficiently. Kudos to @AnAwesomGuy for the trick.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.world_leak: Reduces the memory usage of old client-side worlds that aren't needed after switching dimensions. These are normally garbage collected in vanilla, but mods sometimes retain references to them.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.compact_moja: (Fabric) Experimental option that reduces the memory usage of registries by roughly 50%. Not useful in most modpacks unless they contain millions of blocks and items.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.dynamic_bloc: Avoids storing a codec for every block(state) and instead generates and caches it on the fly when needed. Generally not worth enabling unless you have a million blocks/items.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.faster_comma: Mitigate lag when there are hundreds of thousands of suggestions while typing a command
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.mojang_regis: Fixes an issue causing registration of blocks/items to slow down proportional to the number already registered. This improves startup time.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.cache_profil: Avoids pointlessly creating a URL object and speeds up skull block rendering.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.entity_pos: Fixes Forge issue #9118, where mods can cause undebuggable render crashes by pushing the matrix stack without popping it.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.file_dialo: Fixes a security issue with the worldgen settings file dialog
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.forge_vehi: Fixes a bug introduced by a Forge patch that causes excessive amounts of chunk data packets to be sent to the player if they are riding a vehicle on a chunk border.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.mantle_mod: Fixes a bug in Mantle that can cause random ConcurrentModificationException crashes when rendering Tinkers Construct content.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.model_data: Works around design flaws in the Forge ModelDataManager system that can cause unexpected concurrency issues.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.recipe_boo: Fixes Forge clients being disconnected when connecting to a vanilla server if mods add custom recipe book entry types.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.unsafe_mod: Fixes various ConcurrentModificationExceptions that can occur in content mods when computing block shapes
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.feature.stalled_c: This option may help to detect the cause of chunkloading freezes. However, leaving it enabled may cause slightly worse performance.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.fix_loop_spi: Fixes Minecraft's built-in wait function consuming excessive amounts of CPU resources.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.forge_cap_re: Small micro-optimization that makes retrieving custom entity data slightly more efficient on Forge.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.forge_regist: Fixes oversights in Forge that lead to excessive allocation in hot registry methods.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.restore_ol: Fixes MC-272431, which tracks the ender dragon being unable to dive to the portal as it did in 1.13 and older. This causes the dragon to fly quite a bit differently from what modern players are used to and also patches out one-cycling, so it's not enabled by default. Thanks to Jukitsu for identifying the regression in the vanilla code.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.missing_bl: Hypixel sends chunks to the client that are missing some block entity data, which makes chests etc. appear invisible. This 'fixes' the problem by creating the needed data on the client. Has no effect for properly behaved servers or in singleplayer.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.buffer_bui: Attempts to work around mods constructing BufferBuilder objects that leak memory. This can cause the JVM to crash with an hs_err_pid file in some rare cases. If you experience this type of crash, try disabling this option.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.extra_expe: Fixes the experimental feature warning being shown still being shown the first time you reopen a world that was created as experimental.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.forge_at_i: Fixes a major oversight in Forge's early error handling code that causes some parts of mods to load, but not others, which usually results in the game crashing rather than displaying the intended error screen. This issue was fixed in NeoForge, and eventually fixed in new enough versions of Forge.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.bugfix.world_scre: Fixes MC-251068, where deleting the last world takes you back to an empty world list.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.feature.blockenti: **This is a debug option and should not be enabled for regular gameplay.** Attempts to detect mods interacting with block entities on the wrong thread and crash the game with more information, rather than an unclear ConcurrentModificationException
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.feature.cause_lag: Disables the game's use of worker threads for the server and for chunk rendering. **This will make performance worse on almost all hardware**, and should only be enabled on a client, when you know exactly what you are doing, and probably only on hardware with very few (2 or less) physical CPU cores. In those rare cases, it can reduce lag spikes since there is less contention over the limited cores.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.feature.registry_: Runs the Forge loading screen on a background thread for part of the loading process, to allow progress to be shown while content is being registered. May have compatibility issues with some GPU drivers (e.g. macOS), so do not enable it by default in a modpack.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.feature.remove_ch: Prevents the Minecraft client from obtaining the keypair for chat signing. This disables the client's ability to sign chat messages (like No Chat Reports, but in a simpler, albeit less user-friendly way).
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.feature.remove_te: Prevents the Minecraft client from sending telemetry to Mojang. The telemetry is generally not relevant to them anyway for a modded instance.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.chunk_meshin: Implements some minor optimizations to the vanilla chunk meshing logic (they will have no effect with a mod that replaces chunk rendering entirely).
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.faster_struc: Improves the speed at which structures like buried treasure can be located.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.forge_regist: Fixes more oversights in Forge that lead to excessive allocation in hot registry methods.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.memoize_crea: Improves on vanilla's existing caching for creative tab contents in a way that is compatible with the timing requirements of mods like JEI/EMI. This can reduce the lag spike when opening the creative inventory for the first time in a modpack.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.potential_sp: Optimizes the Forge event for finding potential mobs that can spawn. This reduces allocations and the overhead of rebuilding a weighted list when no mods modify the potential spawns.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.ticking_chun: Optimizes chunk ticking in vanilla to reduce allocations.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.perf.worldgen_all: Optimizes some world generation logic in vanilla to reduce object allocations.
modernfix.modernfix.option.mixin.feature.suppress_: Prevents the game from logging a very long stacktrace when the narrator fails to load on Linux (usually caused by not having libflite installed).

morerelics.amulet.morerelics.amulet_transforms: The amulet shifts and warps, its base expanding as an ethereal light begins to seep through.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.whispering_amulet.descrip: Tendrils of pure light unfurl from the amulet, twisting and thrashing with frantic energy as if they are reaching for something just beyond the veil, a place they desperately seek.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.whispering_amulet.ability: The amulet hums softly, its whispers winding through your mind, guiding you toward a place it insists you must go.
morerelics.amulet.morerelics.amulet_ascends: The amulet transcends its shell, revealing the power it was always meant to hold.
morerelics.whisper.morerelics.ascend: Bring me to %s. Let us ascend together.
morerelics.whisper.morerelics.pull: Can you feel the pull? Lead me to %s.
morerelics.whisper.morerelics.clear_path: The path is clear, %s. Make your way to %s.
morerelics.__morerelics.comment_for_translators1: Hello, do not translate this. This is a comment for translators. The first %s above is the players name and the second one is the cords.
morerelics.whisper.morerelics.destiny: The world seems to hold its breath, as though waiting for us to act. Accompany me the way to the place where destiny lies at %s.
morerelics.whisper.morerelics.rude: Do not delay our ascension any longer, %s. Go to %s NOW.
morerelics.__morerelics.comment_for_translators2: Same goes for the above, name then cords.
morerelics.whisper.morerelics.wrong_dimension1: The path to ascension does not exist in this place... Return to the dimension where our journey first began.
morerelics.whisper.morerelics.wrong_dimension2: We cannot ascend in this place... Lead us back to our home dimension.
morerelics.whisper.morerelics.wrong_dimension3: Ascension is impossible here... Bring us back to the dimension we call home.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.made_in_heaven.descriptio: The amulet has unlocked its full potential, transforming into its true form. It now seems to share a bond with you.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.made_in_heaven.ability.as:
Made in Heaven channels its power into you, increasing all your stats by %1$sX.
Hitting an enemy grants Accelerating, stacking up to 10 times. Each stack boosts all stats except health by 0.03X. Gaining stacks has a %2$s second cooldown and all stacks expire after a short duration of not attacking.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.made_in_heaven.ability.ze:
While at 10 Accelerating stacks gain an additional %2$sX stat boost and automatically revive with half your maximum HP when you die.
Triggering the revive puts it on cooldown for %1$s seconds and consumes all Accelerating stacks.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.made_in_heaven.leveling_s: The amulet is happy to spend time with you, granting it 1 experience per second. This experience is not shared with other relics.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.made_in_heaven.ability.co:
Upon activation, unleash holy fire in a cone, dealing %2$s damage, burning enemies and applying Charred for a duration.
Charred causes affected enemies to take 1 extra damage per level from all sources.
Cooldown: %1$s seconds.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.made_in_heaven.ability.di:
Upon activation, rise into the air and after a short delay engulf everything within a 7-block radius in holy fire, dealing up to %1$s damage over 5 seconds in 5 increasing hits and burning enemies. The last 3 hits apply and stack Charred.
You gain 60% damage reduction while casting this ability.
This ability can only be used while you have 10 Accelerating stacks and has a cooldown of %2$s seconds.
morerelics.tooltip.morerelics.made_in_heaven.zenith: Zenith has shielded you from death and is now on cooldown.
Zenith is ready to revive again.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.mass_gauntlet.description: A gauntlet with a massive iron ball affixed to it, designed to force the user's body to move in sync with their strikes. This unique design amplifies the power of each attack as the user's weight is channeled into every blow.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.mass_gauntlet.ability.hea: Your attacks deal %1$s% of your maximum health as extra damage.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.mass_gauntlet.leveling_so: The gauntlet gains 2 experince every time you attack.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.eject_button.description: A yellow box with a red, glowing button. Engineered for "heroic and tactical" retreats.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.eject_button.ability.nope: Grants %1$sX speed when the user's health falls below 20%.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.shieldweave_cape.descript: A cape woven with steel-like threads that adjust to the wearer's armor, covering weak spots.
The cape hardens upon impact, blocking the hit with %1$s% + %2$s% * armor chance (max 33%).
The cape covers your weak spots, increasing your armor by %1$s%.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.shieldweave_cape.leveling: The cape gains 2 experince every time it blocks an attack.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.axolotl_cream.description: A light pink cream. Enhances healing and smells like strawberries.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.axolotl_cream.ability.men: Increases healing from any source by %1$sX.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.axolotl_cream.leveling_so: The cream gains 2 experience every time you heal.
morerelics.tooltip.morerelics.axolotl_cream.source: Don't ask how it is made
morerelics.tooltip.relics.sentient_rust.description: A cluster of Ferro Comedenti fungi, a rare species of fungus which rapidly corrodes metal on contact. Commonly known as 'Sentient Rust' for its reddish hue.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.sentient_rust.ability.cor: Applies an armor-corroding effect for %1$s seconds. Consecutive hits refresh the duration and stack the effect (up to 10 times). Each stack reduces armor by %5.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.sentient_rust.leveling_so: The fungi gain 1 experience every time you attack.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.opal_necklace.description: A silver necklace adorned with a small opal stone, traditionally gifted to travelers and soldiers venturing into barren lands, symbolizing a wish for their safety and protection.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.opal_necklace.ability.bub: Protects from all damage once, then goes on cooldown for %1$s.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.opal_necklace.leveling_so: The necklace gains 5 experience every time you block an attack with it.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.tyrant_mask.description: A brass mask once worn by a forgotten tyrant. Though his soul is long gone the mask still brims with malice, drawing restless spirits and trapping them within its dark influence.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.tyrant_mask.ability.regre: The trapped souls within the mask hinder you, lowering your speed, damage, and attack speed by %1$s%.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.tyrant_mask.ability.monot: The souls trapped within the mask regret avoiding change and living a monotonous life. Perhaps travelling with them could soothe their longing for adventure.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.tyrant_mask.ability.reven: The souls trapped within the mask crave for revenge against the monsters that slayed them. Perhaps hunting monsters with them could soothe their fury.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.tyrant_mask.ability.futil: The souls trapped within the mask carry the sorrow of a life spent without leaving a lasting mark. Maybe building with them will help soothe their need to create.
morerelics.tooltip.morerelics.tyrant_mask_freed: The trapped souls within the mask are freed.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.king_crimson.description: Freed souls burst out of the mask, changing its color and leaving a strange hole in the middle. When you look into the hole you can't see the bottom but the other side looks solid.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.king_crimson.ability.epit: Distorts time and space, rewinding you to your position from 10 seconds ago. %1$s seconds cooldown.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.king_crimson.ability.talk:
Your attacks disrupt your target's mind, applying Weakness and Slowness with a %2$s% chance for %1$s seconds. If the target is another player Static is also applied for half the duration.
Your first attack after Epitaph always triggers this effect.

Static makes players unable to see other mobs and players while it is active.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.king_crimson.ability.the_: The Court Of The Crimson King

When you attack, if your maximum health is more than or equal to your target's maximum health and their health is below %1$s%, they are instantly executed. If your target has more maximum health than you they instead take double damage below this threshold.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.king_crimson.leveling_sou: This relic gains 20 experience every time you use Epitaph
This relic gains 2 experience every time a status effect is applied
The Court Of The Crimson King
This relic gains 3 experience every time a target is executed
morerelics.tooltip.relics.crown_of_the_legend.descr: This crown embodies courage. Those who wear it inherit the legacy of a true legend, unshaken in the face of any challenge.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.crown_of_the_legend.abili: Increases your damage against pig based mobs by %1$sX.

Grants life-steal scaling with damage and missing health.
(1-(Current Health)/(Maximum Health)) * Damage * %1$s
morerelics.tooltip.relics.crown_of_the_legend.level: This relic gains 5 experience every time a pig based mob is attacked
morerelics.tooltip.relics.bionic_eye.description: A high-tech eye implant that grants the wearer the ability to seek and track targets, highlighting them even through obstacles.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.bionic_eye.ability.seeker:
When activated applies Glowing and Vulnerability effects on enemies in %1$s block radius for %2$s seconds. %3$s seconds cooldown.
While cyberpsychosis is active: Has reduced cooldown and applies Vulnerability 2 instead.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.bionic_eye.leveling_sourc: This relics gains 10 experience every time you use Seeker.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.bionic_eye.ability.cyberp:
Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger Cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.thermoseismic_heart.descr: A high-tech heart implant that converts movement and vibrations into energy, powering itself and recharging its internal batteries.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.thermoseismic_heart.abili: Explosions do not harm the user and instead grant a stack of Overload for %1$s seconds, with a maximum of 4 stacks.

When activated, it releases a stream of heat in a %1$s block radius, dealing %2$s damage. Stacks of Overload are consumed to amplify the fire's power and range.
While cyberpsychosis is active: The fire triggers as if the user has 2 Overload stacks when they have less and the Overload stacks are not consumed.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.thermoseismic_heart.level: This relics gains 5 experience every time you use Thermal Discharge.
This relics gains 20 experience every time explosion damage is blocked.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.thermoseismic_heart.abili:
Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.biojoint.description: A high-tech joint implant that absorbs impact and reduces damage, providing extra protection against physical stress.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.biojoint.ability.suspensi:
Reduces damage based on the amount taken, ranging from a maximum of %2$s% to a minimum of %1$s% reduction. The maximum reduction is achieved when the damage taken is equal to users max health or more.
While Cyberpsychosis is active: Damage reduction is always at maximum.
If multiple copies are equipped, damage reduction cannot exceed 50%.
This relics gains 3 experience every time you get hit.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.biojoint.ability.cyberpsy:
Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger Cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.whims_of_fate.description: A cursed die that draws strength from its wielder's despair and suffering, promising salvation while demanding agony in return.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.whims_of_fate.ability.jus: Whenever the user is hit, rolls a 20-sided die. Each number above 1 increases damage reduction by %1$s%. A 20 cancels all damage, a 1 doubles it.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.whims_of_fate.leveling_so: This relics gains 2 experience every time you roll the dice.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.depleted_spool.descriptio: Once able to regenerate threads that could alter reality, this spool has lost its power. Now silent and empty, it stands as a relic of forgotten potential.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.depleted_spool.ability.re: The spool's powers can be restored by holding the required items while wearing it, reawakening its ability to regenerate reality-altering threads.
morerelics.tooltip.morerelics.depleted_spool_evolve: The spool's regenerative abilities are restored!
morerelics.tooltip.relics.weavers_spool.description: Restored to its former power, the spool now regenerates silk that can subtly alter reality, weaving outcomes according to the weaver’s design.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.weavers_spool.ability.wea:
Each strike against an enemy weaves silk back into your spool, building up to a maximum of 10 silk stored.
Additionally, gain silk passively every %1$s seconds when you have less than 3 silk.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.weavers_spool.ability.bin: Consumes 6 silk to heal for %1$s and grants absorption for a short duration, shielding you from further harm.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.weavers_spool.ability.soa: Consumes 3 silk to propel you in the direction you're facing with a force of %1$s and grants a speed boost for %2$s seconds afterwards.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.weavers_spool.ability.unr: Consumes 7 silk to unleash a blast that deals %1$s damage and severely slows enemies for %2$s seconds within a 4-block radius around you.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.whims_of_fate.leveling_so: This relics gains 3 experience every time you gain silk.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.moodworm.description: A symbiotic worm that manipulates its host's emotions, helping them adapt and thrive in shifting conditions.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.moodworm.ability.moody.de:
The worm changes its mood every 10 minutes, providing different benefits:
Furious: Increases damage by %1$sX and attacks burn enemies.
Joyful: Increases speed and luck by %1$sX.
Gloomy: Reduces damage taken by %2$s% and increases resistance to knockback.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.moodworm.ability.tranquil:
The worm can switch to a new mood.
Tranquil: Provides all the advantages of the worm's other moods.
This relic gains 20 experience each time the mood changes.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.converging_orb.descriptio: A rather heavy orb made from an unknown material which permanently compresses under pressure.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.converging_orb.ability.co: Every time the user is hit the orb undergoes permanent compression, decreasing its size and dramatically increasing its density.
morerelics.amulet.morerelics.orb_final_push: The orb has stopped gaining density. It needs one last push from an overwhelming force.
morerelics.tooltip.morerelics.converging_orb.final_: Task: Get hit the Warden's sonic boom.
morerelics.tooltip.morerelics.converging_orb.collap: The orb exceeded critical density, collapsing in on itself to form a miniature black hole.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.wonder_of_u.description: The orb has collapsed in on itself, becoming a miniature black hole. It now absorbs any harm aimed at its user, redirecting it toward those who oppose them.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.wonder_of_u.ability.entro:
%1$s% of the incoming damage is also dealt to the attacker.

Reflected damage cannot exceed the user's current health.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.wonder_of_u.ability.flow_:
When attacked, the attacker suffers a random negative potion effect.
Cooldown: %1$s seconds.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.wonder_of_u.ability.event:
Upon activation, the user unleashes a blast that knocks back and stuns nearby enemies.
For the next %1$s seconds, the user enters a state of nullification, gaining complete invincibility and doubling the effects of Entropy and Flow of Calamity. This ability has a cooldown of %2$s seconds.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.wonder_of_u.leveling_sour: This relic gains 5 experience each time you reflect damage.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.gravitum_glove.descriptio: A glove which is made from a unique cloth-like material which anchors itself to its current position, making it very hard to move. When it collides with an object it transfers a massive amount of energy, creating a powerful impact even at low speed.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.gravitum_glove.ability.al: Multiplies attack damage by %1$sX but reduces attack speed by 66%.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.gravitum_glove.ability.bo:
Attacks over 20 damage (before armor) have a %1$s% chance to trigger a heavy strike, dealing 2X damage and inflicting Dazed for %2$s seconds.
Dazed enemies have a chance to miss their attacks.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.gravitum_glove.leveling_s: This relic gains 2 experience each time the user attacks.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.vertebrax.description: A high-tech spine implant designed to boost immunity by continuously injecting poison into the body... It was quickly banned and pulled from the market due to obvious reasons.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.vertebrax.ability.fortifi:
Harmful potion effects have their duration reduced by %1$s%. These effects have a %2$s% chance to be filtered, decreasing their level or reducing duration by an additional 20% if the level is already at its minimum. Filtration also synthesizes the opposite beneficial effect for half the original duration if it exists.
While cyberpsychosis is active: Synthesized effects are more powerful and the reduction is amplified by 50%.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.vertebrax.ability.acquire: Completely converts Poison into Regeneration for its full duration.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.vertebrax.ability.cyberps:
Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger Cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.vertebrax.leveling_source: This relic slowly gains experience while it is worn.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.epoch_apple.description: An ancient apple believed to be from the earliest generations of its kind. Its regenerative abilities allow it to recover from severe damage which is how it has survived through the ages.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.epoch_apple.ability.persi: The apple recovers to its full form after %1$s minutes of being eaten.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.epoch_apple.ability.ripen: The apple ripens into greater quality after %1$s minutes of being in its full form.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.epoch_apple.leveling_sour: This relic gains 120 experience every time it is eaten.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.gravitum_strider.descript: A boot that uses a Gravitum engine to reduce the effects of gravity. It was commonly used by astronauts for training before the severe health risks of Gravitum were discovered.
Reduces your gravity by %1$s%. Fall damage and safe fall distance are adjusted accordingly.
Jumping after crouching for one second launches you upwards with a force of %1$s. You take reduced fall damage from this jump.
morerelics.tooltip.relics.gravitum_strider.leveling: This relic gains 1 experience each time the user jumps.

mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.wastelander_race: Waste but not discouraged, mortal body hides edge, defying fate reveals the brilliant immortal path
Waste but not discouraged, mortal body hides edge, defying fate reveals the brilliant immortal path
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.foundation_estab: The Foundation Establishment stage is the first step in cultivation, with some spiritual energy and the ability to perform a double jump and immune to fall damage within 8 blocks.

Foundation Establishment cultivators have condensed spiritual energy, with clear meridians, beginning their path of immortal cultivation. They can concentrate spiritual energy on their feet for air jumps and cushion landing impacts.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.golden_core_race: A cultivator who has condensed spiritual power into a Golden Core and gained finer control over qi.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.nascent_soul_rac: A cultivator whose Golden Core has transformed into a newly formed Nascent Soul.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.spirit_transform: A cultivator whose Nascent Soul has broken through and formed a divine body.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.void_refinement_: A cultivator who refines the power of the void to temper their body and spirit.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.unity_race.descr: A cultivator who has united body and soul after mastering Void Refinement.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.great_ascension_: A peak mortal cultivator standing one step away from immortal ascension.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.tribulation_tran: A cultivator facing heavenly tribulation in final preparation for ascension.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.true_immortal_ra: A true immortal who has survived heavenly tribulation and successfully ascended.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.heavenly_dao_rac: A supreme cultivator who commands the laws of heaven and has become one with the Heavenly Dao.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.dao_breaking_rac: The ultimate realm of one who has surpassed the Heavenly Dao and shattered its laws.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.talisman_apprent: Talisman Apprentices are cultivators who have chosen to specialize in the art of talisman-making during the Foundation Establishment stage. They can perform air jumps and are immune to fall damage within 8 blocks.

Talisman Apprentices focus on the creation and application of magical talismans. They have a deep understanding of spiritual symbols and can channel their energy into written patterns to create various magical effects.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.talisman_master_: An advanced cultivator who has risen from Talisman Apprentice and mastered the creation and use of talismans.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.sigil_master_rac: A high-level cultivator versed in the profound arts of talisman craft.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.sigil_saint_race: An evolution of the Sigil Master who has brought the talisman arts to their highest mortal realm.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.sigil_immortal_r: An evolution of the Sigil Saint who has entered the immortal realm of talisman cultivation.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.demonic_foundati: The Demonic Foundation Stage is the entry level of demonic cultivation where practitioners have chosen the demonic path and established the foundation for demonic cultivation, with the ability to perform a double jump and immune to fall damage within 8 blocks.

Demonic Foundation Stage cultivators have embarked on the path of demonic cultivation, beginning to comprehend the power of demonic energy. While their strength is comparable to righteous path cultivators, their cultivation methods are fundamentally different. Demonic Foundation Stage cultivators have a lifespan of around 200 years.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.demonic_golden_c: A cultivator who has formed a Demonic Core and entered the second realm of demonic cultivation.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.demonic_nascent_: A demonic cultivator whose Demonic Core has transformed into a Nascent Soul.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.demonic_spirit_t: A high-level demonic cultivator whose Nascent Soul has undergone demonic transformation.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.demonic_void_ref: A demonic cultivator who tempers their being with the power of the infernal realm.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.demonic_unity_ra: A cultivator who has become one with the power of the demonic path.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.demonic_great_as: A demonic cultivator who has endured a great calamity and advanced toward a higher realm.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.demonic_tribulat: A demonic cultivator who has survived the great calamity and attained a true demon body.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.demonic_true_imm: A demonic cultivator who has entered the Endless Hell Realm and surpassed the power of a true demon.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.race.demonic_void_ret: A demonic cultivator who has returned to the void and reached the ultimate realm of the demonic path.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.skill.early_cultivati: Shoots a small fireball that causes a minor explosion.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.skill.talisman_master: Masters the art of talisman creation. Press the skill key to open the talisman creation interface.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.skill.qi_flight.descr: §7Control the spiritual energy within to fly freely in the air.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.skill.sword_flight.de: Grants the ability to travel by commanding a flying sword.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.skill.myriad_swords_r: Countless swords bow before their master as worshippers before a sovereign god.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.skill.neidan.descript: Transforms your body, allowing your spiritual body to survive even after your physical body dies.
Failed to acquire %s due to the lack of Aura.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.skill.alchemy_prodigy: Precise micro-operations, reduced time consumption, stable pill formation
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.skill.cultivating_the: Sit in the void, roam through the ethereal realm, sense the spiritual essence of heaven and earth with a mystic heart, and refine divine consciousness. Hold the skill key to hover in mid-air with a Taoist array beneath your feet, restoring 1% of magicule, fighting spirit, and health per second.
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.skill.hundred_ghosts_: Using the Ten Thousand Soul Banner as a guide, command a hundred souls to obey. The caster activates the evil banner, instantly releasing a hundred fierce vengeful spirits that transform into a black mist ghost tide sweeping across the battlefield. The wailing souls pierce to the bone, gnawing at living flesh and tearing enemy souls. Those devoured will have their souls imprisoned in the banner, never to transcend.
mortal_cultivation.item.mortal_cultivation.monster_gatherin: Gather creatures and control them within a 15 block radius.
Shift + Right-click with an empty hand to pick up.
mortal_cultivation.item.mortal_cultivation.thunder_talisman: Summons heavenly thunder to attack enemies with devastating power.
mortal_cultivation.item.mortal_cultivation.nourishing_qi_ta: Restores your body to its strongest state.
mortal_cultivation.effect.mortal_cultivation.nourishing.des: Continuously nourishes the body, restoring health, magicule, and aura without exceeding their maximums.
Southern Puppet Art, terrifying as it is
Invalid target! Must be used on a living creature.
This creature is too powerful for you to control!
You don't have enough magicules to use this talisman!
The creature is now under your control!
mortal_cultivation.item.mortal_cultivation.fasting_talisman: No need for food, sustain yourself
mortal_cultivation.item.mortal_cultivation.localized_fantas: Made with cinnabar mixed with the blood of the caster or spiritual beasts, used to draw talismans with magical patterns. The yang nature of cinnabar can suppress evil spirits.
mortal_cultivation.item.mortal_cultivation.foundation_build: You need to consume this pill to successfully establish your foundation
mortal_cultivation.item.mortal_cultivation.stellar_core_pil: Quickly condenses stellar energy within your body, followed by a burst of power!
mortal_cultivation.item.mortal_cultivation.giant_spirit_pil: Reduces demonic interference and helps stabilize your Nascent Soul
mortal_cultivation.item.mortal_cultivation.mystic_void_elix: A mystical elixir that resonates with the void, granting profound insights into the nature of reality
mortal_cultivation.item.mortal_cultivation.void_refinement_: A profound pill that harmonizes with the void, allowing cultivators to refine void energy
mortal_cultivation.item.mortal_cultivation.heaven_cleansing: Cleanses meridians after consumption (has great effect for Wastelander race)
mortal_cultivation.mortal_cultivation.heaven_cleansing_elix: The Heaven Cleansing Elixir has purified your meridians, you have achieved a qualitative breakthrough.
mortal_cultivation.jei.mortal_cultivation.localized_fantasy:

§7Made with cinnabar mixed with the blood of the caster or spiritual beasts, used to draw talismans with magical patterns. The yang nature of cinnabar can suppress evil spirits.

§7A brush made from dragon peacock feathers, it can be used to draw talismans on talisman paper when dipped in cinnabar blood ink.

§eUsage:§7 Used in talisman crafting, placed in a special slot in the talisman crafting table, has 180 durability.
mortal_cultivation.jei.mortal_cultivation.talisman_paper.in:

mortal_cultivation.jei.mortal_cultivation.foundation_buildi:

mortal_cultivation.jei.mortal_cultivation.stellar_core_pill:

mortal_cultivation.jei.mortal_cultivation.giant_spirit_pill:

mortal_cultivation.jei.mortal_cultivation.heaven_cleansing_:
