mysticism.mysticism.race.amped_guitar_wolf.descrip: An evolved Guitar Wolf that has a deep connection to sound. It can disrupt the magic of nearby enemies, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
mysticism.mysticism.race.ant.description: Ants are fearless critters that have absurdly tanky exoskeletons, known for being bulky and hard to take down. Prepare for a long, drawn out battle if you encounter one!
mysticism.mysticism.race.antumbra_spirit_wolf.desc: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Light Fangs bow to this creature.
mysticism.mysticism.race.arch_angel.description: Only few Angels make it to this point because of their lack of ego.
mysticism.mysticism.race.arch_doll.description: The result of an Arch Daemon possessing a magisteel body.
mysticism.mysticism.race.arch_fallen.description: An arch angel that got corrupted by magicules, then chose to abandon the light for the darkness.
mysticism.mysticism.race.army_wasp.description: An evolved scorpion, with the capability of manipulating gravity itself. It floats around aimlessly and randomly stings things it finds interesting. It has never been hunted excessively due to its nature, so its defenses are extremely weak.
mysticism.mysticism.race.ascended.description: It will be fine if you never remember your past. That is what they tell themselves. Being able to accept this truth and embrace it. That is why they Ascend past all odds to become Spiritual Lifeforms despite their challenges.
mysticism.mysticism.race.attuned_wyrm.description: A race of wyrm that as yet to find a element to evolve into, it searches for ways to evolve while it wanders the world.
mysticism.mysticism.race.beetle.description: Beetles are heavy-hitting insects, focusing everything into their power. Though they are one of the stronger races, their defences are lacklustre, to put it nicely.
mysticism.mysticism.race.black_fang.description: A Direwolf that has a connection to magic. It can tune in to the nearby magicules and use it to sense its surroundings.
mysticism.mysticism.race.blazing_scorch_wolf.descr: An evolved Scorch Wolf that has a deep connection to pure heat and energy. It can create deadly fire storms, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
mysticism.mysticism.race.blue_centipede.descriptio: An evolved centipede, leaning into its swimming ability. It loves to hunt in the vast oceans, making use of its ability to paralyze targets.
mysticism.mysticism.race.blue_fang.description: A Direwolf that has a connection to water. It can tune in to the nearby magicules and use it to sense its surroundings.
mysticism.mysticism.race.brown_fang.description: A Direwolf that has a connection to the earth. It can tune in to the nearby magicules and use it to sense its surroundings.
mysticism.mysticism.race.centipede.description: Centipedes are fast, speed-oriented insects that can escape virtually any fight. Their many legs makes up for their lack of power.
mysticism.mysticism.race.chaos_doll.description: The result of an Arch Doll reversing its alignment to become Chaos aligned.
mysticism.mysticism.race.chaos_metalloid.descripti: The result of a Chaos Doll  achieving Divinity and awakening.
mysticism.mysticism.race.charged_perforator.descri: A rare mutation of a sculk worm. It consumed essence of Lightning itself and gained specific abilities. But this one... Seems weird.
mysticism.mysticism.race.cherub.description: The second most powerful type of pure Angel known.
mysticism.mysticism.race.daemon_doll.description: The result of an Arch Doll acquiring a name.
mysticism.mysticism.race.darkness_fang.description: A Direwolf that has a connection to the dark. It can blend in with the shadows and become invisible, as dark as night.
mysticism.mysticism.race.devil_doll.description: The result of a Daemon Doll achieving Divinity and awakening.
mysticism.mysticism.race.direwolf.description: Direwolves are a species of monster that love to cause havoc. The more intelligent and friendly ones are capable of giving others a ride on their back. They have great potential for growth.
mysticism.mysticism.race.dissonance_deity.descript: What was once a sculk worm has truly disappeared. "The beast stretched from one horizon to the next and belched storms that reminded all of the hero’s promise: that this land – and all those who live here - would never suffer again..." It has achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_army_wasp.descript: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Army Wasp that has gained Divinity.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_drone_beetle.descr: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Drone Beetle that has gained Divinity.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_elemental.descript: An aspect of perfection that embodies its element to perfection. This being possesses God-level Spiritual Magic rivaling King-Tier Ultimate Skills that can wipe out continents should they be cast.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_excelsius.descript: The culmination of one who has lost their past. They find meaning in their new life, pushing past all their worries and transgressions to attain Divinity.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_fire_ant.descripti: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Fire Ant that has gained Divinity.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_hardshell_ant.desc: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Hardshell Ant that has gained Divinity.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_inferius.descripti: The culmination of one who has lost their past. They find meaning in death, defeating all, even one who has truly forgotten the world, just to attain Divinity.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_lixivant_mantis.de: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Lixivant Mantis that has gained Divinity.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_loxodrome_scorpion: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Loxodrome Scorpion that has gained Divinity.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_majin_elemental.de: An aspect of perfection that embodies its element to perfection. This being possesses God-level Spiritual Magic rivaling King-Tier Ultimate Skills that can wipe out continents should they be cast.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_preying_mantis.des: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Preying Mantis that has gained Divinity.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_purple_centipede.d: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Purple Centipede that has gained Divinity.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_queen_wasp.descrip: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Queen Wasp that has gained Divinity.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_singularity_scorpi: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Singularity Scorpion that has gained Divinity.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_stag_beetle.descri: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Stag Beetle that has gained Divinity.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_tengu.description: The result of a Tengu achieving Divinity.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_wolf.description: Direwolf that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
mysticism.mysticism.race.divine_yellow_centipede.d: Such a presence commands everyone's attention. Be warned that you may not make it out in one piece encountering this monster of a Yellow Centipede that has gained Divinity.
mysticism.mysticism.race.dragonoid.description: A child of the stars and hopes of the world. Can you obtain true power? You can only ever evolve once, but your stats grow with your EP.
mysticism.mysticism.race.drone_beetle.description: An evolved beetle, leaning into its speed. Trading damage for speed, it is now capable of flight. However, it is still too young.
mysticism.mysticism.race.drone_beetle_insectar.des: A Drone Beetle that has gained a humanoid body. Its wings are much stronger and capable of traveling much quicker.
mysticism.mysticism.race.drone_beetle_savant.descr: A Drone Beetle that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It flies at tremendous speeds, almost capable of breaking the sound barrier with how fast it flies.
mysticism.mysticism.race.earth_soul_insect.descrip: A Hardshell Ant that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It embodies the element of Earth perfectly, defending the weak and fighting off those who wrong it.
mysticism.mysticism.race.elemental_lord.descriptio: A graceful and elegant evolved Elemental that wields powerful Lord-level Spiritual Magic, capable of going toe-to-toe with Ultimate Skills.
mysticism.mysticism.race.empty.description: A Remnant that chose the hard way out. Instead of accepting their forgotten past, they chose to fight it, to no avail. A greater, emptier husk awaits.
mysticism.mysticism.race.enflamed_aberration.descr: These creatures have evolved to look eerily similar to their overworld counterparts. Pray that its power is not truly unleashed. It is a demi-spiritual lifeform.
mysticism.mysticism.race.fallen.description: A seraph that got corrupted by magicules, then chose to abandon the light for the darkness.
mysticism.mysticism.race.fallen_arch_angel.descrip: An arch angel that got corrupted by magicules, despite that, they still retain the light element.
mysticism.mysticism.race.fallen_cherub.description: A cherub that got corrupted by magicules, despite that, they still retain the light element.
mysticism.mysticism.race.fallen_greater_angel.desc: A greater angel that got corrupted by magicules, despite that, they still retain the light element.
mysticism.mysticism.race.fallen_lesser_angel.descr: A lesser angel that got corrupted by magicules, despite that, they still retain the light element.
mysticism.mysticism.race.fallen_lord.description: A cherub that got corrupted by magicules, then chose to abandon the light for the darkness.
mysticism.mysticism.race.fallen_seraph.description: A seraph that got corrupted by magicules, despite that, they still retain the light element.
mysticism.mysticism.race.fantasy_soul_insect.descr: A Stag Beetle that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It embodies the element of Fantasy perfectly, distorting magic and removing threats with pure might alone.
mysticism.mysticism.race.field_officer.description: The evolution of a Phantom with an ego, now having the ability to split bodies.
mysticism.mysticism.race.fire_ant.description: An evolved ant, leaning into its offenses. They are able to ignite their physical attacks, akin to the Fire Aspect enchantment.
mysticism.mysticism.race.fire_ant_insectar.descrip: A Fire Ant that has gained a humanoid body. It delivers painful, stinging bites and fights ferociously.
mysticism.mysticism.race.fire_ant_savant.descripti: A Fire Ant that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It carries out the will of the army, being a shining beacon for other Fire Ants.
mysticism.mysticism.race.flame_soul_insect.descrip: A Fire Ant that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It embodies the element of Flames perfectly, singing its foes to a fiery demise.
mysticism.mysticism.race.forgotten.description: The Forgotten Race struggle to remember. A ghost, an apparition of something that used to be. The remains of a soul from someone long departed, that couldn’t be reused in reincarnation. Left behind to linger the world eternally.
mysticism.mysticism.race.frost_wolf.description: A Direwolf that has a connection to ice. Temperatures drop to lethal freezing points when one exists nearby.
mysticism.mysticism.race.frostcoil_sea_serpent.des: A sea dragon race that lives in the coldest depths of the Ocean's tundra's, using its enhanced ears to find its prey, and its speed to catch them.
mysticism.mysticism.race.frostwrought_leviathan.de: A deadly dragon that lives near the bottom of the ocean's, a tame but deadly race able to manipulate sound to find and catch threads.
mysticism.mysticism.race.gale_spirit_wolf.descript: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Black Fangs bow to this creature.
mysticism.mysticism.race.general.description: A commanding officer of the Phantom army.
mysticism.mysticism.race.glacier_spirit_wolf.descr: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Frost Wolves bow to this creature.
mysticism.mysticism.race.greater_angel.description: The evolution of a Lesser Angel with a more developed ego.
mysticism.mysticism.race.greater_doll.description: The result of a Greater Daemon possessing a magisteel body.
mysticism.mysticism.race.greater_elemental.descrip: An Elemental that evolved to take on a more human-like shape. Beware its powerful Greater Spiritual Magic!
mysticism.mysticism.race.greater_fallen.descriptio: A greater angel that got corrupted by magicules, then chose to abandon the light for the darkness.
mysticism.mysticism.race.greater_glacier_wyrm.desc: A higher evolution of the wyrm that live in the Icy Tundras, even more powerful and deadly then their previous evolutions, using its icy breath to freeze all those who come across it.A higher evolution of the wyrm that live in the Icy Tundras, even more powerful and deadly then their previous evolutions, using its icy breath to freeze all those who come across it.
mysticism.mysticism.race.greater_pyre_wyrm.descrip: A higher evolution of the wyrm that lives in the deserts, using its flaming breath to scorch its preys as it hunts those unprepared for the heat.
mysticism.mysticism.race.green_fang.description: A Direwolf that has a connection to wind. It can tune in to the nearby magicules and use it to sense its surroundings.
mysticism.mysticism.race.guitar_wolf.description: A Direwolf that has a connection to sound. It can tune in to the nearby magicules and use it to sense its surroundings.
mysticism.mysticism.race.hardshell_ant.description: An evolved ant, leaning into its defenses. They naturally have good bulk, making them extremely tough to take out of a fight.
mysticism.mysticism.race.hardshell_ant_insectar.de: A Hardshell Ant that has gained a humanoid body. Its shell has only become tougher, and it will continue to become stronger.
mysticism.mysticism.race.hardshell_ant_savant.desc: A Hardshell Ant that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It carries out the will of the army, being a shining beacon for other Hardshell Ants.
mysticism.mysticism.race.insect.description: A cryptid from another world. They excel in physical combat, and specialise in different things. Which one will you be? (Selecting this will RE-ROLL your race among the races in the Mysticism General config file!)
mysticism.mysticism.race.lesser_angel.description: A spiritual life-form similar to Daemons known to wreck havoc on the world every 500 years.
mysticism.mysticism.race.lesser_elemental.descript: A curious Elemental with a mind not yet formed. What shape will it take?
mysticism.mysticism.race.lesser_fallen.description: A lesser angel that got corrupted by magicules, then chose to abandon the light for the darkness.
mysticism.mysticism.race.lesser_glacier_wyrm.descr: A Race of Wyrm that live in the depth of the Icy Tundras, thriving on the cold and all those live in it.
mysticism.mysticism.race.lesser_pyre_wyrm.descript: A race of wyrm that live hottest deserts, thriving on the heat and all those that live in it.
mysticism.mysticism.race.light_fang.description: A Direwolf that has a connection to the light. It blinds its prey before striking.
mysticism.mysticism.race.lightning_aberration.desc: Pray that its power is not truly unleashed. Know the fear and drive behind an aberration of pure electricity. It is a demi-spiritual lifeform.
mysticism.mysticism.race.lightning_soul_insect.des: A Drone Beetle that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. It embodies the element of Lightning perfectly, rupturing the battlefield and being nigh untouchable.
mysticism.mysticism.race.lixivant_mantis.descripti: An evolved mantis, gaining the ability to corrode things. It melts through enemy defenses and cripples them before they even know what hit them.
mysticism.mysticism.race.loxodrome_scorpion.descri: An evolved scorpion, becoming the king of the pack. It uses deadly and lethal venom to destroy all of its targets from the inside.
mysticism.mysticism.race.magic_spirit_wolf.descrip: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Black Fangs bow to this creature.
mysticism.mysticism.race.magma_worm.description: "And his brother loved worms..." A powerful evolved variant of the sculk worm, gaining a long, worm-like appendage.
mysticism.mysticism.race.majin_lord.description: A very powerful majinised Elemental that wields powerful Lord-level Spiritual Magic, capable of going toe-to-toe with Ultimate Skills.
mysticism.mysticism.race.mantis.description: Mantises are fast-hitting insects that whittle down their opponents with quick strikes and their powerful melee skills. Some variants have even been known to melt through armor.
mysticism.mysticism.race.medium_elemental.descript: An Elemental that has evolved, taking the form of a mythological creature. Its arsenal of Spiritual Magic is now stronger as well.
mysticism.mysticism.race.molten_perforator.descrip: A rare mutation of a sculk worm achieved through forcibly devouring Flame Essence. Now it thrives in the Nether.
mysticism.mysticism.race.molten_spirit_wolf.descri: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Scorch Wolves bow to this creature.
mysticism.mysticism.race.mountain_spirit_wolf.desc: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Brown Fangs bow to this creature.
mysticism.mysticism.race.mystic_angel.description: A ReaperAberration that got corrupted by the magicules of the World Destroying Dragon, but still kept their status as holy beings.
mysticism.mysticism.race.mystical_black_fang.descr: An evolved Black Fang that has a deep connection to magic. It can disrupt the magic of nearby enemies, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
mysticism.mysticism.race.mystical_blue_fang.descri: An evolved Black Fang that has a deep connection to water. It can disrupt the magic of nearby enemies, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
mysticism.mysticism.race.mystical_brown_fang.descr: An evolved Black Fang that has a deep connection to the earth. It can disrupt the magic of nearby enemies, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
mysticism.mysticism.race.mystical_darkness_fang.de: An evolved Darkness Fang that has a deep connection to the dark. It can disrupt the magic of nearby enemies, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
mysticism.mysticism.race.mystical_green_fang.descr: An evolved Black Fang that has a deep connection to wind. It can disrupt the magic of nearby enemies, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
mysticism.mysticism.race.mystical_light_fang.descr: An evolved Light Fang that has a deep connection to the light. It can illuminate its surroundings instantly, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
mysticism.mysticism.race.mystical_purple_fang.desc: An evolved Purple Fang that has a deep connection to space. It can appear at any place at any time, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
mysticism.mysticism.race.mystical_red_fang.descrip: An evolved Red Fang that has a deep connection to fire. It can destroy its surroundings in mere moments, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
mysticism.mysticism.race.nivalis_frost_wolf.descri: An evolved Frost Wolf that has a deep connection to ice. It can freeze entire landscapes easily, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
mysticism.mysticism.race.ocean_spirit_wolf.descrip: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Blue Fangs bow to this creature.
mysticism.mysticism.race.overloading_worm.descript: "The Reminder." When two brothers played, this one watched.
mysticism.mysticism.race.penumbra_spirit_wolf.desc: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Darkness Fangs bow to this creature.
mysticism.mysticism.race.phantom.description: A demi-spiritual creature born in the Underworld by the magicules of the World Destroying Dragon.
mysticism.mysticism.race.planet_spirit_wolf.descri: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Purple Fangs bow to this creature.
mysticism.mysticism.race.preying_mantis.descriptio: An evolved mantis, leaning into its attack speed. It punches quick and deals decisive blows that almost guarantees victory.
mysticism.mysticism.race.purple_centipede.descript: An evolved centipede, leaning into its offenses. It creates spatial distortions to disorient its prey before striking.
mysticism.mysticism.race.purple_fang.description: A Direwolf that has a connection to space. It creates portals to move quickly.
mysticism.mysticism.race.queen_wasp.description: An evolved scorpion, with the capability of manipulating gravity itself. It floats around aimlessly and randomly stings things it finds interesting. It has never been hunted excessively due to its nature, so its defenses are extremely weak.
mysticism.mysticism.race.reaper_aberration.descrip: One can only hope this thing does not find you. It has achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
mysticism.mysticism.race.red_fang.description: A Direwolf that has a connection to fire. It incinerates its surroundings for fun, making trouble for travelers.
mysticism.mysticism.race.remnant.description: These lost souls piece their past back together slowly. They have regained some semblance of self-being, but it's still not enough.
mysticism.mysticism.race.revenant.description: A husk of what could have been. Revenants carve their way out of the hell they have created for themselves, one soul at a time.
mysticism.mysticism.race.rimeblight_hydra.descript: A deadly, three headed dragon monster that thrives in the cold mountains of the tundra, using its 3 heads to Poison, Paralyze and freeze its foes.
mysticism.mysticism.race.rimefang_drake.descriptio: A wingless dragon monster that lives in the icy tundras, thanks to its improved eyesight, its able to see its prey from far distances.
mysticism.mysticism.race.scorch_wolf.description: A Direwolf that has a connection to pure heat and energy. Simply being near one causes the environment to heat up. It can create deadly fire storms and harnesses pure scorch itself.
mysticism.mysticism.race.scorchtail_salamander.des: A monster race that soars through the skies as it hunts for its next meal, diving down as it breaths its flaming breath on unsuspecting prey below.
mysticism.mysticism.race.scorchtalon_wyvern.descri: A dragon monster race that scorches all those who come across it. Even its own kind is not safe from it.
mysticism.mysticism.race.scorpion.description: Scorpions deliver strikes with their powerful stinger, which can inflict a potent venom on their targets. In rare cases, some even gain the ability to manipulate Gravity itself.
mysticism.mysticism.race.sculk_worm.description: An ancient family of sculk inhabitants, where evolution has given them permanent darkness. Starts off weak, but grows to become a monstrosity.
mysticism.mysticism.race.seraph.description: Only the most powerful pure Angels with the most developed ego can attain Divinity.
mysticism.mysticism.race.singularity_scorpion.desc: An evolved scorpion, with the capability of manipulating gravity itself. It floats around aimlessly and randomly stings things it finds interesting. It has never been hunted excessively due to its nature, so its defenses are extremely weak.
mysticism.mysticism.race.soul_aberration.descripti: Very rarely, a Warden can evolve to an even bigger monstrosity. What this one will do with its power is still unknown. It is a demi-spiritual lifeform.
mysticism.mysticism.race.soul_shrieker.description: A sculk worm has tapped into their inner potential as a sculk inhabitant, and learned how to utilize its sound-based organs to fire projectiles.
mysticism.mysticism.race.staff_officer.description: A high graded officer of the Phantom army.
mysticism.mysticism.race.stag_beetle.description: An evolved beetle, leaning into its offenses. Their tough horn allows them to jab opponents to deal great damage.
mysticism.mysticism.race.stag_beetle_insectar.desc: A Stag Beetle that has gained a humanoid body. It can now funnel its strength into its fists, allowing it to dominate the battlefield.
mysticism.mysticism.race.stag_beetle_savant.descri: A Stag Beetle that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. Its exoskeleton hardens evermore, capable of utilising Mithril Strength to further enhance its capabilities.
mysticism.mysticism.race.star_wolf.description: A Direwolf that has a connection to storms. Their tails can create strong winds when wagging and they are able to reduce their size.
mysticism.mysticism.race.storm_spirit_wolf.descrip: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Star Wolves bow to this creature.
mysticism.mysticism.race.string_spirit_wolf.descri: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Guitar Fangs bow to this creature.
mysticism.mysticism.race.sundeity_loong.descriptio: Having learned to fly without wings, it soars through the air, using magic to rain down light on its foes and save others.
mysticism.mysticism.race.sunfire_lindwurm.descript: A wingless spiritual dragon race that crawls across the ground, it helps those that it can, while also hunting for its own prey, it shows mercy, making sure to end the lives of prey quick and swiftly using rays of light.
mysticism.mysticism.race.tempest_star_wolf.descrip: An evolved Star Wolf that has a deep connection to storms. It can create storms without a care, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
mysticism.mysticism.race.tengu.description: The result of an angel possessing an Okami.
mysticism.mysticism.race.tengu_saint.description: The result of a Tengu becoming once more a spiritual being.
mysticism.mysticism.race.true_dragonoid.descriptio: A child of the stars and hopes of the world. A being that has achieved divinity, challenging the existence that brought you into this world.
mysticism.mysticism.race.violence_deity.descriptio: What was once a sculk worm has truly disappeared. This is a monstrosity and there is no going back. It has achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
mysticism.mysticism.race.volcanic_spirit_wolf.desc: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Red Fangs bow to this creature.
mysticism.mysticism.race.warden.description: Wardens are terrible creatures that inhabit the Deep Dark, always waiting and always ready to strike.
mysticism.mysticism.race.wasp.description: Wasps are frail insects that have the innate ability to fly. Though they aren't quick, they have great versatility, and it all exists to protect the Queen.
mysticism.mysticism.race.whole.description: Acceptance. The first step to becoming complete. When the remnants of your past collide together, only when you accept your struggles can you become Whole.
mysticism.mysticism.race.yellow_centipede.descript: An evolved centipede, leaning into its speed. It swiftly dodges its target's attacks before paralyzing them, finishing the job.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.acquire_failed.ap: Failed to acquire %s due to the lack of Aura.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.bullet_punch.description: You can only be fast, and go even faster. On the next attack, you speed up and deliver four quick attacks.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.butcher.butchering_scree: No body parts selected. Select one and try again.
Too many body parts selected. Maximum of three.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.butcher.description: Slice, dice, and feel your hunger. Your thirst for the hunt is unquenching, so grab a plate and have a taste.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.captivator.description: Your previous life, you were the brightest, shining star. Your ability to turn lies into truths… Perhaps it’s the other way around? Whatever it may be, your eyes shine brilliantly in response to being on the biggest stage.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.captivator.target_immune: Target %s is immune to the effects of this mode.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.clangorous_soul.descript: Your soul, your beats. Your shell is hard, and makes wonderful noises when it is banged against. Maybe it can help you.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.coalescence.description: Freeze, stop and stagnate. Prevent hindering effects from applying to you and cause others to halt and solidify.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.constant.description: Use magicules to force differing stats to remain the same. Become nigh invincible for a short period of time while
mysticism.mysticism.skill.corroder.description: Apply powerful Corrosion to your physical attacks. Turn into Corrosion and sear your enemies. Deal massive armor-ignoring damage with a Corrosion slash.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.corrosion_transform.desc: Channel your inner corrosion to burn and bleed the flesh off your enemies.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.crasher.description: The essence of "deletion". Completely and utterly erase your foes from the plane of existence with the power of your sheer will alone.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.cryogenic_cessation.desc: Command your absolute authority over Deceleration, allowing you to freeze all enemies with ice and spew superchilled ice. Additionally, freeze the surroundings into ice
mysticism.mysticism.skill.cultivator.description: Embody the relentless pursuit of ascension, gathering and refining energy to reach unparalleled heights. A Cultivator walks the path of self-perfection and dominion over all.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.darkness_domination.desc: Boosts the power of Dark abilities by a large amount.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.darkness_manipulation.de: Boosts the power of Dark abilities by a decent amount.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.discharge.description: Strike a bolt of lightning using your inner bio-electricity generated from a sac within you. Can be used without thundering weather.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.dissonance.description: You are the calamity. You are the storm, and you are approaching. Strike lightning in all cardinal directions that deal massive Electricity Damage to all those unfortunate to be hit by it.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.dreamer.description: Dream a dream so grand it becomes a nightmare... Gain control over the forces of life and death, allowing you to cheat death and restore yourself back to a "save point".
mysticism.mysticism.skill.embryo.title: The Seed of Genesis
mysticism.mysticism.skill.engineer.description: Tinkering and tinkering. No one understood the machines as much as you did. In fact, no one understood you either. Perhaps it was always meant to be.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.exoskeleton.description: The Insects of the other world all possess this tough Exoskeleton. It grows together with the user, and even allows them to wear armor on top of it.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.gardener.description: The crops, the wild, everything was there for you. You sow the seeds and wish only for a bountiful harvest. And in turn, the crops bless you.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.gatekeeper.description: Wield the authority of kings and command treasures beyond mortal reach. Summon divine armaments from the vault, binding foes in chains of judgment while asserting dominion over all.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.gravitational_void.descr: A black hole sucking everything into a singularity
mysticism.mysticism.skill.gravity_flux.description: Utilise the power of gravity to disrupt the target's movement and hamper their ability to move.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.hell_hall.description: Rupture the floor, raising your natural body temperature to liquefy all surfaces around you to molten levels.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.hidden_ruler.description: Inspire your allies. Conscript allies in the dark. Copy abilities from your foes and Paste them onto allies.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.hidden_ruler.user_died: You died! Your Hidden Ruler skill bank was wiped.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.ice_domination.descripti: Boosts the power of ice abilities by a large amount.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.ice_manipulation.descrip: Boosts the power of ice abilities by a decent amount.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.jinchuriki.description: That voice... It's familiar, yet something so distant. Another side of you, perhaps. But it's something that can be controlled. Provided you have the right tenacity to do it.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.kyurem.description: A husk of what you formally were. The leftovers, discarded without a second thought when the split happened. Coldness seeps through your skin as you freeze everything to reclaim your other parts.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.lethal_poison.descriptio: As the King of Scorpions, your poison is highly dangerous. An upgrade to the Poison skill. Can only be used by King Scorpions and their evolutionary line.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.light_domination.descrip: Boosts the power of Light abilities by a large amount.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.light_manipulation.descr: Boosts the power of light abilities by a decent amount.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.lightning_mode.descripti: Burst forth with an incredible speed boost, gaining doubled EP temporarily on top of higher damage. Beware of the terrible drawbacks.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.looter.shadow_storage_mo: Changed %s's Shadow Storage to Come Forth.
Changed %s's Shadow Storage to Shadow Storage.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.magisteel_body.descripti: Have a body made of magisteel, making it much harder and gaining progressively stronger armor depending on your EP.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.malleable.description: Malleable like clay, the tides of fate are yours to mold to your desire. Your body seems to work like the metal of a forge, hardening and relaxing under pressure, as you merge yourself with the elements around you.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.melancholy.description: Summon an aura of sorrow that slows and weakens nearby enemies, filling them with despair. The skill also throws objects or air, amplifying the feeling of hopelessness around you.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.mithril_strength.descrip: Turn your muscles as hard as Mithril and gain an increase in damage, toggleable when mastered.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.mode.butcher.rupture.no_: You do not have any targets above %s marks.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.mode.butcher.血淋林的爱.no_ch: No charges of 血淋林的爱. Kill an enemy with over 20 marks to gain a charge.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.mode.captivator.performa: "I'm in love with you," my career is built on such a lie!
So, lying surely is the greatest kind of love!
mysticism.mysticism.skill.mode.coalescence.fixatio: The target cannot be given Fixation, it is on cooldown for %s seconds!
mysticism.mysticism.skill.mode.constant.destructio: Constant: Destruction is now available, with a damage of %s!
mysticism.mysticism.skill.mode.crasher.dimension_h: The target dimension is the same as the current dimension!
Crasher is too weak to leap from this dimension!
mysticism.mysticism.skill.mode.cultivator.breakthr: You have broken through to Cultivation Level %s!
Cultivation started! Do not die! Dying will cause Cultivation to fail and force you to go back to zero (0 mastery as well)!
Your death caused the energy within you to become imbalanced. Start from Cultivation Level 0.
You need %s more mob kills in order to use this ability!
mysticism.mysticism.skill.mode.dreamer.dream.cance: You let go of a foolish ideology.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.mode.dreamer.dream.creat: You think of the place you're in... It starts to become vivid.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.mode.dreamer.dream.death: If only death could stop dreams...

mysticism.mysticism.skill.mode.repeater.flarefrost: Defeating the Lost Spirit made its skill's energy combine with yours!

mysticism.mysticism.skill.paralysis_transform.desc: Channel your inner paralysis to emit paralysing enzymes that make your target go numb just from your presence.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.phaser.description: Your eyes shift. They become able to see things you normally weren't able to see before... And you become able to do things you weren't able to do before.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.poison_transform.descrip: Channel your inner poison to inject deadly venom's into your target through their every pore.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.profaned_prominence.desc: Command your absolute authority over Acceleration, allowing you to inflict all enemies with fire and spew superheated flames. Additionally, melt the surroundings into magma.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.provider.description: The more you give away, the more you feel closer to yourself. Perhaps it even strengthens you along the way.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.reducer.description: Manipulate and wield the power of energy itself, being able to channel the power of the holy element into super strong attacks.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.relapse.description: Collapse back into whence you came. Your memory is fleeting and the people you once knew start to forget you as well. Relapse and claim what belongs to you.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.repeater.description: Through the lens, you trap light. You do something special, and you feel like you’ve already done it in millions of realities. Like the things you’ve done and led up to this moment were predestined. Maybe you can change that.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.reshiram.description: You seek to build a world of truths. Are you prepared to scorch and burn everything in your path to make the truthful world you seek so badly?
mysticism.mysticism.skill.restricted.cannot_copy_r: You tried to copy the skill %s, but you were unable to.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.restricted.description: You were cursed from birth. Your raw, unfiltered potential, blocked by a curse gifted by the heavens. Your skill... It's stopping you from learning other skills. But why...?
mysticism.mysticism.skill.restricted.unable_to_lea: You tried to learn the skill %s, but %s prevents you from doing so.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.scholar.description: Learn and master skills quicker. Study your targets when they attack. Learn enchantments and apply them to weaponry.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.scholar.library_of_babel: You could not raise the book's level! Needs %s experience levels.
By lowering the level of [%s] you have received %s experience levels.
Enchantment [%s]'s level was raised! Consumed %s experience levels.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.schrodinger.description: Is it alive, or is it dead? The only way to find out is to open the box. But since it's a cat, maybe it'll grant you some of its properties.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.spark.description: Light your weapon and fists aflame, igniting your next target on fire for a short period of time.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.spiritualist.description: The souls of the world flock to you, the one who can both see and commune with the dead. Through your knowledge of the occult, harvest souls and use them to empower your attacks.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.stagnator.description: Cease all change. The times call for it. Prevent targets from moving or regenerating, and stop all things from harming you.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.subjugator.awakening_2: <???> You... You can hear me, right? Please, answer me.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.subjugator.awakening_3: <???> ...Apologies. I cannot quite recall anything. What is my purpose?
mysticism.mysticism.skill.subjugator.awakening_oth: Someone has awakened something that was meant to lay dormant.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.subjugator.awakening_res: [2] Um??? Get out of my chat???
mysticism.mysticism.skill.subjugator.convo_busy: You are already in a conversation!
mysticism.mysticism.skill.subjugator.death_1: <%s> Death... So that is what it feels like.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.subjugator.death_2: <%s> Perhaps you should adopt a different strategy?
mysticism.mysticism.skill.subjugator.death_4: <%s> Ouch... That's gotta hurt. Get back up and try again.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.subjugator.death_5: <%s> Wish I could help you, but I'm just your skill.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.subjugator.description: You've always been a powerful manipulator. Capable of bringing anyone and anything under your control. ...But, something is strange...
mysticism.mysticism.skill.subjugator.the_voice.unb: <%s> Unbreakable Defense is active. You need to turn it off if you want to use your other abilities.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.subjugator.unbreakable_d: Your Unbreakable Defense from [Subjugator] is active! Skills and Magic cannot be used except for Battlewills!
mysticism.mysticism.skill.tenacity.description: Become tenacious and repair your body. Since magic and mana itself has rejected you, utilise your pure aura alone.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.victorious_harbinger.des: You are the forerunner of victory, your presence declares near fated victory, shatter the morale of your enemies and have no doubt in your abilities.
mysticism.mysticism.skill.zekrom.description: You seek to build a world of ideals. Be warned as not everyone shares the same ideals. Raze anything in your path with a clap of lightning.
mysticism.mysticism.soulEnergy.acquire_awakening: Awakening increased your Soul Energy by %s!
mysticism.mysticism.soulEnergy.acquire_full_reset: Reincarnating completely increased your Soul Energy by %s!

mysticism.mysticism.staff_officer_evolution: You feel your purity leaving your being... You fell from grace!
mysticism.mysticism.tengu_evolution: You feel yourself being incarnated. You became a Tengu!
mysticism.tooltip.mysticism.darkness_core: Used to convert a Fallen Angel into a Fallen. Cannot be used by any other race.
mysticism.tooltip.mysticism.strange_key_left: Part of a greater whole. Received from felling the Ruler of the Skies.

rarcompat.tooltip.relics.umbrella.ability.glider.d: When held in hand, reduces the player's vertical speed, negating fall damage. Pressing LMB propels the player backward and triggers a cooldown of %2$s seconds. The push can be used up to %1$s times in succession before the player touches the ground.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.umbrella.ability.shield.d: When used, functions as a shield, pushing targets up to %1$s blocks away.

rarcompat.tooltip.relics.plastic_drinking_hat.desc: Speeds up the drinking process, not only quickly quenching thirst but also replenishing hunger in an extraordinary way.

Replenishes %1$s hunger points when consuming liquids. Works on potions and any other items with a drinking animation.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.plastic_drinking_hat.leve: +%1$s experience points for each consumed drink.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.novelty_drinking_hat.desc: Speeds up the drinking process, not only quickly quenching thirst but also replenishing hunger in an extraordinary way.

rarcompat.tooltip.relics.snorkel.description: Allows for longer underwater exploration without the risk of drowning.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.snorkel.ability.diving.de: Applies a water breathing effect for %1$s seconds upon full submersion.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.snorkel.ability.passive.d: Removes the fog effect in liquids.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.snorkel.leveling_source.d: +%1$s experience points for each second of the water breathing effect from the %2$s ability. If the player already has a water breathing effect, its duration is subtracted from the gained experience proportionally.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.villager_hat.description: Reduces trading prices with villagers, making deals more profitable.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.villager_hat.ability.disc: Increases the discount when trading with villagers by %1$s%%.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.villager_hat.ability.pass: Prevents Iron Golems from attacking the player.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.villager_hat.leveling_sou: +%1$s experience points for each trade with villagers. The amount of experience gained increases by the discount value provided by the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.superstitious_hat.descrip: Increases loot drops from defeated mobs.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.superstitious_hat.ability: Has a %1$s%% chance to apply an additional level of Looting to defeated mobs. If successful, the ability repeats, adding another Looting level. This continues until the chance fails, summing all levels.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.superstitious_hat.levelin: +%1$s experience points for each additional level of Looting activated by the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.anglers_hat.ability.catch: Has a %1$s%% chance to increase the amount of catch received. If successful, the ability repeats, adding more catch. This continues until the chance fails, summing all catches.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.anglers_hat.leveling_sour: +%1$s experience points for each additional catch generated by the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.lucky_scarf.description: Increases Luck level when mining blocks.
Has a %1$s%% chance to apply an additional level of Luck to mined blocks. If successful, the ability repeats, adding another Luck level. This continues until the chance fails, summing all levels.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.lucky_scarf.leveling_sour: +%1$s experience points for each additional level of Luck activated by the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.scarf_of_invisibility.des: When moving carefully, makes the player invisible to surroundings.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.scarf_of_invisibility.abi: Grants the player complete invisibility. The effect is lost for %1$s seconds upon any interaction with the world. If during the absence of invisibility any mob targets the player, the effect will not restore until that mob won't lose sight of the player.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.scarf_of_invisibility.lev: +%1$s experience points for each use of the %2$s ability to become invisible.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.flame_pendant.description: Burns anyone who dares to attack the relic bearer.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.flame_pendant.ability.fir: Has a %2$s%% chance to ignite the target attacking the player for %1$s seconds.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.flame_pendant.leveling_so: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.shock_pendant.description: Strikes with lightning anyone who dares to attack the relic bearer.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.shock_pendant.ability.pas: Grants complete resistance to lightning damage.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.shock_pendant.ability.lig: Has a %2$s%% chance to strike the target attacking the player with lightning, dealing %1$s damage.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.shock_pendant.leveling_so: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.thorn_pendant.description: Poisons anyone who dares to attack the relic bearer.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.thorn_pendant.ability.poi: Has a %3$s%% chance to reflect %1$s%% damage and apply poison to the target attacking the player for %2$s seconds.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.thorn_pendant.leveling_so: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.cowboy_hat.description: Enhances the agility of the relic bearer’s mounts.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.cowboy_hat.ability.cowboy: Increases the movement speed, jump height, and safe fall height of mounts by %1$s%%.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.cowboy_hat.ability.overlo: When used, this ability allows you to ride and control any mob for up to %1$s seconds. After the time expires or dismounting, it goes on a 1-minute cooldown.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.cowboy_hat.leveling_sourc: +%1$s experience points with a 25% chance for each second of riding.
+%1$s experience points for each use of the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.crystal_heart.description: Grants the relic bearer extra strength by increasing their maximum health.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.crystal_heart.ability.hea: Increases the player's maximum health by %1$s points.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.crystal_heart.leveling_so: +%1$s experience points for each instance of health regeneration. The probability of gaining experience is inversely proportional to the ratio of current health to maximum health.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.universal_attractor.descr: Manipulates a weak magnetic field around the relic bearer, controlling the gravity of nearby items.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.universal_attractor.abili: A toggleable ability with 3 modes: Attraction, Repulsion, and Neutrality. In the red Attraction mode, items within a radius of %1$s blocks are drawn toward the player. In the blue Repulsion mode, items are pushed away. The purple Neutrality mode disables the relic's effect.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.universal_attractor.level: +%1$s experience points for each item picked up using the %2$s ability. The probability of gaining experience is directly proportional to the ratio of current item count in the stack to its maximum capacity. Does not work if the item was dropped by the relic bearer.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.cross_necklace.descriptio: Envelops the relic bearer in a protective aura, granting temporary invulnerability after each hit taken.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.cross_necklace.ability.in: Increases the duration of invulnerability after taking damage by %1$s seconds.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.cross_necklace.leveling_s: +%1$s experience points for each instance of damage taken.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.night_vision_goggles.desc: Allows the relic bearer to see more clearly in the dark.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.night_vision_goggles.abil: Enhances the brightness of poorly lit areas and reduces the effectiveness of blindness and darkness by %1$s%%.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.night_vision_goggles.leve: +%1$s experience points for every 5 seconds of movement in darkness. The probability of gaining experience is directly proportional to the current light level ratio at the player's location to the maximum.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.cloud_in_a_bottle.descrip: Enhances the relic bearer's agility, allowing for additional jumps in the air.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.cloud_in_a_bottle.ability: Allows up to %1$s additional air jumps.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.cloud_in_a_bottle.levelin: +%1$s experience points for each additional jump performed using the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.vampiric_glove.descriptio: Grants the relic bearer's attacks a vampiric effect, healing them by a portion of the damage dealt.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.vampiric_glove.ability.va: Heals the player for %1$s%% of the damage dealt.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.vampiric_glove.leveling_s: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability. The probability of gaining experience is directly proportional to the ratio of healing received to the player's maximum health.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.golden_hook.description: Allows the relic bearer to perform more precise attacks, retaining more experience from killed mobs.
Increases experience gained from killing mobs by %1$s%%.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.golden_hook.leveling_sour: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.onion_ring.description: Enhances the relic bearer's block mining efficiency when sufficiently satiated.
Increases block mining speed by %1$s%% per unit of the player's saturation.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.onion_ring.ability.satura: When mining blocks, there is a %1$s%% chance to restore 1 hunger point and 0.5 saturation to the player.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.onion_ring.leveling_sourc: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each block mined. The chance of gaining experience is directly proportional to current saturation. Does not work on blocks with instant break.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.digging_claws.description: Strengthens the relic bearer's hands, allowing them to chop through any blocks more effectively.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.digging_claws.ability.pas: Reduces the required tool level for all blocks by 1.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.digging_claws.leveling_so: +%1$s experience points for each mined block. The probability of gaining experience is directly proportional to the block's toughness. Does not work on blocks with instant destruction.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.feral_claws.description: Awakens a bloodthirsty instinct in the relic bearer, making them fight faster with each consecutive attack.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.feral_claws.ability.claws: Increases the player's attack speed by %1$s%% for each consecutive attack performed within 3 seconds of the last. Otherwise, loses 1 charge per second. Attacking with an unfilled attack speed bar resets the accumulated charges.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.feral_claws.leveling_sour: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.antidote_vessel.descripti: Enhances the relic bearer's resistance to effects.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.antidote_vessel.ability.a: Reduces the duration of negative effects received by %1$s%%.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.antidote_vessel.ability.d: Each successful attack steals %1$s seconds from all positive effects present on the target.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.antidote_vessel.leveling_: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each effect stolen using the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.power_glove.description: Allows the relic bearer to perform empowered attacks.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.power_glove.ability.power: Increases the player's damage dealt by %1$s%% but enters a 5-second cooldown after each attack.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.power_glove.leveling_sour: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.withered_bracelet.descrip: Fills the relic bearer's weapon with withering energy, affecting all it touches.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.withered_bracelet.ability: Has a %1$s%% chance to apply the Wither effect to the attacked target for %2$s seconds.
Grants complete resistance to wither damage.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.withered_bracelet.levelin: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.snowshoes.description: Improves the relic bearer's mobility in harsh snowy conditions.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.snowshoes.ability.passive: Allows walking on powder snow without sinking.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.snowshoes.ability.speed.d: Increases movement speed on snow by %1$s%%.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.snowshoes.leveling_source: +%1$s experience points for every 3 seconds of movement on snow.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.steadfast_spikes.descript: Firmly anchors the relic bearer's feet to any surface.
Increases resistance to knockback and slippery blocks by %1$s%%.
Allows slow wall sliding, negating fall damage.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.steadfast_spikes.leveling: +%1$s experience points for each knockback reduced by the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for every 3 seconds of sliding on blocks.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.rooted_boots.description: Grants the relic bearer the mysterious power of a sheep.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.rooted_boots.ability.devo: Every %1$s seconds transforms the grass block beneath the player into dirt, restoring 1 hunger and saturation point.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.rooted_boots.leveling_sou: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.warp_drive.description: Allows the relic bearer to teleport their body over short distances.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.warp_drive.ability.telepo: Teleports the player to a position along their line of sight within %1$s blocks, then goes on a cooldown for %2$s seconds.
Line of sight to teleport position
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.warp_drive.leveling_sourc: +%1$s experience points for every 10 blocks traversed using the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.charm_of_shrinking.descri: Allows the relic bearer to shrink their body to access previously unreachable areas.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.whoopee_cushion.descripti: Mysteriously increases the relic bearer's flatulence, leading to entirely unpredictable outcomes.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.whoopee_cushion.ability.p: Has a %1$s%% chance to knock back entities within a %2$s block radius, applying a 10-second nausea effect when taking damage or crouching frequently.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.whoopee_cushion.leveling_: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.kitty_slippers.descriptio: Grants the relic bearer feline traits, including soft paws and countless lives.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.kitty_slippers.ability.pa: Scares away all Creepers and Phantoms near the player.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.kitty_slippers.ability.fa: Increases safe falling height by %1$s blocks.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.kitty_slippers.leveling_s: +%1$s experience points for each fall made safe by the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.kitty_slippers.ability.re: Has a %1$s%% chance to save the player from fatal damage, leaving them with 1 health point.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.kitty_slippers.leveling_s: +%1$s experience points for each point of damage from the last fatal attack prevented by the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.bunny_hoppers.description: Strengthens the relic bearer's legs, allowing them to push off the ground more powerfully.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.bunny_hoppers.ability.hol: Allows high jumps by continuously holding the jump key for up to %1$s seconds.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.bunny_hoppers.leveling_so: +%1$s experience points for each high jump performed using the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.charm_of_sinking.descript: Grants the relic bearer's legs the ability to absorb air from the ground.
While the player stands on the underwater floor, it blocks air consumption and slowly restores its supply by %1$s seconds every second.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.charm_of_sinking.leveling: +%1$s experience points for each touch of the underwater floor.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.panic_necklace.descriptio: Quickens the relic bearer's heartbeat, warning of impending danger.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.panic_necklace.ability.pa: Increases the player's movement speed by %1$s%% for each mob within a %2$s blocks radius targeting the player for attack.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.panic_necklace.leveling_s: +%1$s experience points for each instance of damage taken from mobs affected by the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.helium_flamingo.descripti: Temporarily allows the relic bearer to glide through air as they would water.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.helium_flamingo.ability.f: When performing a double jump, allows the player to float in the air for up to %1$s seconds. Movement speed in the air is proportional to the player's swimming speed with an additional bonus of %2$s%%.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.helium_flamingo.leveling_: +%1$s experience points for each second of air swimming using the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.pocket_piston.description: Grants the relic bearer's hands the strength of mechanisms.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.pocket_piston.ability.dis: Increases knockback in melee attacks by %1$s%%.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.pocket_piston.ability.int: Increases maximum interaction range with the world by %1$s%%.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.pocket_piston.leveling_so: +%1$s experience points for each melee attack performed.
+%1$s experience points for each interaction with the world at the %2$s ability's extended range.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.obsidian_skull.descriptio: Redirects heat aimed at harming the relic bearer onto itself.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.obsidian_skull.ability.he: Completely absorbs damage from fire sources for up to %1$s seconds. If the player has not taken fire damage for 3 seconds, the absorption time regenerates each second.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.obsidian_skull.leveling_s: +%1$s experience points for each second of fire damage absorption using the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.fire_gauntlet.description: Grants the relic bearer’s weapon the powers of the fire element.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.fire_gauntlet.ability.cas: When attacking, releases several sparks that home in on nearby targets, igniting them for %3$s seconds and dealing %2$s%% of the performed attack's damage. The number of sparks is determined through repeated checks of a %1$s%% chance. Each successful check releases one additional spark, but the process stops as soon as the chance fails even once.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.fire_gauntlet.leveling_so: +%1$s experience points for each target hit by a spark from the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.pickaxe_heater.descriptio: Concentrates surrounding heat precisely onto the relic bearer's tools.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.pickaxe_heater.ability.he: Smelts any mined block if possible, consuming one charge from a buffer with a capacity of %1$s units. The buffer regenerates 1 charge every %2$s seconds.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.pickaxe_heater.leveling_s: +%1$s experience points for each block smelted by the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.chorus_totem.description: Allows the relic bearer to rewind time when making rash decisions.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.chorus_totem.ability.past: Each attack against the relic bearer has a %1$s%% chance per percent of missing health to teleport the attacker to a random location within a %2$s block radius.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.chorus_totem.leveling_sou: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.running_shoes.description: Strengthens the relic bearer's legs, allowing them to move faster.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.running_shoes.ability.run: Increases the player's running speed by %1$s%%.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.running_shoes.leveling_so: +%1$s experience points for each second of running.
rarcompat.tooltip.relics.flippers.description: Strengthens the relic bearer's legs, allowing them to swim faster.
Increases the player's swimming speed by %1$s%%.
+%1$s experience points for each second of swimming.
