regions_unexplored.advancements.regions_unexplored.descript: Discover the many biomes and explore the world!
regions_unexplored.advancements.regions_unexplored.downer.d: Walk through and take damage from a Dorcel Flower.
regions_unexplored.advancements.regions_unexplored.eternal_: Venture into all Nether biomes from Regions Unexplored!
regions_unexplored.advancements.regions_unexplored.every_bi: Collect or craft every colour of the Snowbelle Flower.
regions_unexplored.advancements.regions_unexplored.from_the: Hang from a Kapok tree's vines.
regions_unexplored.advancements.regions_unexplored.got_wood: Collect every log from Regions Unexplored.
regions_unexplored.advancements.regions_unexplored.light_as: Walk or bounce on a Giant Lily Pad.
Explore all Surface biomes from Regions Unexplored!
regions_unexplored.advancements.regions_unexplored.regions_: You've explored all the biomes from Regions Unexplored
regions_unexplored.advancements.regions_unexplored.rgbeacon: Place Prismaglass on an active Beacon
regions_unexplored.advancements.regions_unexplored.spelunke: Find all Cave biomes from Regions Unexplored!
regions_unexplored.advancements.regions_unexplored.title: Regions Unexplored
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.badland: Saguaro Cactis will generate in Badlands and Woodland Badlands.
Steppe Grass will generate in all Badlands.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.basalt_: Ash Vents will generate in Basalt Deltas.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.beach_p: Palm trees will generate in Beaches in warm areas.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.birch_a: Birch trees will generate with Aspen shaping.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.birch_o: Orange Coneflower patches will generate in Birch Forests.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.branch_: Don't place any branches on trees that would usually have dedicated branch blocks.
Place RU's dedicated branch blocks on some trees.
Place log blocks in place of branch blocks on some trees.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.brightn: The brightness of the rainbow colors.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.common_: Grass Sprouts will generate alongside Short Grass in most biomes.
Shrubs will generate in a variety of biomes.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.custom_: Peat and Silt dirt block families will generate in some RU biomes.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.desert_: Sandy Grass will generate in Deserts.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.forest_: Fancy oak tree will generate more frequently in Forests.
RU's tall flowers will generate in forested biomes.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.jungle_: Bamboo trees will rarely generate in Jungles.
Elephant Ears will generate in Jungles.
Multiplier of falling leaf/needle particle spawn rates.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.mangrov: Flowering Lily Pads will generate in Mangrove Swamps.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.oak_tal: Regular oak trees generate 2-3 blocks taller.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.painted: Re-enables the recipes of the legacy Painted Plank blocks.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.plains_: Small bushes will generate in Plains.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.prismar: Multiplier of prismarite sparkle particle spawn rates.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.saturat: The saturation of the rainbow colors.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.savanna: Small bushes will generate in Savannas.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.small_o: Oak trees with thin fence-like log blocks will generate in some forests.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.snowy_f: Frozen Grass will generate in snowy biomes.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.swamp_c: Cattails will generate in Swamp and Mangrove Swamps.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.swamp_w: Swamps will generate with rooted Willow and Oak trees.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.taiga_p: Pine trees will generate with Pine wood blocks in all Taigas.
Purple Coneflower patches will generate in Taigas.
regions_unexplored.config.regions_unexplored.option.transit: The size of a rainbow color band in Eucalyptus logs. Bigger value = bigger distance between colors.

relics.tooltip.relics.researching.badge.ability: The ability will not work under the effect of Oblivion.
The ability will not work under the effect of Silence.
The ability has reached perfect parameters. Be proud of yourself!
The ability activates immediately upon use.
The ability lasts for a certain time after use and can be interrupted by repeated use.
The ability works only with continuous use.
The ability can be toggled on/off when used.
The ability activates instantly after some time of cyclical use. The outcome may depend on the duration of use.
The ability has several modes that cycle with each use.
relics.tooltip.relics.researching.badge.relic.f: The relic has reached perfect parameters. Be proud of yourself!
relics.tooltip.relics.researching.research.tip: To unlock the ability, it is necessary to connect the stars hidden beneath the fog in such a way that the resulting constellation matches the image in the background. When the constellation is correctly aligned, the ability will be automatically researched.
relics.tooltip.relics.researching.research.hint: Cost: %1$s player experience points (%2$s relative levels) %3$s.
Hold [Shift] for fully automatic ability research.
The ability has already been researched!
relics.tooltip.relics.researching.badge.ability: Use the [%1$s] key outside any interface to call up the active abilities menu!
relics.tooltip.relics.researching.general.level: Earned when leveling up the relic and used to upgrade abilities.
relics.tooltip.relics.researching.general.playe: Player experience from 'vanilla' Minecraft. Gained by killing mobs, mining ore, smelting items, etc.
Gained with each unsuccessful reroll of a relic's random attributes and increases the chance of getting better values on the next reroll. Increases the reroll cost by 5 player experience points for each percent of luck.
relics.tooltip.relics.researching.relic.card.lo: To unlock, you need to level up the relic to %1$s!
relics.tooltip.relics.researching.relic.card.no: Ability has no upgradeable stats and does not affect the quality of the relic!
relics.tooltip.relics.researching.relic.card.un: To use, you need to conduct the research!
relics.tooltip.relics.researching.relic.card.re: Ability is ready to be unlocked! Clicks remaining: %1$s
Ability is ready to be upgraded!
relics.tooltip.relics.researching.relic.gem.low: To unlock the experience source, you need to level up the relic to %1$s!
relics.tooltip.relics.researching.relic.gem.loc: To unlock the experience source, you need to unlock and research the associated ability!
relics.tooltip.relics.researching.relic.info.ex: Relic quality is the arithmetic average of all currently unlocked abilities' quality and is measured in points from 1 to 5 with a step of 0.5. It is purely a visual metric that shows how close the item's initial random characteristics are to the best possible. To improve the overall quality of the relic, each ability needs to be considered separately.
relics.tooltip.relics.researching.relic.experie: Gained by using relic abilities as intended (more details can be found on the experience sources page). Upon reaching the maximum experience value, the relic's level and the pool of upgrade points increase by 1, allowing you to unlock previously unavailable abilities or enhance existing ones.
Ability quality, similar to relic quality, is the arithmetic average of all the ability's current characteristics and is measured in points from 1 to 5 with a step of 0.5. It is purely a visual metric that shows how close the ability's initial random characteristics are to the best possible. To improve the ability's quality, you need to reset its random characteristics until you get a better value.
relics.tooltip.relics.relic.upgrade.cost: Cost: %1$s upgrade points %2$s, %3$s player experience points (%4$s relative levels) %5$s.
relics.tooltip.relics.relic.upgrade.locked: The ability has reached its max level.
relics.tooltip.relics.relic.upgrade.quick: Hold [Shift] to automatically upgrade to the highest possible level.
relics.tooltip.relics.relic.reroll.cost: Cost: %1$s player experience points (%2$s relative levels) %3$s.
relics.tooltip.relics.relic.reroll.quick: Hold [Shift] to automatically reroll random stats to perfect values.
relics.tooltip.relics.relic.reroll.warning: Hold [Shift] to confirm rerolling stats from perfect values to other random ones.
relics.tooltip.relics.relic.reset.cost: Cost: %1$s player experience points (%2$s relative levels) %3$s.
relics.tooltip.relics.relic.reset.locked: To use you need to level-up this ability at least 1 time.
relics.tooltip.relics.infinity_ham.description: A mysterious piece of meat that smoothly regenerates to its original size, no matter how much you carve it.
relics.tooltip.relics.infinity_ham.ability.rege: Every %1$s seconds, regenerates up to 6 edible chunks, each restoring %2$s hunger points. When consumed, the relic automatically uses the required number of chunks to replenish the player's hunger.
relics.tooltip.relics.infinity_ham.ability.mari: Allows applying potion effects to the relic by left-clicking it with a potion in the inventory. Each time the relic is consumed, it applies these effects to the player for %1$s seconds per hunger point restored. Using a water bottle clears the last applied potion effects.
relics.tooltip.relics.infinity_ham.ability.meat: Allows the relic to be used as a melee weapon, dealing %1$s damage and stunning the target for %2$s seconds per chunk. Consumes all chunks when attacking, regardless of the target's remaining health.
relics.tooltip.relics.infinity_ham.leveling_sou: +%1$s experience points for each chunk consumed through the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each effect applied to the relic using the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each chunk consumed during the activation of the %2$s ability.
relics.tooltip.relics.enders_hand.description: +1 experience point for using the ability «End Transposition», +1 experience point for every 10 blocks from the distance to the target when using.
relics.tooltip.relics.enders_hand.ability.neutr: Makes endermen neutral to the wearer.
Swaps the user and the target along the line of sight within a range of up to %1$s blocks.
relics.tooltip.relics.holy_locket.description: Grants the wearer the ability to turn enemies' healing against them.
relics.tooltip.relics.holy_locket.ability.faith: Has 2 toggleable modes: Holiness and Unholiness. In the red Holiness mode, steals %1$s%% of the healing from visible entities within a radius of %3$s blocks and transfers it to the relic's wearer. In the blue Unholiness mode, deals damage to all visible entities within the same radius equal to %2$s%% of the healing received by the relic's wearer.
relics.tooltip.relics.holy_locket.ability.penit: Ignites undead enemies for 10 seconds and increases damage dealt to them by %1$s%%.
relics.tooltip.relics.holy_locket.ability.ascen: Killing a target grants the relic's wearer a temporary stacking immortality effect for %2$s seconds, up to a maximum of %1$s seconds.
relics.tooltip.relics.holy_locket.leveling_sour: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability on an undead enemy that is not yet burning.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
relics.tooltip.relics.magic_mirror.description: +1 experience point for each use of the «Wormhole» ability, +1 experience point for every 50 blocks to the teleportation point.
relics.tooltip.relics.magic_mirror.ability.tele: Upon use, teleports the owner to their spawn point if it is within %1$s blocks, then goes on cooldown for %2$s seconds.
relics.tooltip.relics.shadow_glaive.description: A masterfully forged, capricious weapon. If its temper is favorable, neither horde nor legion will withstand the onslaught of its thousand blades.
relics.tooltip.relics.shadow_glaive.ability.may: Dealing damage has a %1$s%% chance to trigger a projectile that bounces chaotically between nearby targets within a 16-block radius, up to %2$s times, dealing %3$s%% of the triggering attack's damage.
relics.tooltip.relics.shadow_glaive.ability.clo: Each projectile bounce from the Mayhem ability has a %1$s%% chance to spawn an additional identical projectile.
relics.tooltip.relics.shadow_glaive.leveling_so: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
relics.tooltip.relics.blazing_flask.description: +1 experience point for every 5 seconds of flight within the scope of the ability «Eternal Fire».
relics.tooltip.relics.blazing_flask.ability.bon: Using the ability on a block creates a restricted flight zone with a maximum flight speed of %2$s blocks per second and a height of %3$s blocks. The area size depends on the amount of fire within a radius of %1$s blocks around the center, but if there is no fire at all, the zone will not be created.
relics.tooltip.relics.elytra_booster.descriptio: +1 experience point for every 10 seconds of burning fuel when placing it in the internal buffer of the relic from the ability «Acceleration».
relics.tooltip.relics.elytra_booster.ability.bo: Using any combustible fuel that would work in a furnace on the relic in the inventory replenishes its internal buffer, which has a maximum capacity of %1$s units. Activating the ability while flying with elytra gradually increases the player's flight speed up to %2$s blocks per second, consuming fuel from the internal buffer.
relics.tooltip.relics.midnight_robe.description: +1 experience point for every 2 units of damage when attacking while being invisible from the «Disappearing» ability.
relics.tooltip.relics.midnight_robe.ability.van: Grants the wearer complete invisibility and increases their movement speed by %2$s%% when the total light level does not exceed %1$s.
relics.tooltip.relics.midnight_robe.ability.bac: An attack while using the 'Vanish' ability deals %1$s%% increased damage, marking a circle with a radius of %2$s blocks around the target and dispelling the wearer's invisibility. The 'Vanish' ability can only be used again after the wearer exits the circle.
relics.tooltip.relics.reflection_necklace.descr: +1 experience point for every 10 damage accumulated in the internal buffer of the relic from the ability «Infernal Hatred».
relics.tooltip.relics.reflection_necklace.abili: Accumulates damage taken by the wearer into the relic's internal buffer, with a capacity of %1$s units. Five seconds after the last damage received or if the buffer overflows, the relic explodes, scattering obsidian shards in all directions. Each shard deals %2$s damage and stuns for %3$s seconds per unit of damage stored in the relic's internal buffer.
relics.tooltip.relics.jellyfish_necklace.descri: +1 experience point for each activation of the ability «Electric Discharge».
relics.tooltip.relics.jellyfish_necklace.abilit: The wearer does not sink in water.
Deals %1$s damage to targets upon collision with them.
When the «Electric Discharge» ability activates, it applies paralysis to the target for %1$s seconds.
relics.tooltip.relics.spore_sack.description: A simple burlap sack filled to the brim with deadly miasma.
relics.tooltip.relics.spore_sack.ability.spore_: When the player's health drops below 50%, releases up to %1$s homing spores around them. These spores deal damage equal to %2$s%% of the player's missing health and block healing for affected targets for 5 seconds. The ability can trigger again once the player's health rises above 50%.
relics.tooltip.relics.spore_sack.leveling_sourc: +%1$s experience points for each successful hit by a spore from the %2$s ability.
relics.tooltip.relics.ice_breaker.description: +1 experience point for every 3 blocks in the fall before triggering the ability «Earthquake».
relics.tooltip.relics.ice_breaker.ability.susta: Increases fall speed, boosts knockback resistance by %1$s%%, and removes sliding on blocks.
relics.tooltip.relics.ice_breaker.ability.impac: Prolonged use of the ability while falling, up until landing, will create a shockwave with a radius of %1$s blocks, dealing up to %2$s damage and knocking back nearby targets. However, the power of the shockwave also depends on the distance the wearer has fallen.
relics.tooltip.relics.bastion_ring.description:
+1/5/10 experience point for each killed Zombified Piglin / Piglin / Piglin Brute.
+1 experience point for each additional trade from the ability «Respect».
relics.tooltip.relics.bastion_ring.ability.comp: Makes piglins neutral in relation to the wearer. The nearest piglin will indicate the location of a bastion nearby.
relics.tooltip.relics.bastion_ring.ability.trad: Each trade with piglins has a multiple 50% chance to yield an additional trade result, but the chance cannot trigger more than %1$s times.
relics.tooltip.relics.magma_walker.description: +1 experience point for every 5 units of heating from the ability «Fiery Tread».
relics.tooltip.relics.magma_walker.ability.pace: For %1$s seconds, allows walking on the surface of lava without sinking or taking damage. After the time runs out, the boots start overheating and deal damage to the wearer proportional to the level of overheating. To cool them down, the wearer must stay away from lava blocks. The cooling time also depends on the level of overheating.
relics.tooltip.relics.aqua_walker.description: +1 experience point for every 5 units of getting wet from the ability «Moisture Resistance».
relics.tooltip.relics.aqua_walker.ability.walki: For a certain period, allows walking on the surface of water without sinking. Once the time runs out, the boots start sinking, pulling the wearer underwater. To dry them, the wearer must stay away from water blocks. The drying time fully depends on the level of saturation.
relics.tooltip.relics.drowned_belt.description: +1 experience point for each level of enchantment «Riptide» on the trident when using it.
relics.tooltip.relics.drowned_belt.ability.slot: Increases the maximum number of amulet equipment slots by +%1$s.
relics.tooltip.relics.drowned_belt.ability.anch: Reduces swimming speed by %1$s%% and increases the wearer's sinking speed by %1$s%%.
relics.tooltip.relics.drowned_belt.ability.pres: Increases the damage dealt by the player underwater by %1$s%%.
relics.tooltip.relics.drowned_belt.ability.ript: Allows the trident's «Riptide» enchantment ability to be used without rain or water, adding a cooldown of %1$s seconds per enchantment level.
relics.tooltip.relics.hunter_belt.description: +1 experience point for each attack made by the wearer's pet.
relics.tooltip.relics.hunter_belt.ability.slots: Increases the maximum number of amulet equipment slots by +%1$s.
relics.tooltip.relics.hunter_belt.ability.train: Increases the damage dealt by the wearer's pets by %1$s%%.
relics.tooltip.relics.leather_belt.description: +1 experience point for each experience gained by equipped charms.
relics.tooltip.relics.leather_belt.ability.slot: Increases the maximum number of amulet equipment slots by +%1$s.
relics.tooltip.relics.rage_glove.description:
+1 experience point for every 3 charges from the ability «Berserker Rage» when they are reset.
+1 experience point for each target hit by the «Spurt» ability.
relics.tooltip.relics.rage_glove.ability.rage.d: Each attack made by the wearer within %3$s seconds of the last one accumulates 1 charge in the relic's internal buffer. The player's damage increases by %2$s%% per charge, but they also take %1$s%% more damage. If the player fails to attack within the given time to gain another charge, the relic's internal buffer is completely emptied, nullifying all accumulated bonuses.
relics.tooltip.relics.rage_glove.ability.phlebo: Increases the player's attack speed by %3$s%% and movement speed by %2$s%%, while also granting passive health regeneration of %1$s% per missing percent of the player's health.
When activated, performs a dash in the direction of the player's gaze up to %2$s blocks, igniting, inflicting bleeding, and attacking every target in its path with the item in hand. Deals additional damage to each target equal to %1$s per charge stored in the relic's internal buffer from the «Berserker's Rage» ability and then empties it, before going on cooldown for %3$s seconds.
relics.tooltip.relics.ice_skates.description: +1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the ability «Skating».
relics.tooltip.relics.ice_skates.ability.skatin: Increases movement speed on ice by %1$s%% per second of sliding. The modifier stops increasing if the sliding duration exceeds %2$s seconds.
relics.tooltip.relics.ice_skates.ability.ram.de: Upon collision with targets, deals %1$s damage per second of sliding from the «Skating» ability.
relics.tooltip.relics.amphibian_boot.descriptio:
+1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the «Fins» ability.
+1 experience point for every second of acceleration from the «Slipping» ability.
relics.tooltip.relics.amphibian_boot.ability.sw: Increases swimming speed by %1$s%% per second of swimming. The modifier stops increasing if the swimming duration exceeds %2$s seconds.
relics.tooltip.relics.amphibian_boot.ability.sl: Increases movement speed in the rain by %1$s%% per second of movement. The modifier stops increasing if the duration of movement in the rain exceeds %2$s seconds.
relics.tooltip.relics.amphibian_boot.ability.gi: With a %1$s%% chance, the player may not consume an air unit while swimming or in other conditions.
relics.tooltip.relics.chorus_inhibitor.descript: +1 experience point for every 10 blocks to the teleportation point from the «Teleportation Control» ability.
Using a chorus fruit teleports the wearer to a block along the line of sight within %1$s blocks, then goes on cooldown for %2$s seconds.
relics.tooltip.relics.wool_mitten.description: +1 experience point for every 5 units of size when hit by a snowball from the ability «Mold».
Collecting snow with an empty hand using RMB gradually forms special hardened snowballs, up to a size of %1$s units. Hitting a target with such a snowball deals %2$s damage, stuns for %3$s seconds, and freezes the target for %3$s per unit of snowball size. Holding a snowball in the inventory without the relic equipped also freezes the player.
relics.tooltip.relics.roller_skates.description: +1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the ability «Acceleration».
relics.tooltip.relics.roller_skates.ability.ska: Increases movement speed by %1$s%% per second of movement. The modifier stops increasing if the movement duration exceeds %2$s seconds. All blocks also become slippery for the wearer.
relics.tooltip.relics.space_dissector.descripti: +1 experience point for each created portal if there is no existing one
relics.tooltip.relics.space_dissector.ability.d: Holding RMB creates a portal at a point along the line of sight. Releasing RMB within a distance of %1$s blocks creates a second portal in the same way, linking it to the first. When a living entity approaches a portal, it is teleported to the linked portal. Portals do not function if impassable blocks are in their way. After %2$s seconds, the portals close and disappear.
relics.tooltip.relics.phantom_boot.description: Condenses matter beneath the relic owner's feet, creating a path through any terrain, even where no solid ground exists.
relics.tooltip.relics.phantom_boot.ability.brid: Creates a temporary phantom bridge beneath the player's feet that any relic owner can walk on. If the player stands still on the bridge for more than %1$s seconds, they will fall through and cannot get back up until they reach solid ground. While sneaking, the player is forced to fall through the phantom bridge blocks.
relics.tooltip.relics.phantom_boot.leveling_sou: +%1$s experience points with a 10%% chance each time a bridge is created using the %2$s ability.
relics.tooltip.relics.springy_boot.description: Grants the relic owner special elasticity, allowing them to bounce off any solid surface.
relics.tooltip.relics.springy_boot.ability.boun: Increases the elasticity of all blocks by %1$s%% compared to slime blocks, enabling the player to bounce off them upon landing. When activated on the ground, it launches the player into the air.
relics.tooltip.relics.springy_boot.leveling_sou: +%1$s experience points for each bounce off a surface using the %2$s ability.
relics.tooltip.relics.leveling_source.generic.s: Each time any relic in the inventory gains experience, regardless of the method, %1$s%% of that experience is also gained by this relic.
relics.command.relics.base.not_relic: The item in hand must be a relic!
relics.info.relics.researching.wrong_container: Working with the relic in this inventory is not possible. Move item to the player's main inventory and try again.

reliquified_lenders_cataclysm.tooltip.relics.scouring_eye.description: An eye torn from the socket of one of the legendary End monsters. Despite the years passed, it is still alive and searching for a target for its next battle...
reliquified_lenders_cataclysm.tooltip.relics.scouring_eye.ability.glow: Remembers the last target attacked by the player for %2$s seconds. When the ability is activated, the player is teleported behind the remembered target and the ability goes on cooldown for %1$s seconds.
reliquified_lenders_cataclysm.tooltip.relics.scouring_eye.leveling_sou: +%1$s XP for each teleportation to a target using the %2$s ability.
reliquified_lenders_cataclysm.tooltip.relics.void_vortex_in_bottle.des: A homework assignment of a student from the infamous magic school where students face deadly trials, capturing lightning, clouds, or vortexes in jars...
reliquified_lenders_cataclysm.tooltip.relics.void_vortex_in_bottle.abi: Upon killing a target, summons a void vortex %1$s blocks tall that pulls in nearby targets and goes on cooldown for %3$s seconds. After 5 seconds, the vortex explodes, dealing %2$s damage to all nearby targets. If a weaker or equal vortex is nearby, it absorbs it, growing in size and extending its duration.
reliquified_lenders_cataclysm.tooltip.relics.void_vortex_in_bottle.lev: +%1$s XP for each void vortex created by the %2$s ability.
reliquified_lenders_cataclysm.tooltip.relics.void_cloak.description: A robe belonging to a mage who, according to legend, lived beneath the bedrock of any known world. There he mastered a never-before-seen magic of void runes and defeated a massive End beast, whose eye still roams in search of battle.
reliquified_lenders_cataclysm.tooltip.relics.void_cloak.ability.void_i: Grants complete immunity to void damage.
reliquified_lenders_cataclysm.tooltip.relics.void_cloak.ability.void_r: Every %1$s seconds, summons a void rune under a random nearby target, dealing %2$s damage.
reliquified_lenders_cataclysm.tooltip.relics.void_cloak.ability.seismi: Upon the death of the player or their controlled creature, summons a seismic zone at the death location with a radius of %1$s blocks, triggering void runes up to %2$s times, each dealing %3$s damage.
reliquified_lenders_cataclysm.tooltip.relics.void_cloak.leveling_sourc: +%1$s XP for each activation of the %2$s ability.
+%1$s XP for each activation of the %2$s ability.
reliquified_lenders_cataclysm.tooltip.relics.vacuum_glove.description: One of the filthiest tools, not wielded by warriors or mages, but by 'butchers'. Its aura liquefies the air around it, hindering both movement and mind.
reliquified_lenders_cataclysm.tooltip.relics.vacuum_glove.ability.vacu: Creates an area around the player with a radius of %2$s blocks that slows all targets trying to escape it by %1$s%% at the edge. The slowdown increases the closer a target is to the boundary.
reliquified_lenders_cataclysm.tooltip.relics.vacuum_glove.leveling_sou: +%1$s XP for every 10 seconds of slowdown from the %2$s ability.
reliquified_lenders_cataclysm.tooltip.relics.void_bubble.description: A fragile yet durable device that protects the head, body, and mind all at once.
reliquified_lenders_cataclysm.tooltip.relics.void_bubble.ability.prote: Encases the player's head in a protective bubble, completely eliminating the need for air. The bubble also blocks up to %1$s incoming attacks before exploding, scattering %2$s shards in all directions, each dealing %3$s damage. It then regenerates after %4$s seconds.
reliquified_lenders_cataclysm.tooltip.relics.void_bubble.leveling_sour: +%1$s XP for each attack blocked by the %2$s ability.

reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.minotaur_hoof.description: The hoof of a beast that guarded the heart of the underground labyrinth. Rumored to grant its wearer the speed and endurance of the frenzied minotaurs.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.minotaur_hoof.ability.mom: While sprinting, gradually increases the player's movement speed up to %1$s%%. After 3 seconds of running, once the player reaches maximum speed, incoming damage is reduced by %2$s%%, and all nearby targets are knocked back and take %3$s damage until the player stops running.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.minotaur_hoof.leveling_so: +%1$s experience points for each instance of damage dealt using the %2$s ability.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.hydra_heart.description: The most valuable part of the multi-headed fire-breathing serpent that dwells somewhere in the fiery depths of the Twilight Forest. Though its original owner is long dead, the heart still beats, dripping with searing blood.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.hydra_heart.ability.hydra: When taking damage, has a %1$s%% chance to drop a blood droplet that, upon landing, creates a damaging area for %3$s seconds, dealing %2$s damage to all targets and igniting them for 5 seconds.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.hydra_heart.leveling_sour: +%1$s experience points for each blood droplet created by the %2$s ability.
reliquified_twilight_forest.item.reliquified_twilight_forest.gem.tip: Can be used to inlay the Lich Crown
Can be used to inlay the Lich Crown or to craft wands
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.lich_crown.description: The crown of the Twilight Forest’s very own king - the Lich. A symbol of his power and dominance. Legend has it that the true potential of this relic can only be unlocked by uniting all ten gems...
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.lich_crown.ability.soulbo: Allows the crown to be inlaid with %1$s special gems. Each unique gem unlocks a new ability, while additional gems of the same type increase the level of the corresponding ability. To insert a gem into the crown, right-click it while holding it in your inventory. To remove a gem, ensure your cursor is empty and right-click the crown.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.lich_crown.ability.bone_p: All skeletons become friendly towards the player.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.lich_crown.ability.fortif: Every %2$s seconds, creates a shield around the player that completely blocks most directed attacks. The number of active shields cannot exceed %1$s at a time.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.lich_crown.ability.lifedr: When the player's health falls below 20%, for 5 seconds, drains %1$s%% of their max health from all targets within %2$s blocks. Afterward, it enters a cooldown of %3$s seconds.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.lich_crown.ability.twilig: When looking at a target and pressing LMB, launches a twilight projectile moving at approximately %2$s blocks per second, dealing %1$s damage. Does not work if the target is within melee range.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.lich_crown.ability.zombie: Every %3$s seconds, spawns a mini-zombie that fights for the player, dealing %2$s damage to targets. The total number of mini-zombies cannot exceed %1$s.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.lich_crown.leveling_sourc: +%1$s experience points for each shield created by the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for every 0.5 seconds of healing done by the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each hit landed with the projectile from the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each mini-zombie spawned by the %2$s ability.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.firefly_queen.description: A fragile and slightly disgusting-looking insect capable of spawning a swarm of fireflies that will forever dispel any darkness.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.firefly_queen.ability.glo: Generates a firefly larva in the internal buffer every %1$s seconds, with a maximum of %2$s at a time. When the player is in complete darkness, it consumes 1 larva and places a firefly nearby to light the way.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.firefly_queen.leveling_so: +%1$s experience points for each firefly placed by the %2$s ability.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.cicada_bottle.description: A jar filled with the energy of hatred. Though this spawn of evil looks like a small bug, do not let your eyes deceive you. Its devilish song can evoke true rage in anyone who hears it, making them willing to do anything to make it stop.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.cicada_bottle.ability.cic: Has a %1$s%% chance on hit to inflict the Cicada's Curse on the target for %2$s seconds, forcing all nearby mobs to attack that target, ignoring their other tasks.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.cicada_bottle.leveling_so: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.deer_antler.description: A suspiciously large antler for an ordinary deer, which would look just as suspiciously fitting on some living creature.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.deer_antler.ability.ride_: When used on a creature whose hitbox volume does not exceed %1$s blocks, places it on the player's antlers and prevents it from dealing damage to the player.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.deer_antler.leveling_sour: +%1$s experience points for every 3 seconds spent with a creature on the antlers from the %2$s ability.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.scaled_cloak.description: A cloak woven from giant serpent scales not only takes on the shape of its previous owner but also inherits some of her abilities.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.scaled_cloak.ability.wall: Allows the player to smoothly climb walls for %1$s seconds. After the duration ends, the player will slowly slide down.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.scaled_cloak.ability.elus: When taking damage, has a %1$s%% chance to make the attacker miss if the player maintains eye contact with them.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.scaled_cloak.leveling_sou: +%1$s experience points for each second of climbing from the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.twilight_feather.descript: A feather from the tail of a mysterious bird that could transform into other creatures.
When attacking a target whose current health does not exceed the player's maximum health, there is a %1$s%% chance to instantly execute it, transforming it into a small bird.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.twilight_feather.leveling: +%1$s experience points for each successful activation of the %2$s ability.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.thorn_crown.description: An ornament closely tied to torment. Its sharp thorns dig into the wearer's head, bringing both unbearable pain and paralyzing power.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.thorn_crown.ability.pokin: Upon touching a target, deals %3$s damage and has a %1$s%% chance to paralyze them for %2$s seconds.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.thorn_crown.ability.thorn: Grants the player full resistance to any 'thorn' damage.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.thorn_crown.leveling_sour: +%1$s experience points for each paralysis triggered by the %2$s ability.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.steel_cape.description: A remarkably flexible yet durable material forms the basis of this cape, providing not only protection for its wearer but also retaliation when their safety is threatened.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.steel_cape.ability.iron_g: When taking damage that could potentially be mitigated by armor (even if none is equipped), reduces it by %1$s points. If the damage is not fully blocked, there is a %2$s%% chance to launch a steel orb toward the attacker, dealing %3$s damage to all in its path and stunning them for %4$s seconds.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.steel_cape.leveling_sourc: +%1$s experience points for each steel orb released by the %2$s ability.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.charm_backpack.descriptio: A seemingly ordinary backpack, yet for some unknown reason, charms inside it behave differently...
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.charm_backpack.ability.ch: Allows storing up to %1$s life or inventory charms inside the backpack. When a charm activates, it prevents complete destruction and instead goes on cooldown for %2$s minutes per its level. To store a charm, right-click on the backpack in the inventory with it. To extract a charm, the cursor must be empty.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.charm_backpack.leveling_s: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.goblin_nose.description: A nose crudely taken from a goblin. No one suspected that goblins could shed skin like lizards...
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.goblin_nose.ability.vein_: When activated, worsens vision but enhances smell, allowing the detection of valuable ores within a %1$s block radius. Also allows storing up to %2$s ore blocks inside the nose, so the sense only recognizes them. To store ore, right-click the nose in the inventory with it. To extract ore, the cursor must be empty.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.goblin_nose.leveling_sour: +%1$s experience points for each ore mined under the effect of the %2$s ability.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.giant_glove.description: A piece of gear once worn by fairy-tale giants who dwell in cloud-top huts. It's said the only way to reach them is with magic beans whose stalk pierces the skies...
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.giant_glove.ability.overs: Increases the size and stats of the held item by %1$s%%.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.giant_glove.leveling_sour: +%1$s XP for each block broken or entity hit made with an item enhanced by %2$s.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.chromatic_cloak.descripti: A stylish and vibrant cloak, woven from the wool of a mythical rainbow sheep...
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.chromatic_cloak.ability.w: Stores up to %1$s slots of wool with up to %2$s units each. Every wool color grants a specific effect, applied for %3$s seconds if not already active, consuming one unit of wool. To insert wool, right-click the cloak in inventory with wool; to extract, make sure the cursor holds no item.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.chromatic_cloak.ability.e: Increases the effect level based on the number of identical-colored wool slots, up to a maximum level of %1$s.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.chromatic_cloak.leveling_: +%1$s XP for each level of effect granted by the %2$s ability.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.lich_crown.ability.frostb: Applies a stacking frostbite effect for %1$s seconds on attack. Once the effect exceeds 7 seconds, the target takes 1 damage through armor every 2 seconds until the effect ends.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.lich_crown.leveling_sourc: +%1$s XP for each frostbite effect applied by %2$s.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.maple_syrup_bottle.descri: An endless syrup bottle that occasionally conjures up fresh waffles.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.maple_syrup_bottle.abilit: Eating a waffle increases health regeneration by %2$s%% for %3$s seconds; the effect stacks. There's a %1$s%% chance the waffle won't be consumed.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.invisibility_cloak.descri: A strange thing – stare at it long enough and it... starts vanishing? Hard to imagine why the emperor needed such a cloak...
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.invisibility_cloak.abilit: Hides the appearance of equipped armor.
Grants full invisibility after remaining completely still or sneaking without interruption for at least %1$s seconds.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.invisibility_cloak.leveli: +%1$s XP for each activation of the %2$s ability.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.parasite_115.description: ...deep within the prison chambers of the §kDark§r Tower, inmate number 115 was forcibly infected with an unknown §kparasite§r. The §klarva§r entwined with his body, feeding on his §kmind§r and flesh until only a twisted mass of reddish §krot§r remained. The warped minds of the wardens immediately forced the §kunfortunate soul§r from the neighboring cell to taste the result. He resisted, but once a piece touched his tongue...
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.parasite_115.ability.infe: Has a %1$s%% chance to infect the attacked target with a parasite, which, if the target is not attacked again within 5 seconds, delivers %2$s rapid strikes dealing %3$s damage each. If the target is killed by the parasite's attack, a random amount of §kExperiment 115§r will drop, up to %4$s units.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.parasite_115.leveling_sou: +%1$s XP for each parasite infection caused by the %2$s ability.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.parasite_116.description: ...suddenly he began to tremble, his body arching as if §ksomething§r inside tried to break free. His eyes turned white, and with a mad roar he attacked a warden, then another, and another... until no one remained in his path. He awoke deep within the §kwilderness§r of the Twilight Forest - wounded, barefoot, covered in blood. Who knows if it was his last meal to blame, or if he is now the victim of a new experiment - §k116§r.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.parasite_116.ability.infe: Has a %1$s%% chance to infect the attacked target with a parasite, which, if the target is not attacked again within 5 seconds, delivers %2$s rapid strikes dealing %3$s damage each. If the target is killed by the parasite's attack, a random amount of §kExperiment 115§r will drop, up to %4$s units.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.parasite_116.ability.rage: Consuming §kExperiment 115§r restores %1$s%% rage charge, which is consumed at a rate of 10%% per second. Rage increases the player's movement speed, attack speed, and damage. At 100%% rage, the bonus reaches %2$s%%.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.parasite_116.leveling_sou: +%1$s XP for each parasite infection caused by the %2$s ability.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.lich_crown.ability.mirror: Any attack on the player has a %1$s%% chance to be reflected back to the attacker, healing the player for the amount of damage dealt.
reliquified_twilight_forest.tooltip.relics.lich_crown.leveling_sourc: +%1$s XP for each full unit of damage reflected using the %2$s ability.

sodium.sodium.options.view_distance.tooltip: The render distance controls how far away terrain will be rendered. Shorter distances mean that less terrain will be rendered, improving frame rates.
sodium.sodium.options.simulation_distance.toolt: The simulation distance controls how far away terrain and entities will be loaded and ticked. Shorter distances can reduce the internal server's load and may improve frame rates.
sodium.sodium.options.brightness.tooltip: Controls the minimum brightness in the world. When increased, darker areas of the world will appear brighter. This does not affect the brightness of already well-lit areas.
sodium.sodium.options.gui_scale.tooltip: Sets the maximum scale factor to be used for the user interface. If "auto" is used, then the largest scale factor will always be used.
sodium.sodium.options.fullscreen.tooltip: If enabled, the game will display in full-screen (if supported).
sodium.sodium.options.fullscreen_resolution.too:
The monitor resolution and refresh rate to be used when in fullscreen mode. Changing this option may interfere with other applications and cause a delay when switching between applications.

This is only supported on the Windows operating system.
sodium.sodium.options.v_sync.tooltip: If enabled, the game's frame rate will be synchronized to the monitor's refresh rate, making for a generally smoother experience at the expense of overall input latency. This setting might reduce performance if your system is too slow.
sodium.sodium.options.fps_limit.tooltip: Limits the maximum number of frames per second. This can help reduce battery usage and system load when multi-tasking. If VSync is enabled, this option will be ignored unless it is lower than your display's refresh rate.
sodium.sodium.options.view_bobbing.tooltip: If enabled, the player's view will sway and bob when moving around. Players who experience motion sickness while playing may benefit from disabling this.
sodium.sodium.options.attack_indicator.tooltip: Controls where the Attack Indicator is displayed on screen.
sodium.sodium.options.autosave_indicator.toolti: If enabled, an indicator will be shown when the game is saving the world to disk.
sodium.sodium.options.graphics_quality.tooltip: The default graphics quality controls some legacy options and is necessary for mod compatibility. If the options below are left to "Default", they will use this setting.
sodium.sodium.options.clouds_quality.tooltip: The quality level used for rendering clouds in the sky. Even though the options are labeled "Fast" and "Fancy", the effect on performance is negligible.
sodium.sodium.options.weather_quality.tooltip: Controls the distance that weather effects, such as rain and snow, will be rendered.
sodium.sodium.options.leaves_quality.name: Leaves
sodium.sodium.options.leaves_quality.tooltip: Controls whether leaves will be rendered as transparent (fancy) or opaque (fast).
sodium.sodium.options.particle_quality.tooltip: Controls the maximum number of particles which can be present on screen at any one time.
sodium.sodium.options.smooth_lighting.tooltip: Enables the smooth lighting and shading of blocks in the world. This can very slightly increase the amount of time it takes to load or update a chunk, but it doesn't affect frame rates.
sodium.sodium.options.biome_blend.tooltip: The distance (in blocks) which biome colors are smoothly blended across. Using higher values will greatly increase the amount of time it takes to load or update chunks, for diminishing improvements in quality.
sodium.sodium.options.entity_distance.tooltip: The render distance multiplier used by entity rendering. Smaller values decrease, and larger values increase, the maximum distance at which entities will be rendered.
sodium.sodium.options.entity_shadows.tooltip: If enabled, basic shadows will be rendered beneath mobs and other entities.
sodium.sodium.options.vignette.name: Vignette
sodium.sodium.options.vignette.tooltip: If enabled, a vignette effect will be applied when the player is in darker areas, which makes the overall image darker and more dramatic.
sodium.sodium.options.mipmap_levels.tooltip: Controls the number of mipmaps which will be used for block model textures. Higher values provide better rendering of blocks in the distance, but could adversely affect performance with resource packs that use many animated textures.
sodium.sodium.options.use_block_face_culling.to: If enabled, only the faces of blocks which are facing the camera will be submitted for rendering. This can eliminate a large number of block faces very early in the rendering process, which greatly improves rendering performance. Some resource packs may have issues with this option, so try disabling it if you're seeing holes in blocks.
sodium.sodium.options.use_fog_occlusion.name: Use Fog Occlusion
sodium.sodium.options.use_fog_occlusion.tooltip: If enabled, chunks which are determined to be fully hidden by fog effects will not be rendered, helping to improve performance. The improvement can be more dramatic when fog effects are heavier (such as while underwater), but it may cause undesirable visual artifacts between the sky and fog in some scenarios.
sodium.sodium.options.use_entity_culling.name: Use Entity Culling
sodium.sodium.options.use_entity_culling.toolti: If enabled, entities which are within the camera viewport, but not inside of a visible chunk, will be skipped during rendering. This optimization uses the visibility data which already exists for chunk rendering and does not add overhead.
sodium.sodium.options.animate_only_visible_text: If enabled, only the animated textures which are determined to be visible in the current image will be updated. This can provide a significant performance improvement on some hardware, especially with heavier resource packs. If you experience issues with some textures not being animated, try disabling this option.
sodium.sodium.options.cpu_render_ahead_limit.to: For debugging only. Specifies the maximum number of frames which can be in-flight to the GPU. Changing this value is not recommended, as very low or high values may create frame rate instability.
sodium.sodium.options.use_persistent_mapping.to:
For debugging only. If enabled, persistent memory mappings will be used for the staging buffer so that unnecessary memory copies can be avoided. Disabling this can be useful for narrowing down the cause of graphical corruption.

Requires OpenGL 4.4 or ARB_buffer_storage.
sodium.sodium.options.chunk_update_threads.name: Chunk Update Threads
sodium.sodium.options.chunk_update_threads.tool: Specifies the number of threads to use for chunk building and sorting. Using more threads can speed up chunk loading and update speed, but may negatively impact frame times. The default value is usually good enough for all situations.
sodium.sodium.options.always_defer_chunk_update: If enabled, rendering will never wait for chunk updates to finish, even if they are important. This can greatly improve frame rates in some scenarios, but it may create significant visual lag where blocks take a while to appear or disappear.
sodium.sodium.options.use_no_error_context.name: Use No Error Context
sodium.sodium.options.use_no_error_context.tool: When enabled, the OpenGL context will be created with error checking disabled. This slightly improves rendering performance, but it can make debugging sudden unexplained crashes much harder.

structure_layout_optimizer.config.structure_layout_optimizer.desc: An attempt at optimizing jigsaw generation
structure_layout_optimizer.config.structure_layout_optimizer.dedupl: Deduplicate shuffled template pool element list

Whether to use an alternative strategy to make structure layouts generate slightly even faster than the default optimization this mod has for template pool weights. This alternative strategy works by changing the list of pieces that structures collect from the template pool to not have duplicate entries.
This will not break the structure generation, but it will make the structure layout different than if this config was off (breaking vanilla seed parity). The cost of speed may be worth it in large modpacks where many structure mods are using very high weight values in their template pools.

Pros: Get a bit more performance from high weight Template Pool Structures.
Cons: Loses parity with vanilla seeds on the layout of the structure. (Structure layout is not broken, just different)

tensura.tensura.race.ancient_giant.description: Ancient form of Giants with even more incredible physical capabilities and abilities.
tensura.tensura.race.arch_daemon.description: The peak evolutionary stage that can be reached by daemons in the Daemon Realm. Only the most powerful of greater daemons can ascend to this height.
tensura.tensura.race.beast_lord.description: Beastfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.beastfolk.description: A race that can freely change between their true animal form and a more a human form. They possess immense physical prowess and regenerative capabilities that let them fight without rest.
tensura.tensura.race.daemon_lord.description: One of the most powerful evolutionary stages of daemons, achieved only by the most powerful arch daemons.
tensura.tensura.race.death_oni.description: Wicked Oni that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.demon_slime.description: The ultimate stage of evolution of Slimes. They evolve to this stage by awakening as a True Demon Lord during the Harvest Festival.
tensura.tensura.race.devil_lord.description: The final stage of evolution for daemons. One emerges when a daemon meets all three requirements of a name, material body, and divinity.
tensura.tensura.race.divine_beast.description: Beastfolk that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
tensura.tensura.race.divine_bird.description: Harpy that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
tensura.tensura.race.divine_boar.description: Orc that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
tensura.tensura.race.divine_dragon.description: Dragonewt that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
tensura.tensura.race.divine_dwarf.description: Dwarf that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
tensura.tensura.race.divine_elf.description: Elf that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
tensura.tensura.race.divine_fighter.description: Wicked Oni that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
tensura.tensura.race.divine_fish.description: Merfolk that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
tensura.tensura.race.divine_giant.description: A godly race born from the earth itself, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
tensura.tensura.race.divine_human.description: Human that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
tensura.tensura.race.divine_oni.description: Oni that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
tensura.tensura.race.divine_skeleton.description: Wight that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
tensura.tensura.race.divine_vampire.description: Vampire that achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
tensura.tensura.race.dragonewt.description: The evolved form of Lizardmen and descendants of dragons. They have an average lifespan of about two hundred years.
tensura.tensura.race.dwarf.description: A sprite race descended from earth elementals. They possess an immense will and make for fierce albeit rather short soldiers.
tensura.tensura.race.dwarf_saint.description: Dwarf that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.elf.description: A sprite race descended from wind elementals. They possess a fierce talent for elemental magic and are more in tune with nature than most.
tensura.tensura.race.elf_saint.description: Elf that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.enlightened_dwarf.descripti: Dwarf that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.enlightened_elf.description: Elf that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.enlightened_hobgoblin.descr: Hobgoblin that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.enlightened_human.descripti: Human that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.enlightened_merfolk.descrip: Merfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.enlightened_ogre.descriptio: Ogre that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.ghoul.description: A vampiric thrall brought about by Blood Raise, highly weakened by sunlight.
tensura.tensura.race.giant.description: A race of powerful Majin most notable for their incredible physical capabilities and Magic Resistance.
tensura.tensura.race.goblin.description: A race of Sprite Demi-Humans. They seem to be descended from the offspring of Dwarves and Oni.
tensura.tensura.race.god_slime.description: The divine stage of evolution of Slimes.
tensura.tensura.race.greater_daemon.description: The daemon race that lesser daemons evolve to when they develop their ego and accumulate enough power.
tensura.tensura.race.harpy.description: A race of winged Majin with capability to cancel out flight spell and are often referred to as the rulers of the skies.
tensura.tensura.race.harpy_queen.description: A Queen Species of Harpy with the ability to reproduce through Parthenogenesis or Virgin Birth.
tensura.tensura.race.high_orc.description: The evolved form of Orcs. They are smarter than Orcs while preserving the Orc race's special characteristics, with appearance virtually identical to regular Orcs.
tensura.tensura.race.hobgoblin.description: The evolved form of male Goblins that is ranked D on average.
tensura.tensura.race.hobgoblin_saint.description: Hobgoblin that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.human.description: A weak but populous race that relies more on technology and numbers than brute force. Their low magicule count makes skills and magic users a rarity among them, instead favouring battlewill.
tensura.tensura.race.human_saint.description: Human that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.kijin.description: A race of Sprite Demi-Humans descended from Fire Elementals. They have an average lifespan of over a thousand years
tensura.tensura.race.lesser_daemon.description: The lowest level of the daemon race. They spontaneously come into existence within the Daemon Realm where they slowly accumulate experience from fighting and being summoned before eventually evolving into greater daemons.
tensura.tensura.race.lizardman.description: A race of scaled people descended from dragons. Their webbed feet give them an advantage in wet terrain.
tensura.tensura.race.merfolk.description: A sprite race descended from water elementals. Their fish-like bodies give them an insurmountable advantage in water.
tensura.tensura.race.merfolk_saint.description: Merfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.metal_slime.description: A slime that has taken in large quantities of Magic Ore. The dissolved ore inside of it provides a strong resistance towards most forms of damage.
tensura.tensura.race.mystic_oni.description: The result of Kijin fully returning to their roots as Elementals, making them Spiritual Lifeforms.
tensura.tensura.race.ogre.description: A sprite race descended from fire elementals. They possess immense physical capabilities and a strong Japanese lineage.
tensura.tensura.race.orc.description: A race of beastfolk who lost the ability to shift between man and beast, resulting in a permanent mix of the two. Their physical strength is greater than average but pails in comparison to their original strength as beastfolk.
tensura.tensura.race.orc_disaster.description: The evolution of an Orc Lord that is a Demon Lord Seed.
tensura.tensura.race.orc_lord.description: A very rare and powerful member of the Orc race with high intelligence who appears roughly every few centuries.
tensura.tensura.race.slime.description: A Spectral race of monster that lacks intelligence and ambition. They’re usually passive but are incredibly ruthless once provoked.
tensura.tensura.race.spirit_beast.description: Beastfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.spirit_bird.description: Harpy that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.spirit_boar.description: Orc that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.spirit_oni.description: Oni that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.spirit_skeleton.description: Wight that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
tensura.tensura.race.true_dragonewt.description: The evolution of Dragonewts and complete Spiritual Lifeforms. They are the second-highest evolutionary stage of Dragonewt known to exist.
tensura.tensura.race.vampire.description: A race of Majin with nearly eternal life. Although they can reproduce, they normally abstain. Hosting overwhelming magical energy and vitality, their flesh never decays.
tensura.tensura.race.vampire_lord.description: A vampire among the loftiest levels of power, comparable to a Demon Lord.
tensura.tensura.race.vampire_overcomer.descripti: Vampires that have evolved to overcome their weakness against the sun.
tensura.tensura.race.wicked_oni.description: A variant of Oni, possessing an essence that leans closer towards that of a Daemon rather than that of a pure Elemental.
tensura.tensura.race.wight.description: A Demi-Spiritual skeletal Undead Monster, highly weakened by sunlight.
tensura.tensura.race.wight_king.description: A type of Undead Monster and an evolution of Wights. They possess fearsome power comparable to that of Demon Lord Seeds.
tensura.tensura.reincarnation.random_race: A race randomly selected from a configurable list of options, adding an element of unpredictability to the experience. Are you willing to take the risk?

tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_5_slimes.title: Kill 5 Slimes
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_5_slimes.descrip: The swamp seems to be a habitat for slimes. Kill 5 slimes, then come back and report.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_4_8_tensura_slim: A pack of slimes has been sighted in the wild. Accept the commission to receive a target of 4 to 8 slimes, then return after the subjugation.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_5_hound_dogs.des: Hound dogs driven by summoning magic are threatening nearby routes. Slay 5 hound dogs, then return to submit the commission.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_5_barghests.desc: Barghest howls unsettle nearby settlements, and their black flames are dangerous. Slay 5 barghests, then return to submit the commission.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.collect_5_magic_ore_s: Magic ore shards split from magicule-rich veins. The guild needs samples for appraisal. Bring back 5 magic ore shards to submit.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.collect_10_medium_qua: Medium quality magic crystals store steadier magicules. The guild is restocking research materials. Bring back 10 crystals to submit.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.collect_3_palm_saplin: Palm saplings are useful for restoring coastal groves and expanding guild-managed plantations. Bring back 3 palm saplings to submit.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.collect_5_raw_blade_t: Blade tiger meat is a valuable field ration once cooked. The guild needs fresh samples for provisioning. Bring back 5 raw blade tiger meat.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.collect_5_raw_giant_b: Giant bat meat is often gathered from cave hunts. Bring back 5 raw giant bat meat for the guild stores.
High potions are reliable recovery supplies for dangerous commissions. Craft and submit 3 high potions.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.collect_2_sissie_fins: Sissie fins are treated as fish materials and are useful for food preparation. Bring back 2 sissie fins.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.collect_20_monster_le: C-rank monster leather is used for basic gear, saddles, and field equipment. Bring back 20 pieces.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.collect_10_monster_le: B-rank monster leather is tougher and suited for sturdier equipment. Bring back 10 pieces.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.collect_4_hipokute_fl: Hipokute flowers are important recovery materials and refining ingredients. Bring back 4 flowers.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.find_grimoire_d.title: Find a Grimoire (D)
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.find_grimoire_d.descr: The guild is restocking basic magic manuals. Find 1 Grimoire (D) from wizard tower ruins or old magical collections and bring it back.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.find_grimoire_c.title: Find a Grimoire (C)
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.find_grimoire_c.descr: A Grimoire (C) can hold steadier spell records for novice study. Find 1 Grimoire (C) and bring it back.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.find_grimoire_b.title: Find a Grimoire (B)
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.find_grimoire_b.descr: B-rank grimoires are uncommon and often kept by magic researchers. Find 1 Grimoire (B) and bring it to the guild for appraisal.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.find_grimoire_a.title: Find a Grimoire (A)
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.find_grimoire_a.descr: A Grimoire (A) records higher-tier magical systems. The guild needs a sample for its archives. Find 1 and submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.find_grimoire_special: A Grimoire (Special A) is said to be treasured only by veteran magic users. If you find one, bring it back for safekeeping.
A heavy core holds unusually dense power and is useful for high-grade guild appraisal work. Obtain 1 heavy core and submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.collect_1_marionette_: A marionette heart is a rare magical material with dangerous life-altering properties. Obtain 1 marionette heart and submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.collect_1_darkness_co: A darkness core emits unstable dark power. The guild needs a sample to confirm its uses. Obtain 1 darkness core and submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_elemental_colo: An Elemental Colossus carries pressure far beyond ordinary monsters. Only prepared adventurers should approach it. Slay 1 Elemental Colossus, then return to submit the commission.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_supermassive_s: The guild has detected an abnormally swollen Supermassive Slime roaming nearby. Travel to the marked coordinates, draw it out, and subjugate it before it runs wild.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.party_clear_giant_ant: Squad commission. The squad must have more than 1 member. Clear 20 Giant Ants within 150 blocks of a Giant Ant Nest. The 30 silver coin reward is split by the squad, and each member gains 25 adventure EXP.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.clear_20_black_spider: Black Spiders have blocked a route near their nest. Travel to a Black Spider Nest, clear 20 Black Spiders within 150 blocks of it, then return to submit the commission.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.investigate_wizard_to: The guild needs a report on an abandoned wizard tower. Travel to the marked coordinates, find and investigate any wizard tower, then return to submit the commission.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_3_giant_cod_f.de: Giant Cod are fighting over the coastal fishing grounds. Subjugate 3 Giant Cod, then return to the guild to submit the commission.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_3_giant_salmon_f: Schools of Giant Salmon are breaking nets and disrupting the waterway. Subjugate 3 Giant Salmon, then return to the guild to submit the commission.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.collect_3_battlewill_: Battlewill manuals are often kept near martial training grounds. The guild needs a few for beginner combat courses. Collect 3 battlewill manuals and submit them.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.craft_20_training_dum: Training dummies wear out quickly in the practice yard. The guild needs a fresh batch for basic drills. Craft 20 training dummies and submit them.

tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_orc_lord.title: Stop the Orc Lord
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_orc_lord.descr: The guild has detected an Orc Lord gathering magicules in the desert. Travel to the target coordinates, draw it out, and defeat it before it evolves further.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_orc_disaster_p: Party commission. The guild has confirmed a fully evolved Orc Disaster in the desert. Travel to the target coordinates, draw it out, and defeat it before the disaster spreads.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.collect_1_warp_core.d: Warp cores can stabilize long-distance teleportation devices. The guild needs one to inspect the teleport network.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.collect_1_daemon_core: Daemon cores hold dense dark-aspected magicules and are important for daemon summoning and sealing studies. Obtain 1 daemon core and submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.collect_1_music_disc_: This disc records a special melody, and the guild archive wants a complete sample. Obtain 1 music disc and submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.craft_10_high_potions: Advanced commissions require more High Potions for treating injured members. Craft 10 High Potions and submit them.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.collect_5_enchanted_g: Enchanted golden apples are extremely valuable emergency medical supplies. Collect 5 and submit them to the guild infirmary.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_charybdis.desc: Charybdis can tear apart trade routes and settlement defenses with violent winds. Solo adventurers or parties may accept this commission. Defeat 1 Charybdis, then return to submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_beast_gnome.de: Beast Gnome disrupts earth-aspected magicules, putting nearby mines and roads at risk of collapse. Defeat 1 Beast Gnome, then return to submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_ifrit.title: Subjugate Ifrit
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_ifrit.descript: Ifrit's heat can trigger wide-area fires, and the guild needs it suppressed immediately. Defeat 1 Ifrit, then return to submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_akash.title: Subjugate Akash
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_akash.descript: Akash causes unstable magicule reactions that are already disrupting survey teams. Defeat 1 Akash, then return to submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_undine.title: Subjugate Undine
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_undine.descrip: Undine can block roads with freezing currents and threaten riverside outposts. Defeat 1 Undine, then return to submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_sylphide.title: Subjugate Sylphide
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_sylphide.descr: Sylphide creates dangerous turbulence that disrupts aerial patrols and caravan movement. Defeat 1 Sylphide, then return to submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_infernal_drago: Ashlord's flames are powerful enough to turn towers, stockades, and entire camps into a burning ruin. The guild wants this infernal dragon cut down before another frontier outpost is lost. Defeat 1 Infernal Dragon, then return to submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_sandworm_a.des: Sirok prowls beneath the dunes, dragging caravans under the sand and erupting without warning. Merchants are already avoiding the route, and the guild needs the giant sandworm dealt with. Defeat 1 Sandworm, then return to submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_yeti_a.title: Subjugate Skor, The Yeti
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_yeti_a.descrip: Skor's freezing storms and crushing strength can lock down mountain passes in a single night. If left alone, the frost yeti will cut off supply lines to every nearby settlement. Defeat 1 Yeti, then return to submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_kraken_s.title: Subjugate Nerakyss, The Kraken
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_kraken_s.descr: Nerakyss commands the sea around its ship like a living disaster, tearing apart hulls and dragging whole crews below the waves. This is an S-rank maritime extermination with a high casualty risk. Defeat 1 Kraken, then return to submit it.
A mature fire dragon can reduce villages, roosts, and treasure roads to molten wreckage in a single raid. The guild needs it brought down before the region is scorched clean. Defeat 1 Fire Dragon, then return to submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_ice_dragon_a.d: An ice dragon can freeze rivers, bury strongholds in hoarfrost, and trap entire patrols in a whiteout. The guild has marked this target for immediate elimination before the cold spreads farther. Defeat 1 Ice Dragon, then return to submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.kill_1_lightning_drag: A lightning dragon strikes with storm-charged fury, shattering fortifications and leaving scorched ground wherever it hunts. The guild needs it eliminated before the damage spreads farther. Defeat 1 Lightning Dragon, then return to submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.collect_1_royal_blood: Royal Blood is an extremely dangerous evolution material and must be sealed under guild control. Obtain 1 Royal Blood and submit it.
tensura_guild.screen.tensura_guild.task.status.party_p: Not enough members. Task paused. The commission timer still counts.
