tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.1: You are the one everyone has been talking about lately, right? I heard you have solved quite a few problems.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.2: I just happened to pass by. It was not a big deal.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.3: Too modest. If that many people mention you, it already says plenty about your ability.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.4: So why are you looking for me?
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.5: Simple. Would you like to join our Adventurers Guild?
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.7: More precisely, the Free Guild. We do not force members to swear loyalty to any country, and we do not restrict your actions. You can take commissions, gather information, and use guild resources.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.8: That does sound convenient. But why invite me?
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.9: Because you are special. Someone like you acting alone would be a waste.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.10: Are you trying to recruit me?
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.11: You could put it that way. I prefer to call it cooperation.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.13: That is fine too. The Free Guild respects freedom. But I believe you will eventually need a place where you can exchange information and commissions.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.15: It is not confidence. It is experience. In this world, strength alone can solve many things, but not everything.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.16: Then if I join, what do I need to do?
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.17: Register your identity first. After that, you can freely choose commissions. Regular jobs, escorts, investigations, monster subjugation, all of them are available.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.21: Haha, you caught that? Do not worry. I will not let you lose out.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.22: Then I will first see what your guild can offer me.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.23: Of course. Welcome to the Free Guild. I hope we get along well.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.yuuki_intro.final: Yuuki: Thank you very much for becoming a member of our guild.
tensura_guild.screen.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dialogue: I need %s Hipokute Flowers for medicine work. Bring them back within %s and I will reward you.
How is the Hipokute Flower request going? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
Good, you have all %s Hipokute Flowers. Hand them over and I will settle the reward.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_hipokute_: The medicine stores have used up many Hipokute Flowers, and the dwarf needs a fresh batch. Collect or grow them, then return them to the task giver before the time limit ends.
Hipokute Flowers are important for recovery medicine, and the workshop is short on fresh blossoms. Bring enough flowers back to the dwarf who issued the request.
The nearby flower stock is nearly gone, and the dwarf wants someone to find or plant more Hipokute Flowers. Finish the request and return to the task giver.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_miner_mag: This vein can yield Magic Ore Shards, and the miner is short on that material. Bring a pickaxe and gather some, without ruining the good ore.
Magic ore is not ordinary stone. It holds magicules and can be useful when handled well. Mine some Magic Ore Shards and bring them back to the workshop.
The workshop needs Magic Ore Shards to test a new processing recipe. Search the mines for magic ore and bring back the shards in the best condition you can.
The miner needs magicule-bearing ore fragments. They do not need many, but they must be real magic ore. Bring back enough Magic Ore Shards for the agreed reward.
Deep in the mines, faintly glowing magic ore sometimes appears. Carefully mine it and bring back usable Magic Ore Shards before the material is wasted.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_leatherwo: Recent orders have buried the leatherworker, and the Monster Leather (D) stock is nearly gone. Gather a usable batch and return it to the task giver before the time limit ends.
The leatherworker is rushing basic travel gear, and belts and liners all need Monster Leather (D). Gather proper materials and bring them back.
More people are ordering clothes and leather fittings, and the Monster Leather (C) stock will not last. Bring back a usable batch to keep the orders moving.
The leatherworker needs sturdy Monster Leather (C) for armguard linings and coat straps. Gather the materials and return them to the task giver.
The job must be delivered on time, and without enough Monster Leather (B), the leatherworker's reputation is at risk. Bring back a batch of good leather.
Tailoring armor is not only about thread. If the leather is poor, the finished gear will not pass. Gather a proper batch of Monster Leather (B).
This is not cheap leather from a market stall. The leatherworker needs Monster Leather (A) that can truly hold up. Bring the materials back.
Advanced adventurer gear needs more reliable Monster Leather (A), and common stock will not do. Gather a batch of quality materials for the leatherworker.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_armorer_a: Craft a Giant Ant Carapace Set
Giant Ant carapace is sturdy enough to test a full smithing set. Make the full set and bring it back so I can check the finish.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_armorer_s: Serpent scales are light and durable, perfect for a set that balances movement and defense. Make the full set and hand it over.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_armorer_k: Craft a Knight Spider Carapace Set
Knight Spider carapace is tough enough for a full finished set. Make the set and bring it back so I can check the joints.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_armorer_a: Armorsaurus scales make reliable armor. Make the full set and bring it back so I can see what the workshop can do.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_armorer_l: Low Magisteel gear is a solid test of basic smithing skill. Make the full set and bring it back for inspection.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.unknown.title: Unknown Dwarf Task
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.unknown.descrip: This dwarf task is missing its description.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: I need %s Hipokute Flowers for medicine work. Bring them back within %s and I will reward you.
The Hipokute Flowers on my herb shelf are almost gone. Bring me %s within %s.
If you have time, plant or gather some Hipokute Flowers for me. I need %s within %s.
How is the Hipokute Flower request going? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
Good, you have all %s Hipokute Flowers. Hand them over and I will settle the reward.
This vein can yield Magic Ore Shards, and I need the material. Bring me %s within %s.
Magic ore holds magicules, and the workshop is waiting to start. Mine %s Magic Ore Shards within %s.
I need Magic Ore Shards to test a new processing recipe. Bring me %s within %s, as intact as you can.
I do not need ordinary gravel. It has to be real Magic Ore Shards. Bring me %s within %s.
Deep mines sometimes hold faintly glowing magic ore. Carefully mine %s Magic Ore Shards and bring them back within %s.
How are the Magic Ore Shards coming along? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
That is enough. Hand over the %s Magic Ore Shards, and this Pure Magisteel Pickaxe should serve you well.
Recent orders are crushing me, and the leather stock is almost gone. If you have time, bring me %s Monster Leather (D) within %s.
Hey, I am short on leather. If you want payment, bring me %s Monster Leather (D), and do not try to pass off torn scraps. Time limit: %s.
How is the Monster Leather (D) coming along? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
That is enough. Hand over the %s Monster Leather (D), and I will settle the reward.
More people are ordering clothes and leather fittings, but my stock will not last. Bring me %s Monster Leather (C) within %s.
I am making travel gear for adventurers, and everything from armguard linings to coat straps needs sturdy leather. Bring me %s Monster Leather (C) within %s.
How is the Monster Leather (C) coming along? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
Good, %s Monster Leather (C) is enough to get started. Hand it over.
This job has to be delivered on time. Without enough good leather, my signboard is at risk. Bring me %s Monster Leather (B) within %s.
Good armor is not made with thread alone. Poor leather makes poor gear. Gather %s Monster Leather (B) within %s.
How is the Monster Leather (B) coming along? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
Good. The %s Monster Leather (B) is usable quality. Hand it over.
This is not cheap market leather. I need leather that can really do the job. Bring me %s Monster Leather (A) within %s.
Advanced adventurer gear cannot be patched together with poor materials. Bring me %s Monster Leather (A), and I will pay you properly. Time limit: %s.
How is the Monster Leather (A) coming along? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
Well done. %s Monster Leather (A) is enough to finish this batch. Hand it over.
I want a full Giant Ant Carapace set, and the workmanship had better be clean. Bring the set back within %s and I will settle up.
Serpent Scalemail is a good fit for this job. Make the full set and bring it back within %s, no missing pieces.
Knight Spider carapace is not easy to work with, so I want the full set. Bring the armor back within %s and make it count.
The workshop wants an Armorsaurus Scalemail set. Bring the full set back within %s, and do not drag it out.
Low Magisteel is simple enough, but the set has to be neat. Bring the full armor set back within %s.
How is the armor set coming along? You have %s/%s pieces. Time left: %s.
Good. All %s armor pieces are ready. Hand them over and I will settle the reward.
tensura_guild.screen.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_lo: The dwarf task disappeared because the client dwarf is gone.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.guild_: Hey! How about I give you a map to the Adventurer Guild? I think you would be a great fit there!
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.refuse: Hmph. I do not hand work to people who are unwelcome here.
Clean up your name before you come asking me for a request.
The guild does not trust just anyone, especially someone with your reputation.
I have heard about you. I have nothing to entrust to you for now.
Until you prove yourself, do not expect me to give you work.
Want a request? Make the dwarves willing to trust you again first.
You do not have a good name here. I have no reason to hire you.
You lack even basic credit, and you still want work from me?
Go clean up the trouble you caused, then come back.
I am not short on adventurers. I am short on people worth trusting.
Do not blame me for being blunt. With a reputation like yours, I cannot use you.
When your reputation is no longer negative, we can talk requests again.
Your name has not been traveling well lately, so I will not risk workshop business on you.
Dwarves trade on trust, and right now that is exactly what you lack.
Stay away from my request board until people here trust you again.
I will not put my work at risk for your bad name. No requests today.
Get the dwarf quarter willing to nod at you first, then knock on my door.
If you truly want work, earn back the trust you lost first.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: How is the fresh meat collection going? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
That is enough. Hand over the %s cuts. I will pay you and throw in the cooked stock I prepared.
How are the materials coming along? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
Good. Hand over the %s materials. These will keep today's work moving.
Still short on Blade Tiger tails? You have %s/%s. Time left: %s.
Good work. %s Blade Tiger tails will do nicely. Hand them over and the gold is yours.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_butcher_r: The butcher wants raw Blade Tiger meat for a new curing method. If the cuts are fresh enough, they can become travel rations fit for adventurers. Bring back a usable batch.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: Blade Tiger meat has firm fibers and makes excellent dried rations. Bring me %s raw cuts within %s.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_butcher_r: Armorsaurus meat comes in heavy cuts and works well for soups and stews. The butcher wants to stock up today, so bring back a fresh batch.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: Armorsaurus meat makes the most filling broth around. Bring me %s raw cuts within %s.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_butcher_c: Cattledeer beef always sells well, and the butcher wants the next batch ready before evening. Bring back a supply of decent cuts.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: Demand for Cattledeer beef is high and my stock is nearly gone. Bring me %s cuts within %s.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_butcher_r: Giant Bat meat gains a distinct flavor once cured, and even taverns place orders for it now and then. The butcher is short on that ingredient, so refill the supply.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: A customer asked for Giant Bat meat and I am completely out. Bring me %s raw cuts within %s.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_butcher_k: Knight Spider legs take effort to prepare, but the cooked result is better than most expect. The butcher wants a batch ready to test demand.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: Knight Spider legs look nasty, but some people swear by them once stewed. Bring me %s legs within %s.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_butcher_g: Giant Ant legs yield more usable meat than they seem, and skewered cuts sell well enough. The butcher needs ingredients in a hurry.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: The kitchen wants to test a new roast today, and it needs proper ingredients first. Bring me %s Giant Ant legs within %s.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_butcher_r: Serpent meat has a strong smell and must be processed while fresh. The butcher wants to turn it into a spice cure, so bring back enough to work with.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: Serpent meat spoils in flavor if it sits too long. Bring me %s raw cuts within %s while it is still fresh.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_butcher_r: Spear Toro meat is tender and perfect for salted slices that keep well. The butcher is missing this main ingredient, so fill the order.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: Spear Toro meat is delicate, and a proper cure turns it into premium stock. Bring me %s raw cuts within %s.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_butcher_s: Dried Spear Toro fins make a fine stock for soups, and both taverns and workshops have use for them. The butcher is short on material, so gather a batch.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: I want to simmer a few proper pots of fish broth, but I am out of Spear Toro fins. Bring me %s within %s.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_butcher_g: Giant Ant carapace is hard, but intact pieces can be turned into knife handles and kitchen guards. The butcher wants material that can go straight to work.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: Do not underestimate carapace. Treated properly, it has its uses in a kitchen. Bring me %s intact Giant Ant carapaces within %s.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_butcher_k: Knight Spider carapace has the toughness needed for small workshop tools once polished down. The butcher wants to restock supplies.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: Knight Spider carapace is both tough and resilient, perfect for refitting a few tools. Bring me %s within %s.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_butcher_a: Armorsaurus scales are heat-resistant and sturdy, useful for replacing worn shields beside the stove. Gather a batch that is still fit to use.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: The guards by the stove are wearing out, and Armorsaurus scales are just right to replace them. Bring me %s within %s.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_butcher_a: Armorsaurus shell is thick and dependable, and once flattened it makes a fine butchering board. The butcher wants to replace old equipment.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: Armorsaurus shell is thick enough to make a fine work board once shaped. Bring me %s within %s.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_butcher_s: Serpent scales have a dense surface that suits finer kitchen fittings for trimming meat and fish. The butcher is short on this useful material.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: Serpent scales are just right for small fittings and fine work. Bring me %s within %s.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_butcher_c: Centipede stingers need careful handling, but once processed they can aid preservative coatings and spice mixes. The butcher wants them for a new recipe.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: I am testing a new curing mix, and what I need most are Centipede stingers. Bring me %s within %s.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_butcher_s: Ground Spider fangs can be used in special seasoning and preservation work. They are not used often, but shortages become a problem fast.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: Spider fangs are not needed every day, but once they are gone, everything slows down. Bring me %s within %s.
tensura_guild.dwarf_task.tensura_guild.dwarf_butcher_b: Blade Tiger tails carry tough sinew and make a rare dish the butcher only serves to trusted customers. The material is hard to source, and the reward reflects that.
tensura_guild.dialogue.tensura_guild.dwarf_task.dwarf_: Blade Tiger tails are not something you find every day. Bring me %s within %s and I will pay you in gold.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.craft_1_void_refineme: The guild has received word that a cultivator workshop urgently needs a Void Refinement Pill for a dangerous breakthrough attempt. Craft 1 Void Refinement Pill and submit it before the deadline.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.craft_1_mystic_void_e: A sealed alchemy request has arrived at the guild, demanding a Mystic Void Elixir refined to a stable state. Craft 1 Mystic Void Elixir and bring it back for delivery.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.craft_1_giant_spirit_: An advanced practitioner is paying handsomely for a Giant Spirit Pill strong enough to support a major cultivation stage. Craft 1 Giant Spirit Pill and submit it to the guild.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.craft_1_hihiirokane_b: A top-tier workshop wants to inspect a Hihiirokane Bone Golem as a model for elite autonomous guardians. Craft 1 Hihiirokane Bone Golem and turn it in before the order is withdrawn.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.craft_1_adamantite_bo: A fortified estate is commissioning an Adamantite Bone Golem durable enough to stand as a permanent defender. Craft 1 Adamantite Bone Golem and return to submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.craft_1_orichalcum_bo: The guild needs a completed Orichalcum Bone Golem for a defensive evaluation contract. Craft 1 Orichalcum Bone Golem and bring it back on time.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.craft_1_pure_magistee: A client from the workshop district has requested a Pure Magisteel Bone Golem to test advanced magical reinforcement methods. Craft 1 Pure Magisteel Bone Golem and submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.craft_1_mithril_bone_: A local defense supplier is short on compact constructs and wants a Mithril Bone Golem ready for field trials. Craft 1 Mithril Bone Golem and bring it in.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.craft_1_high_magistee: The guild workshop wants a High Magisteel Bone Golem to compare durability against recent combat reports. Craft 1 High Magisteel Bone Golem and submit it.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.craft_1_low_magisteel: Even lower-grade constructs are in demand when patrol routes need more bodies on watch. Craft 1 Low Magisteel Bone Golem and return it to the guild.
tensura_guild.task.tensura_guild.craft_1_warp_core_b.d: The transport network is missing a stable Warp Core, and the guild needs a fresh one forged before repairs can continue. Craft 1 Warp Core and submit it.

tensura_tno.tensura_tno.compat.tensuramoreskills.har: , still bearing the authority to call forth his angels.
<Avalon> I lost... Avalon is no more. The world.. belongs to their Endless Desire...
<Avalon> It is clawing its way to the surface! Forgive me... I can no longer contain the power of Oblivion as well as before, run while you still can.
<Avalon> My focus.. it is shattering. The seal is slipping! I cannot.. you must strike harder, or we are all doomed!
<Avalon> Turn back.. This burden is for me alone... If you step forward.. I will have no choice but to fight back.
<Feldway> Claim the Four Shades... and prove you can bear their authority.
<Feldway> So even this vessel can be brought low.
<Feldway> Then take witness. Beyond this defeat, four shadows still remain.
<Feldway> Time. Space. Life. Death. The shades answer only to the one who endures.
<Feldway> You have opened the path. Now inherit what stands behind creation.
<Novari> Ah, finally... a chance to stretch these limbs. Go on, then. Strike me. Give me everything you have. I promise to give it right back.
<Novari> Buried... again? In the dark... by a weakling like you... No... Avalon... do not celebrate... I am... your shadow... I will... return...
<Novari> Feast your eyes on the void! Everything you love, everything you are, it will all be digested into my eternal eternity! Die!
<Novari> Is that the absolute peak of your strength? How pathetic. Let me show you what happens when the seal truly shatters!
<Novari> No... NO! I will not be contained again! If I cannot possess this world, I will reduce it to absolute nothingness!
<Novari> The crown opens. The phenomena kneel.
<Novari> The world's phenomena belong to me! Your magic, your unique talents, your very breath... I claim it all.

tensura_tno.tensura_tno.compat.tensurabarriers.guide: §bContainment§r: Prevent normal exit of the barrier
§bBlock Entry§r: Prevent normal entry into the barrier
§bProjectile Shield§r: Absorbs projectiles that hit the barrier
§bReflect Projectiles§r: Reflects projectiles that hit the barrier
§bProtect Blocks§r: Blocks inside can't be broken by others
§bSpatial Lock§r: Teleports and warps can't bypass the barrier
§bStructural Integrity§r: Each level reduces the HP a barrier loses from its size by §6%1$s§r
§bDistortion Field§r: Stops spatial attacks (which normally bypass barriers)

§bClash§r: Barriers overlapping yours that aren't allied take §6%1$s§r damage every §6%2$ss§r, §6+%3$s§r per level. A barrier does damage in proportion to its §bsize§r, so casting a small barrier is not always optimal. Keeping the barrier up also costs §6%4$s%%§r of your own maximum health each exchange
§bThorns§r: Anything the barrier keeps in or out takes §6%1$s§r damage per level when it touches the wall, at most once every §6%2$ss§r. Only works with §bContainment§r or §bBlock Entry§r
§bElemental Resistance§r: Pick an element, the barrier takes §6%1$s§r less damage from that chosen element
§bMagicule Regen Down§r: Cuts magicule regen by §6%1$s§r/level; caster at §6%2$s§r strength
§bAura Regen Down§r: Cuts aura regen by §6%1$s§r/level; caster at §6%2$s§r strength
§bRegen Down§r: Cuts all healing inside by §6%1$s§r/level
§bDisable Nullifications§r: Toggles all nullifications off, including the caster
§bMagic Jamming§r: Reduces aspectual & spiritual magic damage by §6%1$s§r/level
§bMultilayer§r: Adds layers to a barrier, HP is split between these layers. Every broken layer passes §6%1$s§r of its max HP to the next
§bSound Isolation§r: Sound (and chat) can't pass the wall in either direction
§bAstral Bind§r: Spiritual beings or players with divinity can't escape
§bSuppress Spawns§r: Hostile mobs never spawn inside
§bAlert Owner§r: You're told when a target enters the barrier. Its dropdown sets the §6EP§r requirement needed before an intruder is reported
§bMagicule Efficiency§r: §6%1$s§r less cast & upkeep cost per level
§bEnlarge§r%1$s: Increases the size limit on barriers by §6%2$sx§r, barriers lose §6%3$s§r less HP from size increases

§bSoul Consume§r%1$s: Every §6%2$ss§r everything inside the barrier loses §6%3$s§r of its §dspiritual HP§r, ignoring spiritual attack resistance. Spiritual life forms lose §6%4$sx§r as much. Anything with more than §6%5$s§r of your EP is unaffected

§bMurderer§r%1$s: §e[Necrosis]§r disables all regeneration except for §6Infinite Regeneration§r, instead decreases it by §6%2$s§r, and removes death prevention from anyone with at most 1/§6%3$s§r of your EP. §e[Remove]§r disables resistances unless the target has §6%4$s§r more EP than you and nullifications unless they have §6%5$s§r more EP than you

§bArroganz§r%1$s: Projectiles the barrier absorbs have a §6%2$s§r chance to be analyzed into §5Lucifer§r or §5Nodens§r; every §6%3$ss§r scan there is a §6%4$s§r/level to copy a skill from someone inside

§bDominion§r%1$s: Temporarily acquire §eVirtue§r skills from those inside; copy an §eAngelic§r §cUltimate§r if its holder has no more than §6%2$s§r more EP than you; lock others from using their §eAngelic§r §cUltimates§r unless they have at least §6%3$sx§r your EP; foes under §6%4$s§r of your EP are marked allies

§bEmbracing Drain§r%1$s: Everything in the barrier's containment filter loses §6%2$s§r of its magicules and aura every §6%3$ss§r, and is stunned for §6%4$ss§r each time energy is taken. Once a captive is at §6%5$s§r of either magicules or aura, there is a §6%6$s§r chance every §6%7$ss§r to call down §5Death Blessing§r

§bEnrage§r%1$s: Every hostile or non allied player inside gives you a §6%2$s§r chance every §6%3$ss§r to gain a level of §cRampage§r for §6%4$ss§r. At §cRampage %5$s§r it inverts: every §6%6$ss§r the barrier inflicts §cRampage§r on everyone inside instead, up to level §6%7$s§r

§bDeep Sleep§r%1$s: Your hits inside deal §6%2$s§r extra spiritual damage. You bypass spiritual attack resistance, spiritual attack nullification is treated as resistance. Non-allied players chant at §6%3$s§r speed and are given §5Drowsiness %4$s§r

§bNuclear Bomb§r%1$s: When below §6%2$s§r health the barrier gains §6+1§r charges every §6%3$ss§r (max §6%4$s§r). When it breaks it detonates destroying §6%5$s§r blocks and causes §6%6$s§r damage, +§6%7$s§r block and §6%8$s§r damage per charge. Needs §6%9$s§r Fusionist matter
§bBattlefield§r%1$s: Allies inside gain §6+%2$s§r attack, speed, and health. A §6%3$s§r auto dodge, and a §6%4$s§r chance for their attacks to pierce enemy dodges

§bLast Chance§r%1$s: The first ally who would die inside is restored to §6%2$s§r health, their magicules and aura are restored to §6%3$s§r and are granted §6%4$ss§r of invulnerability. This effect can only happen once per barrier and that ally waits §6%5$s min§r before it can activate again. Allies under §6%6$s§r health get §cStrength %7$s§r, §6+%8$s§r attack speed, §6+%9$s§r movement speed and §6+%10$s§r swim speed

§bIndestructible Wall§r%1$s: §6+%2$s§r barrier HP. §6%3$s§r of any damage done to allies inside is instead dealt to §cyourself§r. This barrier is incapable of saving allies from spiritual damage. Allies inside gain +§6%4$s§r armor and §6+%5$s§r knockback resistance

§bTakeover§r%1$s: Your hits have a §6%2$s§r chance to seize §6%3$s§r of the target's magicules, and a §6%4$s§r chance (§6%5$ss§r cooldown) to plunder one common, extra or aspectual magic from anyone whose EP is no more than §6%6$s00%%§r of yours. Summons inside whose owner is at or under §6%7$s00%%§r your EP become yours

§bReflector§r%1$s: Melee damage directed at the barrier returns §6%2$s§r of its damage to the attacker. Projectiles are sent back at §6%3$sx§r damage and §6%4$sx§r speed, homing onto whoever fired them. However this barrier only has §6%5$s§r of the usual HP

§bAcceleration§r%1$s: All non-magic damage inside the barrier becomes §cflame§r damage. Each crit you land (§6%2$ss§r cooldown) grants a §6Boost§r, boost give §6+%3$s§r movement speed and §6+%4$s§r projectile speed each lvl, however you lose 1 boost every §6%5$ss§r. Starting from §6Boost %6$s§r you radiate an aura of heat for §6%7$s§r damage every §6%8$ss§r with a radius of §6%9$s§r blocks, increasing by §6+%10$s§r per level. At §6Boost %11$s§r the wall cannot contain the heat and bursts. Trigger a §6%12$s§r block explosion for §6%13$s§r flame damage.

§bFamily Bond§r%1$s: Up to §6%2$s§r allies inside split the barrier's upkeep with you. An ally at or below §6%3$s§r of their magicules stops paying and their share returns to you. Players are picked before other entities

§bFull Counter§r%1$s: Any projectile that would hit you while inside the barrier is swallowed by the barrier and it's damage is stored. §6%2$ss§r after the first shot is caught, the wall releases everything it holds at §6%3$sx§r the damage, this damage is split evenly among the entities inside.
§bBerserker§r%1$s: Every EP milestone you have passed (§6%2$s§r of them) adds §6+%3$s§r barrier HP

§bBerserk§r%1$s: Raises the size limit on barriers by §6%2$sx§r, and every physical hit you or your allies land inside deals §6%3$s§r of its damage again as §cfire§r, and then burning the target for §6%4$ss§r
§bRoyal Beast§r%1$s: Inside, battlewill damage is cut to §6%2$s§r, yours included. While you are transformed battlewills will deal §6%3$s§r damage instead. Magic and elemental damage are nullified
§bSurvivor§r%1$s: The barrier takes §6%2$s§r less damage, and after §6%3$ss§r of not being hit it heals itself for §6%4$s§r of its maximum HP every second
§bEnvy§r%1$s: Every §6%2$ss§r everything trapped inside loses between §6%3$s§r and §6%4$s§r of its magicules, and they are given to you
§bPride§r%1$s: Any ability cast inside has a §6%2$s§r chance of being copied into §5Pride§r once every §6%3$ss§r This doesn't work on uniques or ultimates
§bTraveler§r%1$s: The barrier travels with you when you warp, teleporting everyone inside along with it
§bOppression§r%1$s: There is a §6%2$s§r /level to inflict Oppression for §6%3$ss§r, rolled every §6%4$ss§r
§bDomain§r: §6+%1$s§r chant speed, projectiles auto track the nearest enemy, and enemies inside are stripped of barriers
§bVeil§r: Everyone inside is wrapped in Presence Concealment and the barrier turns invisible. How well it hides depends on your veiling skill (§bHaze§r/§bFalsifier§r hide less than §bMurderer§r's)
A §bBarrier Anchor§r is a block that holds a barrier up on its own, its fueled with magic crystals or magic ore.Barrier remains running while you are logged out
Whoever places the barrier anchors owns it. Only the owner and their §ballies§r may configure it
An anchor can be §bpowered§r with redstone to start the barrier. A lever is the preffered methods to use
§eAnchor tiers§r: A higher tier anchor cost less fuel, has more HP, covers a larger distance, and unlocks core slots
§eCores§r go in an anchor's core slots and give the barrier additional effects
Every design is paid for with §6points§r spent on §6modifiers§r and §bIntegrity§r

toms_storage.toms_storage.configuration.importantInfo:
IMPORTANT NOTICE:
THIS IS ONLY THE COMMON CONFIG. It does not contain all the values adjustable for Tom's Simple Storage
The settings have been moved to toms_storage-server.toml
That file is PER WORLD, meaning you have to go into 'saves/<world name>/serverconfig' to adjust it. Those changes will then only apply for THAT WORLD.
You can then take that config file and put it in the 'defaultconfigs' folder to make it apply automatically to all NEW worlds you generate FROM THERE ON.
This may appear confusing to many of you, but it is a new sensible way to handle configuration, because the server configuration is synced when playing multiplayer.

twilightforest.config.twilightforest.animate_trophies.t: Rotate Trophy heads on item model. Has no performance impact at all. For those who don't like fun.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.aurora_biomes.tool: Defines which biomes the aurora shader effect will appear in. Leave the list empty to disable the effect.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.boss_drop_chests.t:
If true, Twilight Forest's bosses will put their drops inside of a chest where they originally spawned instead of dropping the loot directly.
Note that the Knight Phantoms are not affected by this as their drops work differently.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.casket_uuid_lockin:
If true, Keepsake Caskets that are spawned when a player dies will not be accessible by other players. Use this if you dont want people taking from other people's death caskets.
NOTE: server operators will still be able to open locked caskets.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.check_portal_place:
Determines if new portals should be pre-checked for safety. If false, portals will fail to form rather than redirect to a safe alternate destination.
Note that disabling this also reduces the rate at which portal formation checks are performed.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.cloud_precipitatio:
Dictates how many blocks down from a cloud block should the game logic check for handling weather related code.
Lower if experiencing low tick rate. Set to 0 to turn all cloud precipitation logic off.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.default_item_encha:
If false, items that come enchanted when you craft them (such as ironwood or steeleaf gear) will not show this way in the creative inventory.
Please note that this doesn't affect the crafting recipes themselves, you will need a datapack to change those.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.destructive_portal: Set this to false if you want the lightning that zaps the portal to not set things on fire. For those who don't like fun.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.dim_settings.toolt: Settings that are not reversible without consequences.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.disable_portal.too: Disable Twilight Forest portal creation entirely. Provided for server operators looking to restrict action to the dimension.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.disable_skull_cand: If true, disables the ability to make Skull Candles by right clicking a vanilla skull with a candle. Turn this on if you're having mod conflict issues for some reason.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.disable_uncrafting:
Disables the uncrafting function of the uncrafting table. Recommended as a last resort if there's too many things to change about its behavior (or you're just lazy, I dont judge).
Do note that special uncrafting recipes are not disabled as the mod relies on them for other things.

Disables any usage of the uncrafting table, as well as prevents it from showing up in loot or crafted.
Please note that table has more uses than just uncrafting, you can read about them here! http://benimatic.com/tfwiki/index.php?title=Uncrafting_Table
It is highly recommended to keep the table enabled as the mod has special uncrafting exclusive recipes, but the option remains for people that dont want the table to be functional at all.
If you are looking to just prevent normal crafting recipes from being reversed, consider using the 'disableUncrafting' option instead.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.first_person_glove: Allows Traveller's Gloves to render on your hand when in 1st person view.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.giant_skin_uuid_li: List of player UUIDs whose skins the Giants should use. Leave the list empty to use the skin of the player viewing them.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.ingredient_switchi:
If true, the uncrafting table will no longer allow you to switch between ingredients if a recipe uses a tag for crafting.
This will remove the functionality for ALL RECIPES!
If you want to prevent certain ingredients from showing up in the first place, use the "twilightforest:banned_uncrafting_ingredients" tag.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.item_display.toolt: Controls where various elements render when using the Item Display Modifier on Traveller's Gear.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.locked_toasts.tool: Disables the toasts that appear when entering a locked biome. Not recommended if you're unfamiliar with progression.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.magic_trees.toolti: Settings for all things related to the magic trees.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.manual_travellers_: When this option is off, slow falling is the default. Holding the sneak key makes you fall at normal speed. When this option is on, normal falling is the default. Holding the sneak key activates slow falling.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.max_portal_size.to: The max amount of water spaces the mod will check for when creating a portal. Very high numbers may cause performance issues.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.mining_range.toolt:
Defines the radius at which the Minewood Core works. Can be a number anywhere between 1 and 128.
Set to 0 to prevent the Minewood Core from functioning.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.multiplayer_fight_:
Determines how bosses should adjust to multiplayer fights. There are 4 possible values that can be put here:
NONE: doesnt do anything when multiple people participate in a bossfight. Bosses will act the same as they do in singleplayer or solo fights.
MORE_LOOT: adds additional drops to a boss' loot table based on how many players participated in the fight. These are fully controlled through the entity's loot table, using the `twilightforest:multiplayer_multiplier` loot function. Note that this function will only do things to entities that are included in the `twilightforest:multiplayer_inclusive_entities` tag.
MORE_HEALTH: increases the health of each boss by 20 hearts for each player nearby when the fight starts.
MORE_LOOT_AND_HEALTH: does both of the above functions for each boss.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.optifine.tooltip: Disable the nag screen when OptiFine is installed.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.origin_dimension.t: The dimension you can always travel to the Twilight Forest from, as well as the dimension you will return to. Defaults to the overworld. (domain:regname).
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.parry_non_twilight: Set to true to parry non-Twilight projectiles.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.parry_window.toolt: The amount of ticks after raising a shield that makes it OK to parry a projectile. (1 tick = 1/20 second)
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.portal_for_new_pla: If true, the return portal will spawn for new players that were sent to the TF if `newPlayersSpawnInTF` is true.
Allows people with the specified permission or higher to create portals. This is based off of Vanilla's permission system.
You can read about them here: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Permission_level
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.portal_return.tool: If false, the return portal will require the activation item.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.portal_settings.to: All settings regarding the Twilight Forest Portal are found here
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.portal_unlocked_by: Use a valid advancement resource location as a string. For example, using the string "minecraft:story/mine_diamond" will lock the portal behind the "Diamonds!" advancement. Invalid/Empty Advancement resource IDs will leave the portal entirely unlocked.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.portals_in_other_d: Allow portals to the Twilight Forest to be made outside of the 'origin' dimension. May be considered an exploit.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.prettify_ore_meter: Lines up the dashes and percentages in the Ore Meter GUI.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.ram_indicator.tool: Renders a check mark or X above your crosshair while holding wool when hovering over the Questing Ram depending on if that color of wool has been fed to it already.
Multiplies the total XP cost of repairing an item and rounds up.

The table was originally intended to only take shaped recipes, but this option remains for people who wish to keep the functionality.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.shield.tooltip: We recommend downloading the Shield Parry mod for parrying, but these controls remain for without.

twilightforest.config.twilightforest.shield_indicator_c: Enables the fortification shield indicator in creative for debugging.

twilightforest.config.twilightforest.silent_cicadas_on_: Makes Cicadas silent when one is on your head. If the above option is set to true, this won't have any effect.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.sorting_range.tool:
Defines the radius at which the Sortingwood Core works. Can be a number anywhere between 1 and 128.

twilightforest.config.twilightforest.spawn_in_tf.toolti: If true, players spawning for the first time will spawn in the Twilight Forest.

twilightforest.config.twilightforest.twenty_four_hour_f: If ON, the clock upgrade displays time in 24-hour format instead of 12-hour format.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.uncrafting.tooltip: Settings for all things related to the Uncrafting Table.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.uncrafting_mod_id_: If true, this will invert the above option from a blacklist to a whitelist.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.uncrafting_mod_ids:
Here, you can disable all items from certain mods from being uncrafted.
Input a valid mod id to disable all uncrafting recipes from that mod.
Example: "twilightforest" will disable all uncrafting recipes from this mod.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.uncrafting_recipes:
If you don't want to disable uncrafting altogether, and would rather disable certain recipes, this is for you.
To add a recipe, add the mod id followed by the name of the recipe. You can check this in things like JEI.
Example: "twilightforest:firefly_particle_spawner" will disable uncrafting the particle spawner into a firefly jar, firefly, and poppy.
If an item has multiple crafting recipes and you wish to disable them all, add the item to the "twilightforest:banned_uncraftables" item tag.
If you have a problematic ingredient, like infested towerwood for example, add the item to the "twilightforest:banned_uncrafting_ingredients" item tag.
If true, this will invert the above uncrafting recipe list from a blacklist to a whitelist.
twilightforest.config.twilightforest.uncrafting_xp_cost:
Multiplies the total XP cost of uncrafting an item and rounds up.
Higher values means the recipe will cost more to uncraft, lower means less. Set to 0 to disable the cost altogether.
Note that this only affects reversed crafting recipes, uncrafting recipes will still use the same cost as they normally would.

twilightforest.twilightforest.book.author: a forgotten explorer
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.darktower.1:
§8[[An explorer's notebook that seems to have survived an explosion]]§0

This tower clearly has mechanisms that are not responding to me. Their magic almost yearns to acknowledge my touch, but it cannot. It is if the devices of the tower are being
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.darktower.2:
suppressed by a powerful group of beings nearby.

§8[[Next entry]]§0

The magic seems to emanate from deep within the strongholds nearby. It can't come from the goblins, as their magic is charming, but unfocused. There
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.darktower.3:
must still be some force still active in the strongholds.

§8[[Next entry]]§0

My analysis indicates that it comes from several sources, operating as a group. I will head back to the stronghold after I resupply...
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.hydralair.1:
§8[[An explorer's notebook, written on fireproof paper]]§0

Fire is a trivial obstacle for a master explorer such as myself. I have traversed seas of fire, and swam through oceans of lava. The burning air here is an interesting variation, but
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.hydralair.2:
ultimately no hindrance.

What does stop me though is that I have encountered another protection spell, this time surrounding a mighty creature that must be king of this fire swamp. This is not the first protection spell I have encountered, and I am
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.hydralair.3:
beginning to unravel the mysteries of how they work.

If this spell is like the others, it will be sustained by a powerful creature nearby. Surrounding the fire swamp are several wet swamps, and under those swamps are labyrinths full of minotaurs.
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.hydralair.4: The logical choice to bind such a spell to would be some sort of powerful minotaur, different in some way from the others that surround it...
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.icetower.1:
§8[[An explorer's notebook, caked in ice]]§0

I overcame one blizzard, only to run into this terrible ice storm atop the glacier. My explorations have shown me the splendor of an ice palace, shining with the colors of the
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.icetower.2:
polar aurora. It all seems protected by some sort of curse.

§8[[Next entry]]§0

I am no novice. This curse is fed by the power of a creature nearby. The cause of the curse surrounding the fire swamp was built off the power of the
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.icetower.3:
leader of the minotaurs nearby.

Surrounding this glacier, there are masses of yetis. Perhaps the yetis have some sort of leader...
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.labyrinth.1:
§8[[An explorer's notebook, written on waterproof paper]]§0

The mosquitoes in this swamp are vexing, but strange. The vast majority of them seem to have no natural source, nor do they seem to have a role in the local ecology. I have begun to suspect that they are
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.labyrinth.2:
some kind of magical curse.

§8[[Next entry]]§0

Now that I have encountered a protection spell on the ruined labyrinth here, I consider my suspicions confirmed. Both the protection spell and the mosquitoes are a
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.labyrinth.3:
curse. This curse seems to have a different source from the others I have encountered. I will have to research further...

§8[[Next entry]]§0

The curse seems to be of a type too powerful for one being alone to
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.labyrinth.4:
produce. Several wizards working in combination would be necessary.

If one of the wizards stopped contributing, the whole of the curse over the entire swamp would fall. Strangely, my divinations do not show signs of any nearby living wizards.
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.labyrinth.5: I did see something interesting in one of the nearby pointy-roofed towers though...
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.lichtower.1:
§8[An explorer's notebook, gnawed on by monsters]§0

I have begun examining the strange aura surrounding this tower. The bricks of the tower are protected by a curse, stronger than any I've seen before. The magic from the curse is boiling off into the
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.lichtower.2:
surrounding area.

In my homeland I would have many options for dealing with this magic, but here my supplies are limited. I shall have to research...
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.lichtower.3:
§8[[Many entries later]]§0

A breakthrough! In my journeys I sighted a huge snake-like monster in a decorated courtyard. Nearby, I picked up a worn down, discarded green scale.

The magic in the scale seems to have the curse-breaking
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.lichtower.4: properties I need, but the magic is too dim. I may need to acquire a fresher specimen, directly from the creature.
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.tfstronghold.1:
§8[[An explorer's notebook, written on faintly glowing paper]]§0

The tendrils of darkness surrounding this area are just a manifestation of a protective spell over the entire dark forest. The spell causes blindness, which is quite vexing. I have seen several
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.tfstronghold.2:
interesting things in the area and would like to keep exploring.

§8[[Next entry]]§0

I have found ruins in the dark forest. They belong to a stronghold, of a type usually inhabited by knights. Rather than knights though, this stronghold is full of
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.tfstronghold.3:
goblins. They wear knightly armor, but their behavior is most un-knightly.

§8[[Next entry]]§0

Deep in the ruins, I have found a pedestal. The pedestal seems to be of a type that knights would place trophies on to prove their strength.
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.tfstronghold.4: Obtaining a powerful scepter would seem to weaken the curse on the dark forest, and placing a trophy associated with a powerful creature on the pedestal would likely grant access into the main part of the stronghold.
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.trollcave.1:
§8[[An explorer's notebook, damaged by acid]]§0

There seems to be no way to protect myself from the toxic rainstorm surrounding this area. In my brief excursions, I have also encountered another protection spell, similar to the others I have
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.trollcave.2:
witnessed. The spell must be connected to the toxic storm in some way. Further research to follow...

§8[[Next entry]]§0

Such supreme weather magic must be the result of multiple undefeated great evils in this world. My studies contain
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.trollcave.3: several clues pointing at a searing swamp, a forest coated in deep darkness, and a realm coated in snow.
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.unknown.1:
§8[[This book shows signs of having been copied many times]]§0

I cannot explain the field surrounding this structure, but the magic is powerful. If this curse is like the others, then the answer to unlocking it lies elsewhere. Perhaps there is something I have left
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.unknown.2: undone, or some monster I have yet to defeat. I will have to turn back. I will return to this place later, to see if anything has changed.
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.yeticave.1:
§8[[An explorer's notebook, covered in frost]]§0

The blizzard surrounding these snowy lands is unceasing. This is no ordinary snowfall--this is a magical phenomenon. I will have to conduct experiments to find what is capable of
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.yeticave.2:
causing such an effect.

§8[[Next entry]]§0

The curse seems to be of a type too powerful for one being alone to produce. Several wizards working in combination would be necessary. If one of the wizards stopped
twilightforest.twilightforest.book.yeticave.3: contributing, the blizzard would calm. Strangely, my divinations do not show signs of any nearby living wizards. I did see something interesting in one of the nearby pointy-roofed towers though...

 For the "Auto" option, go all the way to the left.

xaerominimap.gui.xaero_start_fading_at: Min Y Distance For Depth Fade
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_start_fading_at: Minimum Y level difference requirement for an entity to start darkening on the radar when the "Show Entity Depth" setting is enabled.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_partial_y_teleportation: Use Y With Partial When TP
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_partial_y_teleportation: When teleporting to a waypoint, offset the Y coordinate by 0.5 to avoid falling through carpet-like blocks into the void. Otherwise, the integer Y coordinate is used.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_delete_reached_deathpoints: Automatically delete deathpoints when you are within 4 blocks from them. This requires the deathpoint to be visible in world or on the minimap. A deathpoint is protected from deletion for 5 seconds after its creation.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_hide_minimap_under_screen: Hide the minimap when a GUI screen is open, e.g. the inventory, with the exception of minimap-related screens and the chat screen.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_category_list_add:
Supports player names, entity/item identifiers or patterns with special characters * ) ( and |. 
 
 * - matches anything. 
 )( - parenthesis, mostly for usage with |. 
 | - the OR operator to match different sequences in the same location. 
 
 For example: 
 minecraft:creeper 
 minecraft:zombie(_villager|_horse) - zombie villagers and horses. 
 minecraft:a*l - any vanilla entity which starts with 'a' and ends with 'l'.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_hide_minimap_under_f3: Hide the minimap when the F3 debug screen is enabled.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_manual_cave_mode_start: Which Y level to start mapping blocks from when the manual cave mode is enabled. Manual cave mode can be toggled with a key binding. For the "Auto" option, go all the way to the left.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_radar_render_over_minimap:
Render the entities over the minimap frame instead of rendering them inside the frame. Entities rendered this way act similarly to the waypoints and stick to the border when out of bounds. Visible entities are still limited to the ones loaded on the game client side though. 
 
 Option "Player List" - render over minimap only when the "List Players" key binding (TAB by default) is pressed.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_compass_over_everything: Render the cardinal direction letters (N, E, S, W) above all map elements, as opposed to under some, e.g. waypoints.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_tracked_players: Display players whose locations are shared with you in one way or another (usually your party) when they are out of the minimap frame bounds or not visible for another reason.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_pac_claims: Display chunk claims from the Open Parties and Claims mod as a colored overlay.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_pac_claims_border_opacity: The opacity of the chunk claims overlay border color. Chunk claims require the Open Parties and Claims mod.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_pac_claims_fill_opacity: The opacity of the chunk claims overlay fill color. Chunk claims require the Open Parties and Claims mod.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_pac_current_claim: Display claim information about the chunk that you are in. Chunk claims require the Open Parties and Claims mod.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_category_include_list_incl: Automatically include all entities from this list, and other lists included in this category, in the super-category/parent of this category, except the entities in the exclude list. That way you don't have to manually add duplicates on each level.

Automatically include all elements from this list, and other sub-lists included in this category, in the super-category/parent of this category. That way you don't have to manually add duplicates on each level. Keep in mind that super-categories are not going to check the exclusion lists of this category.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_temp_waypoints_global: When enabled, temporary waypoints are treated as global waypoints and ignore the waypoint render distance limits.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_keep_enlarged_minimap_unlo: Do not lock the minimap to north when enlarged if possible, which is only when using the circle shape at the time of writing this.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_enlarged_minimap_a_toggle: Treat the "Enlarge Minimap" key binding as a toggle instead of having to hold it.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_visibility_type:
In-World/Minimap Visibility Type 
 
 Local - only visible when in the maximum waypoint render distance 
 Global - always visible 
 World Map Loc. - not visible but is considered local 
 World Map Glo. - not visible but is considered global
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_option_requires_ingame: This option requires you to be in game.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_switch_to_auto_on_death: Whether to switch the waypoint sub-world to auto on deathpoint creation. This doesn't affect what sub-world the deathpoint is created in.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_minimap_info_display_manager_h: Click and drag the elements to change the order of the displayed information.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_info_display_background_op: The opacity of the colored backgrounds of information types that have a background enabled in the info display manager.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_waypoint_type:
Enabled - regular waypoint 
 Disabled - regular hidden waypoint 
 Temporary - waypoint disappears on world exit 
 Destination - waypoint disappears when reached
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_cave_mode_toggle_timer: The minimum time to wait between toggles of cave mode to prevent flickering when quickly switching between being under blocks and not. The latest world map mod has a separate setting for this as well.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_legible_cave_maps: Use depth-based lighting in cave mode instead of actual block lighting, making it easier to mentally separate the different cave layers.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_uses_worldmap_screen_value: Setting value is taken from the world map screen!
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_biome_blending: Smooth out biome color edges by sampling biome colors for multiple blocks for every block on the map. Turning this off can significantly improve performance when biome color calculation is modded to be much more heavyweight than vanilla.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_minimap_info_display_manag: Configure and/or rearrange different types of info displayed under the minimap, such as current coordinates, facing angles, dimension, biome, weather, light level, game time, real time and more.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_entity_radar_categories: Configure specific entity categories, which are usually players, hostile mobs, friendly mobs, items or other entities, separately instead of having the same configuration for every entity. You can even create your own custom categories for specific entity types.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_compass: The cardinal directions displayed on the minimap.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_compass_color: The color of the background/shadow under the cardinal directions displayed on the minimap.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_north_compass_color: The color of the background/shadow under the north cardinal direction displayed on the minimap.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_compass_scale2: The scale of the cardinal direction letters NESW. For the "Auto" option, go all the way to the left.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_dimension_scaled_max_waypo: Scale the maximum waypoint render distance by the current dimension's coordinate scale (e.g. 1/8 in the Nether).
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_waypoints_distance2: Maximum render distance for local waypoints. Global waypoints are not affected. By default, the maximum distance is scaled by the current dimension's coordinate scale. You can toggle this with "Dimension-scaled Max WP Distance".
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_tracked_players_on_map: Display markers on the minimap for players whose locations are shared with you in one way or another (usually your party) when they are out of the minimap frame bounds or not visible for another reason. The "common" config has an option "everyoneTracksEveryone" that enables tracking of every player.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_tracked_players_in_world: Display markers in the world for players whose locations are shared with you in one way or another (usually your party). The "common" config has an option "everyoneTracksEveryone" that enables tracking of every player.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_tracked_player_world_icon_: Scale of the tracked player icons in world.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_tracked_player_world_name_: Scale of the text displaying the name of a tracked player in world.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_tracked_player_minimap_ico: Scale of the tracked player icons on the minimap.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_minimap_redirect_item: Disabled because you're missing the configured required item in your hotbar: %1$s!
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_minimap_item: The ID of an item required in the hotbar for the minimap and waypoints to function. Set it to "-" to have no item requirement.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_config_redirect_fairplay: Disabled by fair-play mode enforced by the server!
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_config_redirect_safe_mode: This value cannot be modified when the minimap is in safe mode.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_teleport_default_command_r: The command used for waypoint teleportation with rotation if a world-specific or a server-specific command is not set in the Options menu in the waypoint screen.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_cave_mode_allowed_dimensio: A list of dimension IDs, separated by comas, where cave mode should work. If the list is empty (just []), cave mode works in every dimension.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_mm_box_auto_cave_mode: Enable cave mode automatically based on what's above you. The ceiling size refers to the size of a square ceiling of solid blocks that has to be detected above you to activate the cave mode. The solid blocks don't have to be on the same Y level.
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_box_cave_mode_allowed: Mapping mode that can go deeper than the surface blocks, mainly to display underground caves and interiors of buildings. Cave mode is usually enabled automatically (see "Auto Cave Mode"), but can also be toggled manually with a key binding (see "Manual Cave Mode Start Y").
xaerominimap.gui.xaero_reset_config_profile_default_m: Are you sure you want to restore the default values in the config profile?
This action cannot be undone! Non-profile options aren't affected.

xaerolib.gui.xaero_delete_profile_0: Are you sure you would like to permanently delete the following profile?
xaerolib.gui.xaero_box_current_profile: Your currently used client config profile.
xaerolib.gui.xaero_box_allow_internet_access: Whether the mod should be allowed to access the internet to fetch dynamic data, such as Patreon member names and mod versions. Nothing is sent from your computer.
xaerolib.gui.xaero_confirm_save_0: Would you like to confirm the changes you've made?
xaerolib.gui.xaero_settings_not_found: No matching entries found for your input!
xaerolib.gui.xaero_config_value_enforced_tooltip_: The effective value of this option is being affected by the server!
Shift-click to view the server-enforced value of this option.
xaerolib.gui.xaero_no_config_edit_permission_0: You don't have permission to edit this config.
xaerolib.gui.xaero_permission_enforced_server_pro: Enforced server profile ID (not the name).
xaerolib.gui.xaero_setting_entry_wrong_context: This entry is not accessible in the current context.
xaerolib.gui.xaero_box_default_enforced_profile: The ID of the server config profile the values of which are enforced for players by default.
xaerolib.gui.xaero_box_ignore_enforcement_if_edit: Whether you should ignore config values normally enforced by the server, if you have the server profile editing permission (e.g. you are an operator). The enforcement for the value of this option ("Ignore Enforced As Editor") can't be ignored though, allowing server owners to disable this feature if they want to, making it a bit more difficult for cheaters to circumvent server enforcement.

xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_requires_reload: Requires reloading the world to take effect! Lower
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_delete_map_msg1: Are you sure you would like to delete the selected map?
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_delete_map_msg2: Only the latest deleted map is backed up.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_delete_map_msg3: Please confirm deletion by pressing Yes again.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_map_selection_box:
Manual - you are asked to select and confirm the world map every time you switch worlds or dimensions. 
 
 World Spawn - the world map is selected and confirmed automatically based on the world spawn point that the game client is aware of. Can break if the server is using the vanilla compass item for a custom function. 
 
 Single - each dimension has a single world map that is automatically confirmed. Useful for simple servers with a single world. 
 
 Server - install the world map mod on the server side to use this automatic mode.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_ignore_heightmaps: Some servers put custom values in the world heightmaps, which can cause incorrectly rendered maps. Sometimes it can even happen in heavily modded singleplayer worlds. This option should fix such issues at the expense of a bit of performance. Do not use unless you need to. Reenter the world after toggling the option! Stored per world/server, not part of the config profile.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_error_loading_properties: Error loading server world map properties. Please retry.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_mw_server_box: Map selection is automatically controlled by the server. You can turn this off with "ignoreServerLevelId" in the server-specific config in the XaeroWorldMap directory.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_no_world_map_message: The map is disabled with a potion effect.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_controls:
Controls 
 
 Click and drag to scroll the map. 
 Scroll the mouse wheel to zoom in and out (CTRL for precise). 
 Right-click the map for some useful shortcuts. 
 Some UI buttons have additional key bindings displayed in their tooltip. 
 
 Right-click a map element (e.g. waypoint) for options. 
 %1$sClick here to edit the key bindings.

§2%s§r to create a new waypoint.

 §2%s§r to switch the waypoint set. 
 §2%s§r to toggle rendering all waypoint sets. 
 §2%s§r to open the full waypoint menu.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_controls_pac: §2%s§r to open the Parties and Claims menu.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_export: Export the map as a PNG file.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_export_confirm_1: Do you want to export the map as a PNG file?
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_export_confirm_2: The game will temporarily appear frozen while it's working.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_waypoints_minimap_required: The waypoint feature requires the Xaero's Minimap mod!
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_waypoints_disabled: Waypoints are disabled in the world map settings!
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_no_world_map_item_message: The mod is configured to require the following item in your hotbar or equipped:
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_current_map_locked1: The currently selected map is used by another process (Minecraft client).
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_current_map_locked2: Please select a different map of this server (bottom left icon).
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_detect_ambiguous_y: A single pixel on the map can contain multiple transparent layers and an opaque block under them. In older non-cache map data files, only the Y level (height) of the opaque block is stored in such cases, which often makes it unsafe to blindly teleport to the stored Y coordinate. When this setting is ON, the mod treats such map pixels as it would undiscovered chunks. It defaults to 2D waypoints and disables direct teleportation to such pixels. Disable this at your own risk!
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_closing_menu_when_hopping: Closing the menu when hopping to a waypoint (left-clicking in the menu)
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_not_closing_menu_when_hopp: Not closing the menu when hopping to a waypoint (left-clicking in the menu)
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_adjust_height_for_carpe: Subtract 1 from the height value for short carpetlike blocks, e.g. carpet, 1-layer snow, lilypad etc. This prevents such blocks from causing harsh shading on the map like a full block. Waypoints and teleportation over these blocks should make more sense too.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_only_current_map_waypoints: Displaying only the waypoints bound to the current world map, even if another waypoint sub-world is selected for the minimap using the full waypoint menu.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_waypoints_selected_by_mini: Displaying waypoints from the same waypoint sub-world as you are viewing in game and on the minimap. The sub-world can be switched in the full waypoint menu.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_arrow_color: Color of the arrow that indicates the position and the rotation of the player.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_minimap_radar: %s Minimap entity radar is displayed (requires Xaero's Minimap)
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_no_minimap_radar: %s Minimap entity radar is not displayed
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_toggle_minimap_radar: Toggle Minimap Radar On World Map
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_players_pac_required: The party player menu feature requires the Open Parties and Claims mod!
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_claims_pac_required: The chunk claim feature requires the Open Parties and Claims mod!
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_pac_player_teleport_com: The chat command used on this world/server to teleport you to other players on the map when Open Parties and Claims is installed.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_player_teleport_command: The chat command used on this world/server to teleport you to tracked players on the map (not regular radar). Stored per world/server, not part of the config profile.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_pac_claims: Display chunk claims from the Open Parties and Claims mod as a colored overlay.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_pac_claims_border_opaci: The opacity of the chunk claims overlay border color. Chunk claims require the Open Parties and Claims mod.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_pac_claims_fill_opacity: The opacity of the chunk claims overlay fill color. Chunk claims require the Open Parties and Claims mod.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_teleport_command_waypoints_: Waypoint teleportation is configured by the minimap.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_teleport_allowed_tooltip: Whether right-click map teleportation is allowed. Waypoint teleportation is configured separately in the full waypoint menu options.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_option_requires_minimap: This option requires the Xaero's Minimap mod.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_option_requires_ingame: This option requires you to be in game.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_settings_not_found: No matching entries found for your input!
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_reset_message: Are you sure you would like to restore the default settings?
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_partial_y_teleportation: Use Y With Partial When TP
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_partial_y_teleportation: When teleporting to a map location, offset the Y coordinate by 0.5 to avoid falling through carpet-like blocks into the void. Otherwise, the integer Y coordinate is used.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_update_chunks: Update chunks on the non-world-save maps (multiplayer).
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_load_chunks: Add new chunks to the non-world-save maps (multiplayer).
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_legible_cave_maps: Use depth-based lighting in cave mode instead of actual block lighting, making it easier to mentally separate the different cave layers.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_cave_mode_type:
The cave mode type to use when cave mode is enabled. 
 
 OFF - display above ground even when cave mode is automatically or manually enabled (same as old world map versions without cave mode) 
 Layered - separate cave maps into multiple layers depending on the used top Y 
 Full - ignore the used top Y, use a single layer for cave maps and map everything from the world top to the world bottom
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_default_cave_mode_type: The default cave mode type assigned to dimensions visited for the first time in a world/server. You can read more about cave mode types by clicking the cave mode icon on the map screen.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_auto_cave_mode:
How the mod should determine the "auto" top Y when viewing the full screen map. The ceiling size refers to the size of a square ceiling of solid blocks that has to be detected above you to activate the cave mode. The solid blocks don't have to be on the same Y level. 
 
 Minimap - if installed, match the minimap mod's cave mode, otherwise use the ceiling size 3x3
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_cave_mode_toggle_timer: The minimum time to wait between toggles of cave mode to prevent flickering when quickly switching between being under blocks and not. This only applies when "Auto Cave Mode" isn't redirecting to the minimap mod. The latest minimap mod has a separate setting for this as well.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_biome_blending: Smooth out biome color edges by sampling biome colors for multiple blocks for every block on the map. Turning this off can significantly improve performance when biome color calculation is modded to be much more heavyweight than vanilla.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_png_result_not_prepared: Can't export just yet! The world map has not been prepared yet.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_png_result_too_big: The exported area is way too big to scale down! Please make a smaller selection.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_png_result_image_too_big: The image size is beyond what's possible to store in a BufferedImage!
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_png_result_out_of_memory: The export failed because the Java heap ran out of memory! Please try again or allocate more memory.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_png_result_bad_fbo: The export failed because the mod failed to create an OpenGL framebuffer.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_png_result_io_exception: The export failed because of an IO exception! Please try again. The full exception has been logged.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_export_screen_exporting: Exporting... Will temporarily appear frozen. Might take a while!
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_export_option_full: Export the whole map even if you've made a map selection.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_export_option_multiple_ima: Export the map as multiple unscaled images no matter how big it is. This does not have the same memory limitations as a single image.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_export_option_nighttime: Export the map with nighttime lighting. This doesn't affect cave mode maps.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_export_option_scale_down_s:
The size, in regions, of a square image equivalent to the resolution that a large exported map will be scaled down to if necessary. For example, 20x20 stands for 400 regions, 512x512 blocks/pixels each. The resulting image doesn't have to be a square. 10x40 is also 400 regions. 
 
 Your computer or the Java heap size might not be able to handle higher export resolutions.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_export_option_highlights: Export the map with all currently enabled highlights (e.g. claims) applied to the map. When exporting the full map, highlights very far from your discovered map won't be included.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_map_writing_distance: The maximum X and Z distance in chunks at which chunks can be loaded or updated on a non-world-save map. For the "Unlimited" option, go all the way to the left. World save maps always generate within your render distance
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_full_reload: Reload all regions on the map without having to manually view them. The reloading process will work in the background and turn off when it's done. It is important to note that going to another dimension will pause it until you come back and changing maps will fully cancel it.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_full_resave: Reload and resave all regions on the map without having to manually visit them. World save maps will be converted into normal map data saved to a separate map instance "Converted World Save", stored in the folder "cm$converted", which can be transferred to multiplayer map instances for the same world, using file manager. The reloading process will work in the background and turn off when it's done. It is important to note that going to another dimension will pause it until you come back and changing maps will fully cancel it.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_full_reload_in_progress: Full map reload is in progress...
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_reload_viewed_regions: Reload every region that is displayed on your screen once.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_unknown_dimension_type2: The map functions are limited. Visiting the dimension once might help.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_teleport_not_connected: You are trying to teleport to a map that is not connected to the current confirmed/auto one. If you are sure that this map is from your current sub-server/world save, then you can enable teleportation by adding a connection in the map selection screen -> Connect. But beware, if you connect unrelated maps and teleport, then there is a good chance you will suffocate in a block or die from fall damage, so be careful and connect only the right ones.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_teleport_never_confirmed: You cannot teleport yet because you have not yet confirmed a single map in your current dimension. Please confirm a map in your current dimension or change map selection type to an automatic one.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_connect_with_auto_msg: Would you like to create the following connection between maps?
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_disconnect_from_auto_msg: Would you like to delete the following connection between maps?
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_cave_mode_allowed: Cave mode on the full screen world map. It's a mapping mode that can go deeper than the surface blocks, mainly to display underground caves and interiors of buildings. Cave mode is usually enabled automatically (see "Auto Cave Mode"), but can also be enabled manually on the world map screen.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_cave_mode_allowed_dimen: A list of dimension IDs, separated by comas, where cave mode should work on the full screen world map. If the list is empty (just []), cave mode works in every dimension.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_world_map_config_redirect_fair: Disabled by fair-play mode enforced by the server!
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_map_teleport_command: The chat commands used on this world/server to teleport you to positions on the map. Stored per world/server, not part of the config profile.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_box_map_item: The ID of an item required in the hotbar for the fullscreen world map to function. Set it to "-" to have no item requirement.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_box_display_minimap_radar: Display minimap radar on the fullscreen map. Only works when the Xaero's Minimap mod is installed.
xaeroworldmap.gui.xaero_wm_reset_config_profile_defaul: Are you sure you want to restore the default values in the config profile?
This action cannot be undone! Non-profile options aren't affected.
